Do not read or modify anything under /workspace. Do not run any formatter. Just write input files. Directory layout and counts: - /tmp/corpus/yaml/ : 45 files with .yaml or .yml extensions. Cover: GitHub Actions workflows (several, with `${{ ... }}` expressions, `on:` triggers, matrix, `run: |` blocks, long single-line `run:` commands, `if:` conditions), docker-compose files (anchors `&x`/aliases `*x`, `<<: *x` merge keys, ports/env lists, quoted strings), Kubernetes manifests (multi-document with `---`, ConfigMaps with `|` blocks, long annotation strings), Helm values.yaml, Ansible playbooks/roles (Jinja `"{{ var }}"` strings, `when:` conditions, handlers, `loop:`), OpenAPI 3 specs (paths, `'200':` keys, `$ref`, long `description:` values, nested schemas, flow lists like `required: [id, name]`), mkdocs.yml (nav lists, `!!python/name:` tags, markdown_extensions), GitLab CI, CircleCI, pre-commit config, conda environment.yml, dependabot.yml, codecov.yml, .readthedocs.yaml-style, Jekyll _config.yml, Hugo config, Serverless framework, CloudFormation snippets (with `!Ref`, `!Sub`, `!GetAtt` tags), Prometheus/alertmanager configs, i18n translation files with long prose values, and a few JSON-Lines-like files (2+ lines each a one-line flow mapping like {"id":1,"name":"x"}). - /tmp/corpus/md/ : 40 files with .md (most), plus 8 .qmd and 6 .Rmd. Cover: READMEs (badges, install sections, code fences with languages, tables, nested lists, HTML blocks like

, reference-style links), CHANGELOGs (Keep a Changelog style, version headings, link reference definitions at the bottom), CONTRIBUTING guides, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, docs pages with admonitions, blockquotes, numbered lists, task lists, footnotes, setext headings (=== and ---), `*` and `+` bullets, headings with trailing #'s, emphasis with _ and __, long paragraphs with hard-wrapped lines at odd widths, very long lines, inline links with long URLs, images, autolinks, HTML comments, YAML front matter. Quarto .qmd files: YAML front matter (title/author/format/execute), ```{r} and ```{python} chunks with `#|` options (label, fig-cap, echo), callout divs (::: {.callout-note} ... :::), cross references (@fig-x), citations [@key], math $$...$$ blocks, tabsets. R Markdown .Rmd: front matter with `output:` and some with `editor_options:\n markdown:\n wrap: sentence` or `wrap: 72`, chunks like ```{r setup, include=FALSE}, inline r code `r 1+1`, long prose paragraphs with multiple sentences (including abbreviations like e.g., Dr., i.e.). - /tmp/corpus/py/ : 8 .py files. Some with consecutive `#|` comment blocks containing YAML (e.g. `#| title: x`, `#| tags: [a,b]`, nested keys), some with `# fmt: markdown` immediately before a triple-quoted string assignment or before a block of `# ` comments containing Markdown, normal Python code otherwise (functions, classes, docstrings). - /tmp/corpus/r/ : 6 .R files. Similar: roxygen `#'` comments, `#|` hashpipe blocks, `# fmt: markdown` before an r"(...)" raw string or a "..." string or a comment block. Make the documents realistic but messy (they will be formatted, so include things a formatter would change): inconsistent indentation (4-space and 2-space, sequences indented or not), extra spaces after colons, `[ a, b ]` flow lists with odd spacing, quoted values that don't need quotes, overly long prose lines (well over 80 chars), trailing whitespace in some places, multiple blank lines, mixed list markers, unaligned Markdown tables, etc. Vary sizes from ~20 to ~200 lines. Keep all content plain UTF-8 text; use LF line endings. Don't make any file invalid YAML (YAML files must parse as valid YAML 1.2), except you may include 2 YAML files whose flow collections span multiple lines. When done, reply with just the list of directories and file counts.

arguments.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - "*.md"
  pull_request:
    branches:    [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
  FORCE_COLOR: '1'
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

jobs:
    lint:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
              with:
                  python-version: "3.12"
                  cache: 'pip'
            - name: Install linters
              run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install ruff==0.6.9 mypy==1.11.2 types-requests types-PyYAML --no-cache-dir
            - name: Ruff
              run: ruff check . --output-format=github
            - name:   Mypy
              run: |
                mypy src/ \
                  --ignore-missing-imports \
                  --strict


    test:
      needs: lint
      name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python-version }})
      runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
      strategy:
        fail-fast: false
        matrix:
          os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest,windows-latest]
          python-version: [ "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13" ]
          exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.13"
            coverage: true
      steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
      - name: Install package
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[test]"
      - name: Run tests
        if: ${{ !matrix.coverage }}
        run: pytest -q -n auto --durations=10
      - name: Run tests with coverage
        if: matrix.coverage
        run: pytest -q -n auto --cov=src/mypkg --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered --junitxml=reports/junit.xml
      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.coverage && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false
      - name: Windows-only smoke test
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          python -c "import mypkg; print(mypkg.__version__)"
          Get-ChildItem -Path dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue


    build:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      needs: [ test ]
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - run: pipx run build
        - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
          with:
            name: dist
            path: dist/*
            retention-days: 7

arguments.content:
# Release workflow — builds wheels, publishes to PyPI and creates a GitHub release
name: "Release"

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
      - "v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+rc[0-9]+"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run everything except the actual upload step (useful for testing changes to this workflow without publishing anything)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      version:
        description:   "Version override"
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  wheels:
    name: Build wheels on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-22.04 , windows-2022, macos-14 ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pypa/cibuildwheel@v2.21.3
        env:
          CIBW_SKIP: "pp* *-musllinux_i686 *-win32"
          CIBW_TEST_REQUIRES: pytest
          CIBW_TEST_COMMAND: "pytest {project}/tests -x -q"
          CIBW_ARCHS_MACOS: "x86_64 arm64"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheels-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: ./wheelhouse/*.whl

  sdist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Build sdist
      run: pipx run build --sdist
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with: { name: sdist, path: dist/*.tar.gz }

  publish:
    needs: [wheels, sdist]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/acme-widgets
    permissions:
      id-token: write     # required for trusted publishing
      contents: write
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && !inputs.dry-run)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: '*'
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: List artifacts
        run: ls -lah dist/ && python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; files=list(pathlib.Path('dist').glob('*')); print(len(files), 'files'); sys.exit(0 if files else 1)"
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          skip-existing: true
          print-hash: true
      - name: Create GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
            --title "acme-widgets $TAG" \
            --generate-notes \
            --verify-tag
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: success()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: 'C0123456789'
          slack-message: "Released acme-widgets ${{ github.ref_name }} to PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/acme-widgets/${{ github.ref_name }}/ (triggered by ${{ github.actor }})"
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

      id-token: write     # required for trusted publishing
      contents: write
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && !inputs.dry-run)
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: '*'
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: List artifacts
        run: ls -lah dist/ && python3 -c "import pathlib,sys; files=list(pathlib.Path('dist').glob('*')); print(len(files), 'files'); sys.exit(0 if files else 1)"
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          skip-existing: true
          print-hash: true
      - name: Create GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
            --title "acme-widgets $TAG" \
            --generate-notes \
            --verify-tag
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: success()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: 'C0123456789'
          slack-message: "Released acme-widgets ${{ github.ref_name }} to PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/acme-widgets/${{ github.ref_name }}/ (triggered by ${{ github.actor }})"
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

name: "CodeQL & lint"

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    # The branches below must be a subset of the branches above
    branches: [ "main" ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'   # every Monday at 03:17 UTC


jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 'macos-latest') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 120) || 360 }}
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      packages: read
      actions: read
      contents: read

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - language: javascript-typescript
          build-mode: none
        - language: python
          build-mode: none
        - language: go
          build-mode: autobuild
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Initialize CodeQL
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
      with:
        languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
        build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
        queries: security-extended,security-and-quality

    - if: matrix.build-mode == 'manual'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo 'If you are using a "manual" build mode for one or more of the' \
          'languages you are analyzing, replace this with the commands to build' \
          'your code, for example:'
        echo '  make bootstrap'
        echo '  make release'
        exit 1

    - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
      with:
        category: "/language:${{matrix.language}}"

  golangci:
      name: golangci-lint
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip lint]')"
      steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
            with:
              go-version-file: 'go.mod'
              cache: false
          - name: golangci-lint
            uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
            with:
              version: v1.61
              args: --timeout=5m --config=.golangci.yml --issues-exit-code=1 --out-format=colored-line-number ./...
              only-new-issues: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

  markdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@v17
        with:
          globs: |
            **/*.md
            !node_modules/**
            !CHANGELOG.md

name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest,
             macos-13,
             windows-latest]
        node: [ 18, 20, 22 ]
        experimental: [false]
        include: [
            {os: ubuntu-latest, node: 23, experimental: true},
            { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, node: 22, experimental: true }
          ]
        exclude:
          - { os: macos-13, node: 18 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test -- --reporter=dot --timeout=20000 --forbid-only --retries=2 --exit
      - name: Report failure
        if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `Nightly failed on ${{ matrix.os }} / node ${{ matrix.node }}`;
            const body = [
              `Run: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
              '',
              'This issue was opened automatically.',
            ].join('\n');
            await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body, labels: ['nightly', 'ci'] });

name: R-CMD-check

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  R-CMD-check:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}

    name: ${{ matrix.config.os }} (${{ matrix.config.r }})

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config:
          - {os: macos-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: windows-latest, r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'devel', http-user-agent: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-1'}

    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      R_KEEP_PKG_SOURCE: yes
      _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.config.r }}
          http-user-agent: ${{ matrix.config.http-user-agent }}
          use-public-rspm: true

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: any::rcmdcheck, any::covr, local::.
          needs: check

      - uses: r-lib/actions/check-r-package@v2
        with:
          upload-snapshots: true
          build_args: 'c("--no-manual","--compact-vignettes=gs+qpdf")'

      - name: Test coverage
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.config.r == 'release'
        run: |
          cov <- covr::package_coverage(
            quiet = FALSE,
            clean = FALSE,
            install_path = file.path(normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RUNNER_TEMP"), winslash = "/"), "package")
          )
          covr::to_cobertura(cov)
        shell: Rscript {0}

version: "3.9"

x-logging: &default-logging
  driver: "json-file"
  options:
    max-size: "10m"
    max-file: "3"

x-app-env: &app-env
  NODE_ENV: production
  DATABASE_URL: "postgres://app:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-changeme}@db:5432/app?sslmode=disable"
  REDIS_URL: 'redis://cache:6379/0'
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"

x-service-defaults: &service-defaults
  restart: unless-stopped
  logging: *default-logging
  networks: [ backend ]

services:
  web:
    <<: *service-defaults
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile
      args:
        - NODE_VERSION=20
        - "BUILD_SHA=${GIT_SHA:-dev}"
    image: "ghcr.io/acme/storefront:latest"
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - 9229:9229
    environment:
      <<: *app-env
      PORT: "3000"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      cache:
          condition: service_started
    networks:
      - backend
      - frontend
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--spider", "-q", "http://localhost:3000/healthz"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s

  worker:
    <<: *service-defaults
    image: ghcr.io/acme/storefront:latest
    command: [ "node", "dist/worker.js", "--concurrency", "4" ]
    environment: *app-env
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
      resources:
        limits: { cpus: '0.50', memory: 512M }

  db:
    <<: *service-defaults
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=app
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-changeme}
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/initdb:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app -d app" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  cache:
    image: "redis:7.2-alpine"
    command: redis-server --save 60 1 --loglevel warning --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    <<: *service-defaults
    volumes: [ "cache-data:/data" ]

  proxy:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    restart: always
    ports: ["80:80", "443:443"]
    volumes:
      - ./docker/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
    depends_on: [web]
    networks: [frontend]
    logging: *default-logging

volumes:
  db-data:
  cache-data: {}

networks:
  backend:
    driver: bridge
  frontend:

name: monitoring

services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.54.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - "--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d"
      - --web.enable-lifecycle
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus:/etc/prometheus:ro
      - prom_data:/prometheus
    ports: [ '9090:9090' ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:11.2.0
    depends_on:
    - prometheus
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?set GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env}
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: "false"
      GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS: "grafana-clock-panel,grafana-piechart-panel"
    volumes:
    - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
    ports:
    - "3001:3000"

  node-exporter:
    image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:latest
    command: ['--path.rootfs=/host']
    pid: host
    network_mode: host
    volumes:

  cadvisor:

      - /sys:/sys:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/:/var/lib/docker:ro

volumes:
  prom_data: {}
  grafana_data: {}

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: "shop"
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.14.0"
  annotations:
    deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "17"
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "Rolled out 2.14.0 to fix the checkout timeout regression introduced in 2.13.2 (see INC-4821 for the full post-incident review and follow-up actions)"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'
        prometheus.io/port: "9102"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: storefront
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: "ghcr.io/acme/storefront:2.14.0"
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        args: ["--port=8080", "--metrics-port=9102", '--log-format=json']
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http
        - {containerPort: 9102, name: metrics}
        env:
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef: { name: storefront-db, key: url }
        - name: FEATURE_FLAGS
          value: "checkout-v2,new-search,  recommendations"
        envFrom:
          - configMapRef:
              name: storefront-config
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /readyz, port: http }
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 3
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "16m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      more_set_headers "X-Frame-Options: DENY";
      more_set_headers "Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin";
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/server-snippet: "location ~* ^/(wp-admin|wp-login\\.php|xmlrpc\\.php) { return 404; }"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
  - hosts: [ shop.example.com, www.shop.example.com ]
    secretName: storefront-tls
  rules:
  - host: shop.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: storefront
            port:
              name: http

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: storefront-config
  namespace: shop
  labels: { app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront }
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: "300"
  ENABLE_TRACING: "true"
  application.properties: |
    server.port=8080
    spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=20
    spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
    management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus
    # trailing comment inside the block
  nginx.conf: |
      worker_processes auto;
      events { worker_connections 1024; }
      http {
          include       mime.types;
          sendfile      on;
          keepalive_timeout  65;
          gzip on;
          gzip_types text/plain application/json application/javascript text/css;

          server {
              listen 8080;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
                  proxy_set_header Host $host;
                  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              }
          }
      }
  motd.txt: >
    Welcome to the storefront staging cluster.
    Please do not run load tests here without
    announcing them in #shop-infra first.

  feature-flags.json: |-
    {
      "checkout-v2": true,
      "new-search": {"enabled": true, "rollout": 0.25},
      "recommendations": false
    }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fluent-bit-config
  namespace: logging
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [SERVICE]
        Flush         5
        Log_Level     info
        Parsers_File  parsers.conf

    [INPUT]
        Name              tail
        Path              /var/log/containers/*.log
        Tag               kube.*
        Mem_Buf_Limit     50MB

    [OUTPUT]
        Name  es
        Match *
        Host  ${ES_HOST}
        Port  9200
  parsers.conf: |
    [PARSER]
        Name   json
        Format json
        Time_Key time
        Time_Format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%L%z
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: storefront-db
  namespace: shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  url: "postgres://app:s3cr3t@db.shop.svc.cluster.local:5432/app"

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: nightly-report
  namespace: analytics
  annotations:
    description: "Generates the nightly revenue report, uploads it to s3://acme-reports/nightly/ and posts a summary to the #revenue channel. Owned by the data-platform team; page them if it fails twice in a row."
spec:
  schedule: "30 1 * * *"
  timeZone: "Europe/Berlin"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit:     5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: report
              image: ghcr.io/acme/reports:1.8.3
              command: [ "python", "-m", "reports.nightly" ]
              args:
                - --date=yesterday
                - "--output=s3://acme-reports/nightly/"
                - --notify-slack
              env:
                - name: AWS_REGION
                  value: eu-central-1
                - name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: slack
                      key: webhook
              resources:
                requests: {cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi}
                limits:   {memory: 2Gi}
          nodeSelector:
            workload: batch
          tolerations:
          - key: "dedicated"
            operator: "Equal"
            value: "batch"
            effect: "NoSchedule"

---
- name: Configure web servers
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    http_port:    80
    max_clients: 200
    app_user: "deploy"
    packages:
      - nginx
      - "python3-pip"
      - git
      - ufw
    app_env:
      DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: "mysite.settings.production"
      SECRET_KEY: "{{ vault_django_secret_key }}"
  vars_files:
    - vars/main.yml
    - "vars/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}.yml"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache if needed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

  tasks:
  - name: Install required packages
    ansible.builtin.package:
      name: "{{ item }}"
      state: present
    loop: "{{ packages }}"
    tags: [packages, setup]

  - name: Create application user
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: "{{ app_user }}"
      shell: /bin/bash
      groups: www-data
      append: true

  - name: Write nginx site config
    ansible.builtin.template:
      src: templates/site.conf.j2
      dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf"
      owner: root
      group: root
      mode: '0644'
      validate: 'nginx -t -c %s'
    notify:
      - Reload nginx

  - name: Enable site
    ansible.builtin.file:
      src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf
      dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf
      state: link
    notify: Reload nginx

  - name: Open firewall ports
    community.general.ufw:
      rule: allow
      port: "{{ item.port }}"
      proto: "{{ item.proto | default('tcp') }}"
    loop:
      - { port: "22", proto: tcp }
      - { port: "{{ http_port }}" }
      - {port: "443"}
    when:
      - ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      - not (skip_firewall | default(false) | bool)

  - name: Show a long debug message
    ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: "Deployed {{ app_user }} on {{ inventory_hostname }} ({{ ansible_default_ipv4.address | default('no ipv4') }}) running {{ ansible_distribution }} {{ ansible_distribution_version }}"
    when: debug_deploy is defined and debug_deploy

  handlers:
    - name: Reload nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded

    - name:   Restart app
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "gunicorn@{{ app_user }}"
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: true
      listen: "restart web stack"

- name: Configure database servers
  hosts: dbservers
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: geerlingguy.postgresql
      vars:
        postgresql_databases:
          - name: mysite
        postgresql_users:
          - name: mysite
            password: "{{ vault_db_password }}"
    - { role: common, tags: ['common'] }

---
# tasks file for roles/nginx
- name: Include OS-specific variables
  include_vars: "{{ item }}"
  with_first_found:
    - "{{ ansible_distribution }}-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}.yml"
    - "{{ ansible_os_family }}.yml"
    - default.yml

- name: Ensure nginx is installed
  package:
    name: nginx
    state: "{{ nginx_package_state | default('present') }}"
  register: nginx_install
  until: nginx_install is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 5

- name: Create vhost directories
  file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - /etc/nginx/sites-available
    - /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
    - "{{ nginx_log_dir }}"

- name: Configure vhosts
  template:
    src: vhost.j2
    dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf"
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.server_name }}"
  when: nginx_vhosts | length > 0
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Remove default site
  file: path=/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default state=absent
  when: nginx_remove_default_vhost|bool
  notify:
  - reload nginx

- name: Generate dhparams (this can take a long time on small VMs, so we only do it once and cache the result in /etc/ssl/certs)
  command: openssl dhparam -out /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem 2048
  args:
    creates: /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem

- block:
    - name: Check nginx configuration
      command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false
    - name: Ensure nginx is started and enabled
      service: name=nginx state=started enabled=yes
  rescue:
    - name: Print the failing config
      debug:
        msg: "nginx -t failed with: {{ ansible_failed_result.stderr | default('unknown error') }}"
    - fail:
        msg: 'Aborting play, nginx config is broken'
  always:
    - debug: msg="nginx role finished"



- name: Set facts for later roles
  set_fact:
    nginx_configured: true
    nginx_vhost_names: "{{ nginx_vhosts | map(attribute='server_name') | list }}"

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory Service API
  version: "1.4.0"
  description: |
    The Inventory Service exposes stock levels, reservations and warehouse metadata for all ACME sales channels.

    All endpoints require a bearer token issued by the identity service. Rate limits are applied per client id; see the `X-RateLimit-*` response headers.
  contact:
    name: Inventory team
    email: inventory-team@example.com
  license: { name: Apache 2.0, url: 'https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html' }
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/inventory/v1
    description: Production
  - url: 'https://staging-api.example.com/inventory/v1'
    description: Staging
tags:
  - name: items
    description: Operations on stock-keeping units
  - name: reservations
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /items:
    get:
      tags: [items]
      summary: List items
      operationId: listItems
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PageSize'
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageToken"
        - name: warehouse
          in: query
          description: Only return items that are stocked in the given warehouse. When omitted, stock levels are aggregated across every warehouse the caller has access to.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: "BER-1"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A page of items
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemPage'
        "401":
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Error'
    post:
      tags: [ items ]
      summary: Create an item
      operationId: createItem
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewItem' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          headers:
            Location:
              description: URL of the created item
              schema: {type: string, format: uri}
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        '409':
          description: An item with the same SKU already exists.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /items/{sku}:
    parameters:
      - name: sku
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4,8}$'
    get:
      tags: [items]
      summary: Get a single item by SKU
      operationId: getItem
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      tags: [items]
      operationId: deleteItem
      summary: Delete an item
      description: >
        Deletes the item and all of its reservations. This operation cannot be undone;
        clients should prefer setting `status: archived` instead.
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    PageSize:
      name: page_size
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500, default: 50 }
    PageToken:
      name: page_token
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    Unauthorized:
      description: Authentication information is missing or invalid.
    NotFound:
      description: The requested resource does not exist.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Error:
      description: Unexpected error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  schemas:
    NewItem:
      type: object
      required: [sku, name]
      properties:
        sku:
          type: string
          example: ABC-12345
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: Free-form, customer-facing description. Markdown is allowed but HTML is stripped before rendering in any storefront.
        tags:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
          uniqueItems: true
    Item:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewItem'
        - type: object
          required: [ id, created_at, stock ]
          properties:
            id: {type: string, format: uuid, readOnly: true}
            created_at:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [active, archived, "out-of-stock"]
              default: active
            stock:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
              example: { BER-1: 12, HAM-2: 0 }
    ItemPage:
      type: object
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        next_page_token:
          type: string
          nullable: true
    Problem:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: { type: string, format: uri }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer, format: int32 }
        detail: { type: string }

  /items:
    get:
      tags: [items]
      summary: List items
      operationId: listItems
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PageSize'
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageToken"
        - name: warehouse
          in: query
          description: Only return items that are stocked in the given warehouse. When omitted, stock levels are aggregated across every warehouse the caller has access to.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: "BER-1"
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A page of items
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemPage'
        "401":
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Error'
    post:
      tags: [ items ]
      summary: Create an item
      operationId: createItem
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewItem' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          headers:
            Location:
              description: URL of the created item
              schema: {type: string, format: uri}
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        '409':
          description: An item with the same SKU already exists.
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /items/{sku}:
    parameters:
      - name: sku
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4,8}$'
    get:
      tags: [items]
      summary: Get a single item by SKU
      operationId: getItem
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      tags: [items]
      operationId: deleteItem
      summary: Delete an item
      description: >
        Deletes the item and all of its reservations. This operation cannot be undone;
        clients should prefer setting `status: archived` instead.
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    PageSize:
      name: page_size
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500, default: 50 }
    PageToken:
      name: page_token
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    Unauthorized:
      description: Authentication information is missing or invalid.
    NotFound:
      description: The requested resource does not exist.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' }
    Error:
      description: Unexpected error
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  schemas:
    NewItem:
      type: object
      required: [sku, name]
      properties:
        sku:
          type: string
          example: ABC-12345
        name:
          type: string
          maxLength: 200
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: Free-form, customer-facing description. Markdown is allowed but HTML is stripped before rendering in any storefront.
        tags:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
          uniqueItems: true
    Item:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewItem'
        - type: object
          required: [ id, created_at, stock ]
          properties:
            id: {type: string, format: uuid, readOnly: true}
            created_at:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [active, archived, "out-of-stock"]
              default: active
            stock:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                type: integer
                minimum: 0
              example: { BER-1: 12, HAM-2: 0 }
    ItemPage:
      type: object
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Item'
        next_page_token:
          type: string
          nullable: true
    Problem:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: { type: string, format: uri }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer, format: int32 }
        detail: { type: string }

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Billing API
  version: 2024-06-01
  description: "Internal billing API used by the checkout, subscription and invoicing services.
    Breaking changes are announced at least 90 days in advance on the #billing-announce channel."
x-tagGroups:
  - name: Core
    tags: [Customers, Invoices,
           Payments]
  - name: Admin
    tags: [ Webhooks ]
paths:
  /customers/{customerId}/invoices:
    get:
      operationId: listInvoices
      tags: [Invoices]
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: customerId
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [
              draft,
              open,
              paid,
              uncollectible,
              void
              ]
        - in: query
          name: created
          description: Filter by creation date. Accepts an object with any of the keys gt, gte, lt and lte, each holding a Unix timestamp in seconds.
          style: deepObject
          explode: true
          schema:
            type: object
            properties: {gt: {type: integer}, gte: {type: integer},
                         lt: {type: integer}, lte: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [data,
                  has_more]
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice" }
                  has_more: { type: boolean }
components:
  schemas:
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amount, currency]
      properties:
        amount: { type: integer, description: "Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents)." }
        currency:
          type: string
          enum: [ EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN,
                  CZK, HUF ]
    Invoice:
      type: object
      required: [ id, customer, status, total, lines ]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, example: in_1NqZ8x2eZvKYlo2C }
        customer: { type: string }
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [draft, open, paid, uncollectible, void]
        total: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money' }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              description: { type: string, maxLength: 500 }
              quantity: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
              unit_amount: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money' }
              tax_rates: {
                type: array,
                items: { type: string },
                description: "IDs of tax rates applied to this line"
                }
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: { type: string }
          description: >-
            Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an invoice. This can be useful for
            storing additional information about the object in a structured format.

  - build
  - deploy

variables:
  DOCKER_DRIVER: overlay2
  DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs"
  PIP_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.cache/pip"
  IMAGE_TAG: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA
  GIT_DEPTH: "20"

default:
  image: python:3.12-slim
  interruptible: true
  cache:
    key:
      files: [ requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt ]
    paths:
      - .cache/pip
      - .venv/

.python-setup: &python-setup
  before_script:
    - python -m venv .venv
    - source .venv/bin/activate
    - pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

.only-mr-and-main:
  rules: &mr_and_main_rules
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
      when: never

lint:
  stage: lint
  <<: *python-setup
  script:
    - ruff check .
    - ruff format --check .
  rules: *mr_and_main_rules

unit-tests:
  stage: test
  <<: *python-setup
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
  variables:
    POSTGRES_DB: test
    POSTGRES_USER: test
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "test"
    DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://test:test@db:5432/test"
  script:
    - pytest --junitxml=report.xml --cov=app --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
  coverage: '/(?i)total.*? (100(?:\.0+)?\%|[1-9]?\d(?:\.\d+)?\%)$/'
  artifacts:
    when: always
    reports:
      junit: report.xml
      coverage_report:
        coverage_format: cobertura
        path: coverage.xml
    expire_in: 1 week
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - PYTHON_VERSION: ["3.11", "3.12"]
        DB: [ postgres ]

build-image:
  stage: build
  image: docker:27
  services: [ "docker:27-dind" ]
  script:
    - echo "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - docker build --pull --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 --cache-from "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" -t "$IMAGE_TAG" -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" .
    - docker push "$IMAGE_TAG"
    - |
      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" = "$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then
        docker push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest"
      fi
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG

deploy-production:
  stage: deploy
  image: bitnami/kubectl:1.31
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://shop.example.com
  script:
    - kubectl set image deployment/storefront app="$IMAGE_TAG" --namespace shop --record=false
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/storefront -n shop --timeout=300s
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/
      when: manual
  needs: ["build-image", unit-tests]

arguments.content:
version: 2.1

orbs:
  node: circleci/node@5.2.0
  aws-cli: circleci/aws-cli@4.1
  slack: circleci/slack@4.13.3

parameters:
  run-e2e:
    type: boolean
    default: false
  deploy-env:
    type: enum
    enum: ["staging", "production"]
    default: staging

executors:
  default:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/node:20.17
        auth:
          username: $DOCKERHUB_USER
          password: $DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD
    working_directory: ~/repo
    resource_class: medium+

commands:
  install-deps:
    description: "Install npm dependencies with caching keyed on the lockfile checksum"
    steps:
      - restore_cache:
          keys:
            - v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
            - v3-deps-
      - run: npm ci
      - save_cache:
          key: v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
          paths: [ node_modules ]

jobs:
  test:
    executor: default
    parallelism: 4
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run:
          name: Run unit tests (split by timings)
          command: |
            TESTFILES=$(circleci tests glob "src/**/*.test.ts" | circleci tests split --split-by=timings)
            npx jest --ci --runInBand --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit $TESTFILES
          environment:
            JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR: ./reports/junit/
      - store_test_results:
          path: ./reports/junit/
      - store_artifacts: { path: coverage, destination: coverage }

  e2e:
    docker:
      - image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.47.2-jammy
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run: npx playwright test --reporter=line,junit --workers=2 --retries=1 --project=chromium --project=firefox
      - store_artifacts:
          path: playwright-report

  deploy:
    executor: default
    parameters:
      env:
        type: string
    steps:
      - checkout
      - aws-cli/setup:
          role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/circleci-deploy
          region: eu-west-1
      - run:
          name: Deploy << parameters.env >>
          command: npm run deploy -- --env << parameters.env >> --confirm
      - slack/notify:
          event: fail
          template: basic_fail_1

workflows:
  build-test-deploy:
    jobs:
      - test
      - e2e:
          requires: [test]
          filters:
            branches:
              only: /^(main|release\/.*)$/
      - hold:
          type: approval
          requires:
            - test
          filters: { branches: { only: main } }
      - deploy:
          name: deploy-staging
          env: << pipeline.parameters.deploy-env >>
          requires: [ hold ]
          context:
            - aws-deploy
            - slack-secrets
  nightly:
    triggers:
      - schedule:
          cron: "0 4 * * 1-5"
          filters:
            branches:
              only:
                - main
    jobs: [test, e2e]

arguments.content:
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - releases/*
  paths:
    exclude: [ docs/*, README.md ]

pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  - group: shared-secrets
  - name: buildConfiguration
    value: 'Release'
  - name: dotnetVersion
    value: "8.0.x"

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: Build and test
  jobs:
  - job: build
    strategy:
      matrix:
        linux:
          imageName: 'ubuntu-latest'
        windows:
          imageName: "windows-latest"
    pool:
      vmImage: $(imageName)
    steps:
    - task: UseDotNet@2
      inputs:
        packageType: sdk
        version: $(dotnetVersion)
    - script: dotnet restore && dotnet build --configuration $(buildConfiguration) --no-restore /p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true /warnaserror
      displayName: 'dotnet build $(buildConfiguration)'
    - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
      displayName: Run tests
      inputs:
        command: test
        projects: '**/*Tests.csproj'
        arguments: '--configuration $(buildConfiguration) --collect "XPlat Code Coverage" --logger trx'
        publishTestResults: true
    - ${{ if eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main') }}:
      - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
        inputs:
          targetPath: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)'
          artifact: drop-$(Agent.OS)

- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
    - deployment: DeployWeb
      environment: 'production'
      strategy:
        runOnce:
          deploy:
            steps:
              - download: current
                artifact: drop-Linux
              - task: AzureWebApp@1
                inputs:
                  azureSubscription: 'acme-prod-service-connection'
                  appName: acme-storefront-prod
                  package: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop-Linux/**/*.zip

arguments.content:
# See https://pre-commit.com for more information
# See https://pre-commit.com/hooks.html for more hooks
default_language_version:
    python: python3.12
default_stages: [pre-commit, pre-push]
exclude: '^(docs/_build/|tests/fixtures/.*\.ya?ml$)'
fail_fast: false

ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: "style: auto fixes from pre-commit.com hooks"
  autoupdate_schedule: monthly
  skip: [mypy]

repos:
-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.6.0
    hooks:
    -   id: trailing-whitespace
        args: [--markdown-linebreak-ext=md]
    -   id: end-of-file-fixer
    -   id: check-yaml
        args: ['--allow-multiple-documents', "--unsafe"]
        exclude: ^charts/.*/templates/
    -   id: check-added-large-files
        args: ['--maxkb=500']
    -   id: check-merge-conflict
    -   id: mixed-line-ending
        args: [ --fix=lf ]

-   repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: "v0.6.9"
    hooks:
    -   id: ruff
        args: [ --fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix ]
    -   id: ruff-format

- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
  rev: v1.11.2
  hooks:
    - id: mypy
      additional_dependencies: [types-requests, "types-PyYAML", pydantic>=2.0]
      args: [--ignore-missing-imports, --no-warn-unused-ignores]

- repo: https://github.com/igorshubovych/markdownlint-cli
  rev: v0.42.0
  hooks:
  - id: markdownlint
    args: ["--fix", "--disable", "MD013", "MD033", "--"]

-   repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: check-changelog
        name: Check that CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change
        entry: python scripts/check_changelog.py
        language: python
        files: ^(src/|CHANGELOG\.md$)
        pass_filenames: false
        stages: [pre-push]
      - id: no-print
        name: "Disallow print() in library code"
        entry: '(?<!\w)print\('
        language: pygrep
        types: [python]
        exclude: ^(scripts|tests)/

# To get started with Dependabot version updates, you'll need to specify which
# package ecosystems to update and where the package manifests are located.
# Please see the documentation for all configuration options:
# https://docs.github.com/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/configuration-options-for-the-dependabot.yml-file

version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: "pip" # See documentation for possible values
    directory: "/"           # Location of package manifests
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: monday
      time: "06:00"
      timezone: Europe/Amsterdam
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    groups:
      dev-dependencies:
        dependency-type: "development"
        patterns: [ "pytest*", "ruff", "mypy", 'types-*' ]
      production:
        dependency-type: production
        update-types:
        - "minor"
        - "patch"
    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "numpy"
        versions: [ ">=3.0" ]
      - dependency-name: django
        update-types: ["version-update:semver-major"]
    labels: [dependencies, python]
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"
      prefix-development: "deps(dev)"
      include: scope

  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
        interval: monthly
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns: ["*"]

  - package-ecosystem: "docker"
    directory: "/docker"
    schedule: { interval: weekly }
    reviewers:
      - "acme/platform"

arguments.content:
service: image-thumbnailer
frameworkVersion: '3'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ${opt:region, 'eu-west-1'}
  memorySize: 1024
  timeout: 29
  logRetentionInDays: 14
  architecture: arm64
  environment:
    BUCKET_NAME: ${self:custom.bucketName}
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES: "128,256,512"
    STAGE: ${sls:stage}
    POWERTOOLS_SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:PutObject
          Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.bucketName}/*"
        - Effect: "Allow"
          Action: [ "sqs:SendMessage" ]
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt: [ ThumbnailQueue, Arn ]
  tags:
    team: media
    cost-center: "cc-1042"

custom:
  bucketName: acme-images-${sls:stage}
  esbuild:
    bundle: true
    minify: false
    sourcemap: true
    exclude: ['@aws-sdk/*']
  prune:
    automatic: true
    number: 3

functions:
  thumbnail:
    handler: src/handlers/thumbnail.handler
    description: Generates thumbnails for every image uploaded to the originals/ prefix and stores them under thumbnails/{size}/
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.bucketName}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          rules:
            - prefix: originals/
            - suffix: .jpg
          existing: true
  api:
    handler: src/handlers/api.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /images/{id}
          method: get
      - httpApi: 'POST /images'
  drain:
    handler: src/handlers/drain.handler
    reservedConcurrency: 2
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn:
            Fn::GetAtt:
              - ThumbnailQueue
              - Arn
          batchSize: 10
          maximumBatchingWindow: 5

resources:
  Resources:
    ThumbnailQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-thumbnails
        VisibilityTimeout: 180
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt ThumbnailDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 5
    ThumbnailDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
  Outputs:
    QueueUrl:
      Value: !Ref ThumbnailQueue
      Export:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-QueueUrl"

plugins:
  - serverless-esbuild
  - serverless-prune-plugin
  - serverless-offline

package:
  individually: true
  patterns:
    - '!node_modules/**'
    - '!.git/**'
    - src/**

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Network baseline: a VPC with two public and two private subnets spread across two
  Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, and one NAT Gateway per AZ.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: An environment name that is prefixed to resource names
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues: [ dev, staging, production ]
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for this VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.0.0/16
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.10.0/24
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.11.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.20.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.21.0/24

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals [ !Ref EnvironmentName, production ]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - { Key: Name, Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw" }

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 0, !GetAZs '' ]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName} Public Subnet (AZ1)

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 1, !GetAZs  "" ]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} Public Subnet (AZ2)'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsProduction
    Properties:
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt: [NatGateway1EIP, AllocationId]
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NoIngressSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Join [ "-", [ !Ref EnvironmentName, "no-ingress-sg" ] ]
      GroupDescription: "Security group with no ingress rule"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

Outputs:
  VPC:
    Description: A reference to the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCID"
  PublicSubnets:
    Description: A list of the public subnets
    Value: !Join [ ",", [ !Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2 ]]
  NatGatewayIds:
    Value: !If [ IsProduction, !Join [",", [!Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2]], !Ref NatGateway1 ]

arguments.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
    orders-api

    SAM template for the orders API (API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB).

Globals:
    Function:
        Timeout: 10
        MemorySize: 256
        Runtime: python3.12
        Architectures: [ arm64 ]
        Tracing: Active
        Environment:
            Variables:
                TABLE_NAME: !Ref OrdersTable
                POWERTOOLS_LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    Api:
        TracingEnabled: true
        Cors:
            AllowMethods: "'GET,POST,OPTIONS'"
            AllowHeaders: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
            AllowOrigin: "'*'"

Parameters:
    Stage:
        Type: String
        Default: dev
        AllowedValues:
            - dev
            - prod

Resources:
    OrdersFunction:
        Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
        Properties:
            CodeUri: orders/
            Handler: app.lambda_handler
            Policies:
                - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
                      TableName: !Ref OrdersTable
                - Statement:
                      - Effect: Allow
                        Action: [ 'events:PutEvents' ]
                        Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/default'
            Events:
                ListOrders:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties:
                        Path: /orders
                        Method: get
                CreateOrder:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties: { Path: /orders, Method: post }
                GetOrder:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties:
                        Path: /orders/{orderId}
                        Method: GET

    OrdersTable:
        Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
        DeletionPolicy: !If [IsProd, Retain, Delete]
        Properties:
            TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-orders-${Stage}"
            BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
            AttributeDefinitions:
                - AttributeName: pk
                  AttributeType: S
                - AttributeName: sk
                  AttributeType: S
            KeySchema:
                - { AttributeName: pk, KeyType: HASH }
                - { AttributeName: sk, KeyType: RANGE }
            PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
                PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [ IsProd, true, false ]

    OrdersAlarm:
        Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
        Properties:
            AlarmDescription: !Sub "Errors in ${OrdersFunction} exceeded the threshold of 5 per minute for 3 consecutive minutes; check the X-Ray traces and the function logs."
            Namespace: AWS/Lambda
            MetricName: Errors
            Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref OrdersFunction
            Statistic: Sum
            Period: 60
            EvaluationPeriods: 3
            Threshold: 5
            ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

Conditions:
    IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Stage, prod]

Outputs:
    OrdersApi:
        Description: "API Gateway endpoint URL for the Prod stage"
        Value: !Sub "https://${ServerlessRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/Prod/orders/"
    OrdersFunctionArn:
        Value: !GetAtt OrdersFunction.Arn
    OrdersFunctionRole:
        Value: !GetAtt [ OrdersFunctionRole, Arn ]

# my global config
global:
  scrape_interval:     15s # Set the scrape interval to every 15 seconds. Default is every 1 minute.
  evaluation_interval: 15s # Evaluate rules every 15 seconds. The default is every 1 minute.
  # scrape_timeout is set to the global default (10s).
  external_labels:
      cluster: 'eu-prod-1'
      replica: "A"

# Alertmanager configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
  - static_configs:
    - targets:
      - alertmanager:9093
      - 'alertmanager-2:9093'

# Load rules once and periodically evaluate them according to the global 'evaluation_interval'.
rule_files:
  - "rules/*.yml"
  - alerts/node.rules.yaml

scrape_configs:
  # The job name is added as a label `job=<job_name>` to any timeseries scraped from this config.
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
    - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  - job_name: node
    scrape_interval: 30s
    static_configs:
      - targets: [ 'node1:9100', "node2:9100", node3:9100 ]
        labels:
          env: prod
          role: worker

  - job_name: kubernetes-pods
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces:
          names: [shop, analytics]
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: true
      - source_labels: [ __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_path ]
        action: replace
        target_label: __metrics_path__
        regex: (.+)
      - source_labels: [__address__, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
        action: replace
        regex: ([^:]+)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
        replacement: $1:$2
        target_label: __address__
      - action: labelmap
        regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(.+)
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        action: replace
        target_label: namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: pod

  - job_name: blackbox-http
    metrics_path: /probe
    params:
      module: [http_2xx]
    static_configs:
      - targets:
        - https://shop.example.com
        - https://api.example.com/inventory/v1/healthz
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__address__]
        target_label: __param_target
      - source_labels: [__param_target]
        target_label: instance
      - target_label: __address__
        replacement: blackbox-exporter:9115

remote_write:
  - url: "https://prometheus-blocks-prod-eu-west-0.grafana.net/api/prom/push"
    basic_auth:
      username: "123456"
      password_file: /etc/prometheus/secrets/grafana-cloud-api-key
    write_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: "go_.*|process_.*"
        action: drop

arguments.content:
global:
  resolve_timeout: 5m
  smtp_smarthost: 'smtp.example.com:587'
  smtp_from: 'alertmanager@example.com'
  smtp_auth_username: "alertmanager"
  smtp_auth_password_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/smtp-password
  slack_api_url_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/slack-webhook

templates:
- '/etc/alertmanager/templates/*.tmpl'

route:
  receiver: team-ops-slack
  group_by: ['alertname', 'cluster', 'service']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - matchers:
        - severity="critical"
      receiver: pagerduty-critical
      continue: true
    - matchers: [ 'team =~ "storefront|checkout"' ]
      receiver: team-shop-slack
      routes:
      - matchers:
          - severity = "warning"
          - alertname != "Watchdog"
        receiver: team-shop-email
        group_wait: 2m
    - matchers:
        - alertname = Watchdog
      receiver: "null"
      repeat_interval: 1m

inhibit_rules:
  - source_matchers: [ severity="critical" ]
    target_matchers: [ severity="warning" ]
    # Apply inhibition if the alertname is the same.
    equal: [alertname, cluster, service]

receivers:
- name: "null"
- name: team-ops-slack
  slack_configs:
  - channel: '#ops-alerts'
    send_resolved: true
    title: '{{ template "slack.default.title" . }}'
    text: >-
      {{ range .Alerts }}
        *Alert:* {{ .Annotations.summary }} - `{{ .Labels.severity }}`
        *Description:* {{ .Annotations.description }}
        *Details:*
        {{ range .Labels.SortedPairs }} - *{{ .Name }}:* `{{ .Value }}`
        {{ end }}
      {{ end }}
- name: team-shop-slack
  slack_configs:
    - channel: "#shop-alerts"
      send_resolved: true
- name: team-shop-email
  email_configs:
    - to: 'shop-team@example.com'
      headers: { Subject: '[{{ .Status | toUpper }}] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}' }
- name: pagerduty-critical
  pagerduty_configs:
  - routing_key_file: /etc/alertmanager/secrets/pagerduty-key
    description: '{{ .CommonAnnotations.summary }}'
    severity: critical

arguments.content:
groups:
- name: node.rules
  interval: 1m
  rules:
  - alert: InstanceDown
    expr: up == 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
    annotations:
      summary: "Instance {{ $labels.instance }} down"
      description: "{{ $labels.instance }} of job {{ $labels.job }} has been down for more than 5 minutes."
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.example.com/node/instance-down

  - alert: HostOutOfMemory
    expr: (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes * 100 < 10) * on(instance) group_left (nodename) node_uname_info{nodename=~".+"}
    for: 2m
    labels: { severity: warning }
    annotations:
      summary: Host out of memory (instance {{ $labels.instance }})
      description: "Node memory is filling up (< 10% left)\n  VALUE = {{ $value }}\n  LABELS = {{ $labels }}"

  - alert: HostHighCpuLoad
    expr: |
      sum by (instance) (avg by (mode, instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[2m]))) > 0.8
      and on (instance)
      node_load5 > 4
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity:   warning
      team: infra
    annotations:
      summary: 'Host high CPU load (instance {{ $labels.instance }})'

- name: storefront.slo
  rules:
    - record: job:http_requests:rate5m
      expr: sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
    - record: job:http_errors:ratio_rate5m
      expr: >
        sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m]))
        /
        sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
    - alert: StorefrontErrorBudgetBurn
      expr: job:http_errors:ratio_rate5m{job="storefront"} > (14.4 * (1 - 0.999))
      for: 2m
      labels:
        severity: page
        slo: availability
      annotations:
        summary: Storefront is burning its error budget 14.4x faster than allowed
        description: >-
          The 5 minute error ratio for {{ $labels.job }} is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }},
          which would exhaust the monthly error budget in roughly two days if it continues.
          Check recent deploys first, then the database and payment provider dashboards.

arguments.content:
name: Bug report
description: File a bug report. Please search existing issues first to avoid creating duplicates, and fill in as much detail as you can.
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: ["bug", "triage"]
assignees:
  - octo-maintainer
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thanks for taking the time to fill out this bug report!

        **Before you start:** make sure you are on the [latest release](https://github.com/acme/widgets/releases/latest) and that the problem is reproducible with a minimal configuration.
  - type: input
    id: contact
    attributes:
      label: Contact details
      description: How can we get in touch with you if we need more info?
      placeholder: ex. email@example.com
    validations:
      required: false
  - type: textarea
    id: what-happened
    attributes:
      label: What happened?
      description: Also tell us, what did you expect to happen?
      placeholder: Tell us what you see!
      value: "A bug happened!"
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: version
    attributes:
      label: Version
      description: What version of our software are you running?
      options:
        - 2.14.x (latest)
        - 2.13.x
        - "2.12.x or older"
      default: 0
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: browsers
    attributes:
      label: What browsers are you seeing the problem on?
      multiple: true
      options: [ Firefox, Chrome, Safari, "Microsoft Edge", Other ]
  - type: textarea
    id: logs
    attributes:
      label: Relevant log output
      description: Please copy and paste any relevant log output. This will be automatically formatted into code, so no need for backticks.
      render: shell
  - type: checkboxes
    id: terms
    attributes:
      label: Code of Conduct
      description: By submitting this issue, you agree to follow our [Code of Conduct](https://example.com/coc).
      options:
        - label: I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
          required: true

cd /tmp && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
base = pathlib.Path("/tmp/corpus/yaml")
# (file, exact line, trailing whitespace to append); first match only
edits = [
    ("gha-ci.yml", "        runs-on: ubuntu-latest", "   "),
    ("gha-ci.yml", "      - name: Install package", " "),
    ("gha-release.yaml", "permissions:", "  "),
    ("gha-release.yaml", "          gh release create \"$TAG\" dist/* \\", ""),
    ("docker-compose.yml", "    image: \"ghcr.io/acme/storefront:latest\"", "  "),
    ("docker-compose.yml", "  worker:", " "),
    ("k8s-app.yaml", "  replicas: 3", "    "),
    ("k8s-configmap.yaml", "    spring.jpa.open-in-view=false", "  "),
    ("helm-values.yaml", "replicaCount: 1", "  "),
    ("helm-values.yaml", "  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.", " "),
    ("ansible-site.yml", "  become: yes", "  "),
    ("ansible-site.yml", "    - name: Update apt cache if needed", "   "),
    ("openapi.yaml", "      summary: List items", " "),
    ("openapi.yaml", "    The Inventory Service exposes stock levels, reservations and warehouse metadata for all ACME sales channels.", "  "),
    ("mkdocs.yml", "site_name: Widgets Documentation", "  "),
    ("mkdocs.yml", "    - navigation.tabs", " "),
    ("gitlab-ci.yml", "  stage: lint", "  "),
    ("gitlab-ci.yml", "    - ruff check .", "   "),
    ("locales-en.yml", "      empty: \"Your cart is empty.\"", " "),
    ("_config.yml", "markdown: kramdown", "    "),
    ("prometheus.yml", "  - job_name: node", "  "),
    ("pre-commit-config.yaml", "    rev: v4.6.0", " "),
    ("Chart.yaml", "type: application", "   "),
    ("cloudformation-vpc.yaml", "  VPC:", " "),
    ("circleci-config.yml", "      - run: npm ci", "  "),
    ("hugo.yaml", "paginate: 10", " "),
    ("_quarto.yml", "    toc: true", "  "),
    ("alertmanager.yml", "  group_wait: 30s", " "),
]
# replace a blank line (first blank line after the given anchor line) with whitespace-only line
blank_after = [
    ("gha-ci.yml", "                  --strict", "    "),
    ("codecov.yml", "  require_head: yes", "  "),
    ("serverless.yml", "    number: 3", "  "),
    ("azure-pipelines.yml", "    value: \"8.0.x\"", " "),
    ("k8s-cronjob.yml", "  failedJobsHistoryLimit:     5", None),
]
for f, line, ws in edits:
    p = base / f
    lines = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    idx = lines.index(line)
    lines[idx] = line + ws
    p.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
for f, anchor, ws in blank_after:
    if ws is None:
        continue
    p = base / f
    lines = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    i = lines.index(anchor)
    j = next(k for k in range(i + 1, len(lines)) if lines[k] == "")
    lines[j] = ws
    p.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("done")
EOF
