arguments.content:
name: observability

x-logging:
      &default-logging
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "1m"
        max-file: "1"
        tag: "{{.Name}}"

services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0
    command:
      - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
      - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - --web.external-url=https://prometheus.example.com/
    configs:
      - source: prometheus_config
        target: /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    volumes:
      - prometheus-data:/prometheus
      - ./prometheus/rules:/etc/prometheus/rules:ro
    ports: [ "9090:9090" ]
    logging: *default-logging
    restart: unless-stopped

  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.27.0
    command: [ "--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml", "--storage.path=/alertmanager" ]
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager:/etc/alertmanager:ro
      - alertmanager-data:/alertmanager
    ports:
      - 9093:9093
    logging: *default-logging

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:11.1.0
    depends_on: [prometheus,loki]
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD__FILE=/run/secrets/grafana_admin_password
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - "GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.example.com"
      - GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS=grafana-piechart-panel,grafana-clock-panel
    secrets:
      - grafana_admin_password
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    healthcheck:
      test: wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
    logging: *default-logging

  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3.1.0
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml
    ports: ["3100:3100"]
    logging: *default-logging

  promtail:
    image: grafana/promtail:3.1.0
    volumes:
      - /var/log:/var/log:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      - ./promtail/config.yml:/etc/promtail/config.yml:ro
    command: -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml
    profiles: [ logs ]

  node-exporter:
    image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.1
    command:
      - '--path.rootfs=/host'
      - '--collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(sys|proc|dev|host|etc)($$|/)'
    pid: host
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - '/:/host:ro,rslave'
    profiles:
      - host-metrics

  cadvisor:
    image: gcr.io/cadvisor/cadvisor:v0.49.1
    privileged: true
    devices:
      - /dev/kmsg
    volumes:
      - /:/rootfs:ro
      - /var/run:/var/run:ro
      - /sys:/sys:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/:/var/lib/docker:ro
    profiles:
      - host-metrics

configs:
  prometheus_config:
    file: ./prometheus/prometheus.yml

secrets:
  grafana_admin_password:
    file: ./secrets/grafana_admin_password.txt

volumes:
  prometheus-data: {}
  alertmanager-data: {}
  grafana-data: { }

arguments.content:
# Swarm stack for the "Atlas" booking platform
# deploy with:  docker stack deploy -c docker-compose.yml --with-registry-auth atlas
version: '3.8'

x-default-deploy: &default-deploy
  restart_policy:
    condition: on-failure
    delay: 5s
    max_attempts: 3
    window: 120s
  update_config:
    parallelism: 1
    delay: 10s
    order: start-first
    failure_action: rollback
  rollback_config:
    parallelism: 0
    order: stop-first

x-service-env: &service-env
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: http://otel-collector:4317
  OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES: deployment.environment=production,service.namespace=atlas
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  LOG_FORMAT: json

x-healthcheck: &http-healthcheck
  interval: 20s
  timeout: 3s
  retries: 3
  start_period: 30s

services:

  gateway:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-registry.atlas.internal}/atlas/gateway:${GATEWAY_VERSION:-1.12.0}
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: 443
        protocol: tcp
        mode: ingress
    environment:
      <<: *service-env
      UPSTREAM_BOOKINGS: http://bookings:8080
      UPSTREAM_INVENTORY: http://inventory:8080
      UPSTREAM_PAYMENTS: http://payments:8080
      RATE_LIMIT_RPS: 200
    configs:
      - source: gateway_routes
        target: /etc/gateway/routes.yaml
        mode: 0444
    secrets:
      - source: tls_cert
        target: /run/secrets/tls.crt
      - source: tls_key
        target: /run/secrets/tls.key
    healthcheck:
      <<: *http-healthcheck
      test: ["CMD", "/gateway", "healthcheck"]
    deploy:
      <<: *default-deploy
      replicas: 3
      resources:
        limits: {cpus: "0.50", memory: 256M}
        reservations: {cpus: "0.10",  memory: 64M}
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.role == worker
          - node.labels.zone != dmz
        preferences:
          - spread: node.labels.zone
    networks: [edge, services]

  bookings:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-registry.atlas.internal}/atlas/bookings:${BOOKINGS_VERSION:-3.4.1}
    env_file:
      - ./env/common.env
      - ./env/bookings.env
    environment:
      <<: *service-env
      DB_HOST: bookings-db
      DB_NAME: bookings
      DB_USER: bookings
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/bookings_db_password
    secrets: [ bookings_db_password ]
    command: >
      java
      -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0
      -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError
      -Djava.security.egd=file:/dev/./urandom
      -Dspring.profiles.active=prod,swarm
      -jar /app/bookings.jar
      --server.shutdown=graceful
      --spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase=25s
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    healthcheck:
      <<: *http-healthcheck
      test: curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/actuator/health/readiness || exit 1
    deploy:
      <<: *default-deploy
      replicas: 4
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '2'
          memory: 1536M
    networks:
      - services
      - data@@T3@@

  inventory:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-registry.atlas.internal}/atlas/inventory:${INVENTORY_VERSION:-2.0.7}
    environment:
      <<: *service-env
      REDIS_ADDR: inventory-cache:6379
      CACHE_TTL: 5m
    deploy:
      <<: *default-deploy
      replicas: 2
    networks: [services, data]

  payments:
    image: ${REGISTRY:-registry.atlas.internal}/atlas/payments:${PAYMENTS_VERSION:-5.1.0}
    environment:
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://otel-collector:4317
      - LOG_LEVEL=warn
      - PSP_API_URL=https://api.psp.example.com/v3
      - PSP_API_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/psp_api_key
      - PSP_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/psp_webhook_secret
    secrets:
      - psp_api_key
      - psp_webhook_secret
    deploy:
      <<: *default-deploy
      replicas: 2
      placement:
        constraints: [ "node.labels.pci == true" ]
    networks:
      - services

  bookings-db:
    image: postgres:16.3
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: bookings
      POSTGRES_USER: bookings
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/bookings_db_password
    secrets: [bookings_db_password]
    volumes:
      - bookings-db:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      placement:
        constraints:
          - node.labels.storage == ssd
    networks: [ data ]

  inventory-cache:
    image: redis:7.2
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no", "--maxmemory", "512mb"]
    networks: [data]

  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.104.0
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    configs:
      - source: otel_config
        target: /etc/otelcol/config.yaml
    deploy:
      mode: global
    networks: [services]

configs:
  gateway_routes:
    file: ./config/gateway/routes.yaml
  otel_config:
    file: ./config/otel/config.yaml

secrets:
  tls_cert:
    external: true
  tls_key:
    external: true
  bookings_db_password:
    external: true
    name: atlas_bookings_db_password_v2
  psp_api_key:
    external: true
  psp_webhook_secret:
    external: true

networks:
  edge:
    driver: overlay
  services:
    driver: overlay
    attachable: true
  data:
    driver: overlay
    internal: true
    driver_opts:
      encrypted: "true"

volumes:
  bookings-db:
    driver: local

arguments.content:
---
# Airflow for the analytics team (CeleryExecutor).  Based on the upstream
# docker-compose.yaml, trimmed down and with our own defaults.
x-airflow-common:
  &airflow-common
  image: ${AIRFLOW_IMAGE_NAME:-registry.analytics.example.com/airflow:2.9.3-py3.11}
  # build: .
  environment:
    &airflow-common-env
    AIRFLOW__CORE__EXECUTOR: CeleryExecutor
    AIRFLOW__DATABASE__SQL_ALCHEMY_CONN: postgresql+psycopg2://airflow:airflow@postgres/airflow
    AIRFLOW__CELERY__RESULT_BACKEND: db+postgresql://airflow:airflow@postgres/airflow
    AIRFLOW__CELERY__BROKER_URL: redis://:@redis:6379/0
    AIRFLOW__CORE__FERNET_KEY: ''
    AIRFLOW__CORE__DAGS_ARE_PAUSED_AT_CREATION: 'true'
    AIRFLOW__CORE__LOAD_EXAMPLES: "false"
    AIRFLOW__API__AUTH_BACKENDS: 'airflow.api.auth.backend.basic_auth,airflow.api.auth.backend.session'
    AIRFLOW__SCHEDULER__ENABLE_HEALTH_CHECK: 'true'
    AIRFLOW__WEBSERVER__BASE_URL: https://airflow.analytics.example.com
    _PIP_ADDITIONAL_REQUIREMENTS: ${_PIP_ADDITIONAL_REQUIREMENTS:-}
  volumes:
    - ${AIRFLOW_PROJ_DIR:-.}/dags:/opt/airflow/dags
    - ${AIRFLOW_PROJ_DIR:-.}/logs:/opt/airflow/logs
    - ${AIRFLOW_PROJ_DIR:-.}/config:/opt/airflow/config
    - ${AIRFLOW_PROJ_DIR:-.}/plugins:/opt/airflow/plugins
  user: "${AIRFLOW_UID:-50000}:0"
  depends_on:
    &airflow-common-depends-on
    redis:
      condition: service_healthy
    postgres:
      condition: service_healthy

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:13
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: airflow
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: airflow
      POSTGRES_DB: airflow
    volumes:
      - postgres-db-volume:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "airflow"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s
    restart: always

  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-bookworm
    expose:
      - 6379
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD" ,"redis-cli", "ping" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 30s
      retries: 50
      start_period: 30s
    restart: always

  airflow-webserver:
    <<: *airflow-common
    command: webserver
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      <<: *airflow-common-depends-on
      airflow-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  airflow-scheduler:
    <<: *airflow-common
    command: scheduler
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "http://localhost:8974/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      <<: *airflow-common-depends-on
      airflow-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  airflow-worker:
    <<: *airflow-common
    command: celery worker
    healthcheck:
      # yamllint disable rule:line-length
      test:
        - "CMD-SHELL"
        - 'celery --app airflow.providers.celery.executors.celery_executor.app inspect ping -d "celery@$${HOSTNAME}" || celery --app airflow.executors.celery_executor.app inspect ping -d "celery@$${HOSTNAME}"'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    environment:
      <<: *airflow-common-env
      # Required to handle warm shutdown of the celery workers properly
      # See https://airflow.apache.org/docs/docker-stack/entrypoint.html#signal-propagation
      DUMB_INIT_SETSID: "0"
    restart: always
    deploy:
      replicas: 2
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4G
    depends_on:
      <<: *airflow-common-depends-on
      airflow-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  airflow-triggerer:
    <<: *airflow-common
    command: triggerer
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", 'airflow jobs check --job-type TriggererJob --hostname "$${HOSTNAME}"']
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: always@@T1@@

  airflow-init:
    <<: *airflow-common
    entrypoint: /bin/bash
    command:
      - -c
      - |
        if [[ -z "${AIRFLOW_UID}" ]]; then
          echo
          echo -e "\033[1;33mWARNING!!!: AIRFLOW_UID not set!\e[0m"
          echo "If you are on Linux, you SHOULD follow the instructions below to set "
          echo "AIRFLOW_UID environment variable, otherwise files will be owned by root."
          echo
        fi
        mkdir -p /sources/logs /sources/dags /sources/plugins
        chown -R "${AIRFLOW_UID}:0" /sources/{logs,dags,plugins}
        exec /entrypoint airflow version
    environment:
      <<: *airflow-common-env
      _AIRFLOW_DB_MIGRATE: 'true'
      _AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_CREATE: 'true'
      _AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_USERNAME: ${_AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_USERNAME:-airflow}
      _AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_PASSWORD: ${_AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_PASSWORD:-airflow}
      _PIP_ADDITIONAL_REQUIREMENTS: ''
    user: "0:0"
    volumes:
      - ${AIRFLOW_PROJ_DIR:-.}:/sources

  flower:
    <<: *airflow-common
    command: celery flower
    profiles:
      - flower
    ports:
      - "5555:5555"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "http://localhost:5555/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: always

volumes:
  postgres-db-volume:

arguments.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '**.md'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - pyproject.toml
      - .github/workflows/ci.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: 1
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install ruff mypy
      - name: Ruff
        run: ruff check --output-format=github .
      - name : Mypy
        run: mypy src/

  test:
    needs: lint
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.10"
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.12"
            coverage: true
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            python-version: "3.8"
            experimental: true
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: |
            requirements/*.txt
            pyproject.toml
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[test]"
      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest -n auto --junitxml=junit/test-results-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml ${{ matrix.coverage && '--cov=src --cov-report=xml' || '' }}
      - name: Upload coverage
        if: ${{ matrix.coverage }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false@@T2@@
      - name: Publish test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: junit-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: junit/*.xml


  integration:
    needs: [lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'run-integration')
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: test_db
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports: ['6379:6379']
    env:

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '**.md'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - pyproject.toml
      - .github/workflows/ci.yml

  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: 1
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install ruff mypy
      - name: Ruff
        run: ruff check --output-format=github .
      - name : Mypy
        run: mypy src/

  test:
    needs: lint
    name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.10"
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.12"
            coverage: true
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            python-version: "3.8"
            experimental: true
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: |
            requirements/*.txt
            pyproject.toml
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[test]"

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release (e.g. 1.4.0), without the leading v'
        required: true
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: "Build everything but don't publish"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      channel:
        description: Release channel
        type: choice
        options:
          - stable
          - beta
          - nightly
        default: stable

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  packages: write

env:
  GO_VERSION: '1.23'
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      prerelease: ${{ steps.version.outputs.prerelease }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
          else
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          fi
          if [[ "$VERSION" == *-* ]]; then
            echo "prerelease=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "prerelease=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Releasing **$VERSION**" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  build:
    needs: prepare
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - { goos: linux,   goarch: amd64, runner: ubuntu-latest }
          - { goos: linux,   goarch: arm64, runner: ubuntu-latest }
          - { goos: darwin,  goarch: arm64, runner: macos-14 }
          - { goos: windows, goarch: amd64, runner: windows-latest, ext: .exe }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
      - name: Build
        shell: bash
        env:
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          go build -trimpath \
            -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION} -X main.commit=${GITHUB_SHA::7}" \
            -o "dist/tern-${VERSION}-${GOOS}-${GOARCH}${{ matrix.ext }}" ./cmd/tern
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tern-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 5

  publish:
    needs: [prepare, build]
    if: ${{ !inputs.dry_run }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: release
      url: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Checksums
        run: cd dist && sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS
      - name: Install cosign
        uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3
      - run: cosign sign-blob --yes --output-signature dist/SHA256SUMS.sig dist/SHA256SUMS
      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
          prerelease: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.prerelease == 'true' || inputs.channel != 'stable' }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            dist/*
          fail_on_unmatched_files: true

  homebrew:
    needs: [prepare, publish]
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.prerelease == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Bump Homebrew formula
        uses: mislav/bump-homebrew-formula-action@v3
        with:
          formula-name: tern
          homebrew-tap: tern-cli/homebrew-tap
          tag-name: v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
        env:
          COMMITTER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}

name: "Nightly: dependency audit & data refresh"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'      # every night at 03:17 UTC
    - cron:  "0 12 * * 1"     # plus Monday noon
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  group: nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
    NODE_VERSION: 20
    DATA_BUCKET: s3://example-open-data/snapshots
    SLACK_CHANNEL: "#eng-alerts"

jobs:
  audit:
    if: github.repository == 'example-org/atlas-web'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: npm audit
        id: audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev
      - name: Open issue on failure
        if: steps.audit.outcome == 'failure' && github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `npm audit found vulnerabilities (${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)})`;
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              labels: ['security', 'dependencies'],
              body: `See ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
            });

  refresh-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-nightly-refresh
          aws-region: eu-west-1
      - name: Download latest snapshot
        run: aws s3 cp "${DATA_BUCKET}/latest.parquet" data/latest.parquet --only-show-errors
      - run: npm ci && npm run build:data@@T3@@
      - name: Commit if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name  "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet -- public/data; then
            echo "No data changes."
            exit 0
          fi
          git add public/data
          git commit -m "chore(data): nightly refresh $(date -u +%F)"
          git push
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: ${{ env.SLACK_CHANNEL }}
          slack-message: "Nightly data refresh failed: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

arguments.content:
name: docker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ 'main' ]

env:
  REGISTRY_IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/image-resizer

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform == 'linux/arm64' && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform:
          - linux/amd64
          - linux/arm64
    steps:
      - name: Prepare
        run: |
          platform=${{ matrix.platform }}
          echo "PLATFORM_PAIR=${platform//\//-}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Docker meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}

      - name: Login to GHCR
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push by digest
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
            BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}

      - name: Export digest
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/digests
          digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          touch "/tmp/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

      - name: Upload digest
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: digests-${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          path: /tmp/digests/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - build
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    permissions:
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Download digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/digests
          pattern: digests-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Docker meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha,format=short
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Create manifest list and push
        working-directory: /tmp/digests
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create $(jq -cr '.tags | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< "$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON") \
            $(printf '${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}@sha256:%s ' *)
      - name: Inspect image
        run: docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}

        with:
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}
            BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}

      - name: Export digest
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/digests
          digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          touch "/tmp/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

      - name: Upload digest
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: digests-${{ env.PLATFORM_PAIR }}
          path: /tmp/digests/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - build
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    permissions:
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Download digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/digests
          pattern: digests-*
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Docker meta
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=sha,format=short
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Create manifest list and push
        working-directory: /tmp/digests
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create $(jq -cr '.tags | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< "$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON") \
            $(printf '${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}@sha256:%s ' *)
      - name: Inspect image
        run: docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY_IMAGE }}:${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}

arguments.content:
name: monorepo-ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      deploy_target:
        description: Where to deploy after a successful build
        type: environment
        required: false
      force_all:
        description: 'Ignore path filters and run every job'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  TURBO_TEAM: ${{ vars.TURBO_TEAM }}
  TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  PNPM_VERSION: 9.12.1
  GO_VERSION: "1.23.2"

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    outputs:
      web: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web == 'true' || inputs.force_all }}
      api: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.api == 'true' || inputs.force_all }}
      infra: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.infra }}
      docs: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            web:
              - 'apps/web/**'
              - 'packages/ui/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            api:
              - 'services/api/**'
              - 'go.work'
              - 'go.work.sum'
            infra:
              - 'infra/**'
            docs:
              - 'docs/**'
              - '*.md'

  web:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test build --filter=web...
      - name: Upload build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: web-dist
          path: apps/web/dist

  api:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgis/postgis:16-3.4
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres" --health-interval 5s --health-retries 10
    strategy:
      matrix:
        package: [ ./services/api/..., ./libs/geo/... ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
          cache-dependency-path: |
            services/api/go.sum
            libs/geo/go.sum
      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.61
          working-directory: services/api
          args: --timeout=5m
      - name: Test
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:test@localhost:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable
        run: go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic ${{ matrix.package }}
      - name: Build image
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          docker build \
            --build-arg GIT_SHA=${{ github.sha }} \
            -t ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/api:${{ github.sha }} \
            -f services/api/Dockerfile .

  terraform:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.infra == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: infra/envs/staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.9.7
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
      - id: plan
        run: terraform plan -no-color -input=false -out=tfplan
        continue-on-error: true
      - uses: actions/github-script@v7
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          PLAN: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.stdout }}
        with:
          script: |
            const body = `#### Terraform plan \`${{ steps.plan.outcome }}\`

            <details><summary>Show plan</summary>

            \`\`\`hcl
            ${process.env.PLAN}
            \`\`\`

            </details>`;
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body
            })
      - if: steps.plan.outcome == 'failure'
        run: exit 1

  deploy:
    needs: [changes, web, api]
    if: |
      always() &&
      !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') &&
      !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') &&
      (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || inputs.deploy_target != '')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: ${{ inputs.deploy_target || 'staging' }}
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
        with:
          name: web-dist
          path: dist
      - id: deploy
        name: Deploy
        run: |
          echo "Deploying ${{ github.sha }} to ${{ inputs.deploy_target || 'staging' }}"
          ./scripts/deploy.sh --env "${{ inputs.deploy_target || 'staging' }}" --sha "${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "url=https://${{ inputs.deploy_target || 'staging' }}.example.dev" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: bookstore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: bookstore
    istio-injection: "enabled"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: catalog-config
  namespace: bookstore
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: "300"
  application.yaml: |
    server:
      port: 8080
      shutdown: graceful
    spring:
      datasource:
        url: jdbc:postgresql://catalog-db.bookstore.svc.cluster.local:5432/catalog
        hikari:
          maximum-pool-size: 20
    management:
      endpoints:
        web:
          exposure:
            include: health,info,prometheus
  logback.xml: |-
    <configuration>
      <appender name="JSON" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
        <encoder class="net.logstash.logback.encoder.LogstashEncoder"/>
      </appender>
      <root level="${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}">
        <appender-ref ref="JSON"/>
      </root>
    </configuration>
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalog
  namespace: bookstore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: catalog
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "4.2.0"
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  annotations:
    deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "12"
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "Upgrade catalog to 4.2.0 (adds ISBN-13 validation and the new /v2/search endpoint backed by OpenSearch)"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: catalog
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: catalog
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "4.2.0"
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'
        prometheus.io/port: '8080'
        prometheus.io/path: /actuator/prometheus
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: catalog
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
      - name: catalog
        image: ghcr.io/bookstore/catalog:4.2.0
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION
          value: /config/application.yaml
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: catalog-db
              key: password
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name }
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: catalog-config
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}
          limits:
            memory: 1Gi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/readiness
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet: {path: /actuator/health/liveness, port: http}
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
          failureThreshold: 3
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config
          mountPath: /config
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp@@T2@@
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: catalog-config
          items:
          - key: application.yaml
            path: application.yaml
          - key: logback.xml
            path: logback.xml
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalog
  namespace: bookstore
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: catalog
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: catalog
  namespace: bookstore
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: 8m
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      more_set_headers "X-Frame-Options: DENY";

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
    name: search-api
    namespace: search

spec:
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: search-api
    template:
        metadata:
            labels:
                app: search-api
                tier: backend
        spec:
            topologySpreadConstraints:
              - maxSkew: 1
                topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
                whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
                labelSelector:
                    matchLabels: {app: search-api}
            terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
            containers:
              - name: api
                image: "registry.example.net/discovery/search-api:2024.10.3"
                args: ["--port=8080", "--index=products-v7", '--replicas-hint=$(REPLICAS_HINT)']
                ports:
                  - containerPort: 8080
                    name: http
                  - containerPort: 9090
                    name: metrics
                env:
                  - name: REPLICAS_HINT
                    value: "6"
                  - name: OPENSEARCH_URL
                    value: https://opensearch.search.svc:9200
                  - name: GOMAXPROCS
                    valueFrom:
                      resourceFieldRef:
                        resource: limits.cpu
                        divisor: "1"
                resources:
                    requests:
                        cpu: "500m"
                        memory: "512Mi"
                    limits:
                        cpu: "2"
                        memory: 1Gi
                startupProbe:
                    httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: http }
                    failureThreshold: 30
                    periodSeconds: 2
                readinessProbe:
                    httpGet: { path: /readyz, port: http }
                    periodSeconds: 5@@T3@@
                lifecycle:
                    preStop:
                        exec:
                            command: ["sleep", "10"]

  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 40
  metrics:
  - type: Resource

      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization

  - type: Pods

        type: AverageValue

      - type: Pods
        value: 6
        periodSeconds: 30

metadata:
  name: search-api
  namespace: search
spec:
  maxUnavailable: "25%"
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: search-api
  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: chat-prod
  labels:
    kubernetes.io/metadata.name: chat-prod
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: latest
  annotations:
    owner: "team-messaging@example.com"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: chat-api-secrets
  namespace: chat-prod
type: Opaque
data:
  JWT_SIGNING_KEY: ZXhhbXBsZS1zaWduaW5nLWtleS1ub3QtcmVhbA==
  DATABASE_URL: cG9zdGdyZXM6Ly9jaGF0OnNlY3JldEBjaGF0LWRiOjU0MzIvY2hhdA==
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: chat-api
  namespace: chat-prod
data:
  NODE_ENV: production
  WS_PING_INTERVAL_MS: "25000"
  FEATURE_FLAGS: "reactions,threads,typing-indicators"
  rate-limits.json: |
    {
      "messages": { "perMinute": 60, "burst": 20 },
      "uploads":  { "perMinute": 10, "burst": 3 },
      "search":   { "perMinute": 30, "burst": 10 }
    }
  nginx-sidecar.conf: |
    upstream app { server 127.0.0.1:3000; keepalive 32; }

    map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade {
      default upgrade;
      ''      close;
    }

    server {
      listen 8080;
      location /ws {
        proxy_pass http://app;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
      }
      location / {
        proxy_pass http://app;
      }
    }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: chat-api
  namespace: chat-prod
  labels: &labels
    app.kubernetes.io/name: chat-api
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: chat-api-prod
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: *labels
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *labels
      annotations:
        checksum/config: 9f2d7c1b5e3a8f60d4c2b1a0e9f8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b9a8f7e6d5c4b3a2f1e0
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      initContainers:
        - name: migrate
          image: ghcr.io/example/chat-api:3.17.2
          command: ["node", "dist/migrate.js", "--to", "latest"]
          envFrom:
            - secretRef: {name: chat-api-secrets}
          securityContext: &restricted
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: ghcr.io/example/chat-api:3.17.2
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: chat-api
            - secretRef:
                name: chat-api-secrets
          env:
            - {name: PORT, value: "3000"}
            - name: NODE_OPTIONS
              value: "--max-old-space-size=768 --enable-source-maps"
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 200m, memory: 512Mi }
            limits:   { memory: 1Gi }
          securityContext: *restricted
          volumeMounts:
            - { name: config, mountPath: /etc/chat/rate-limits.json, subPath: rate-limits.json }
            - { name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp }
        - name: nginx
          image: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
          securityContext: *restricted
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: nginx-sidecar.conf
            - name: nginx-cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: chat-api
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: nginx-cache
          emptyDir:

# Minimal in-cluster Prometheus for the "edge" clusters (no operator).
# Apply with: kubectl apply -f prometheus.yaml
--- # ServiceAccount + RBAC
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: monitoring
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: prometheus-edge
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [nodes, nodes/metrics, services, endpoints, pods]
    verbs: [get, list, watch]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: [configmaps]
    verbs: ["get"]
  - nonResourceURLs: ["/metrics", "/metrics/cadvisor"]
    verbs: ["get"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: prometheus-edge
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: prometheus-edge
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: prometheus
  namespace: monitoring
--- # configuration
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: prometheus-config
  namespace: monitoring
data:
  prometheus.yml: |
    global:
      scrape_interval: 30s
      evaluation_interval: 30s
      external_labels:
        cluster: edge-ams-1
    remote_write:
      - url: https://metrics.example.com/api/v1/write
        basic_auth:
          username: edge-ams-1
          password_file: /etc/prometheus/secrets/remote-write-password
    scrape_configs:
      - job_name: kubernetes-nodes
        scheme: https
        tls_config:
          ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
        bearer_token_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
        kubernetes_sd_configs:
          - role: node
      - job_name: kubernetes-pods
        kubernetes_sd_configs:
          - role: pod
        relabel_configs:
          - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
            action: keep
            regex: "true"
          - source_labels: [__address__, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
            action: replace
            regex: ([^:]+)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
            replacement: $1:$2
            target_label: __address__
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: monitoring
  labels: {app: prometheus}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy: { type: Recreate }
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: prometheus}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: prometheus}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: prometheus
      containers:
      - name: prometheus
        image: quay.io/prometheus/prometheus:v2.54.1
        args:
        - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
        - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
        - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=2d
        - --web.enable-lifecycle
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9090
          name: web
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 400Mi}
          limits: {memory: 2Gi}
        volumeMounts:
        - {name: config, mountPath: /etc/prometheus}
        - {name: data, mountPath: /prometheus}
        - name: remote-write
          mountPath: /etc/prometheus/secrets
          readOnly: true
      - name: config-reloader
        image: ghcr.io/jimmidyson/configmap-reload:v0.13.1
        args: ["--volume-dir=/etc/prometheus", "--webhook-url=http://127.0.0.1:9090/-/reload"]
        volumeMounts:
        - {name: config, mountPath: /etc/prometheus, readOnly: true}
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap: {name: prometheus-config}
      - name: data
        emptyDir: {sizeLimit: 8Gi}
      - name: remote-write
        secret:
          secretName: prometheus-remote-write
--- # expose inside the cluster only
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: monitoring
  annotations:
    description: "In-cluster Prometheus for edge clusters. Scraped by nothing; data is shipped to the central Mimir via remote_write. Access with kubectl port-forward svc/prometheus 9090:80 -n monitoring."
spec:
  selector: {app: prometheus}
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: web

theme:

    - toc.integrate

      toggle:
        icon: material/weather-night
        name: Dark mode
    - scheme: slate
      primary: indigo
      toggle:
        icon: material/weather-sunny
        name: Light mode

            show_bases: true
            show_if_no_docstring: false
            show_root_heading: true
            show_root_full_path: false
            show_signature_annotations: true
            show_source: false
            show_symbol_type_heading: true
            show_symbol_type_toc: true
            signature_crossrefs: true

  - pymdownx.snippets:
      check_paths: true

  - pymdownx.tabbed:
      alternate_style: true

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Vetcare Appointments API
  version: "2.3.0"
  description: |
    The Vetcare Appointments API lets partner clinics manage patients (pets), owners and appointments.

    ## Authentication
    All endpoints except `GET /health` require an OAuth 2.0 access token obtained with the client credentials flow. Tokens are valid for one hour; request a new one when you receive a `401` response rather than refreshing proactively.

    ## Rate limits
    Each client is limited to **600 requests per minute**. When the limit is exceeded the API responds with `429 Too Many Requests` and a `Retry-After` header.
  termsOfService: https://vetcare.example.com/terms
  contact:
    name: Vetcare API support
    email: api-support@vetcare.example.com
    url: https://developer.vetcare.example.com
  license:
    name: Proprietary
servers:
  - url: https://api.vetcare.example.com/v2
    description: Production
  - url: https://sandbox.api.vetcare.example.com/v2
    description: Sandbox (data is reset nightly)
tags:
  - name: pets
    description: Patients
  - name: appointments
    description: Booking, rescheduling and cancelling appointments
security:
  - oauth2: ['appointments:read', 'appointments:write']
paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      tags: [pets]
      summary: List pets
      operationId: listPets
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit'
        - name: species
          in: query
          description: Filter by species.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [dog, cat, rabbit, bird, reptile, other]
        - name: owner_id
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A page of pets.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [data, next_cursor]
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
                  next_cursor:
                    type: string
                    nullable: true
        "401":
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
    post:
      tags: [ pets ]
      summary: Register a pet
      operationId: createPet
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'
            example:
              name: Biscuit
              species: dog
              breed: Beagle
              date_of_birth: 2019-04-12
              owner_id: 5f0c6a1e-8a51-4c1e-9d0e-2f6a3b7c9d10
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          headers:
            Location:
              schema: {type: string}
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'}
        '422':
          description: Validation failed
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'
  /pets/{petId}:
    parameters:
      - name: petId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      tags: [pets]
      operationId: getPet
      summary: Get a pet by ID
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
        "404":
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
        default:
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Error'
  /appointments:
    post:
      tags: [appointments]
      operationId: bookAppointment
      summary: Book an appointment
      description: Books an appointment slot. Slots are held for 5 minutes after a successful `GET /slots` call; booking a slot that is no longer held returns `409 Conflict`.
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [pet_id, slot_id, reason]
              properties:
                pet_id: {type: string, format: uuid}
                slot_id: {type: string}
                reason:
                  type: string
                  enum: [checkup, vaccination, illness, injury, surgery, dental, other]
                notes:
                  type: string
                  maxLength: 2000
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Booked
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Appointment'}
        '409':
          description: The slot is no longer available.@@T2@@
components:
  parameters:
    Cursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema: {type: string}
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 25}
  responses:
    Unauthorized:
      description: Missing or invalid access token.
    NotFound:
      description: The resource does not exist.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'}
    Error:
      description: Unexpected error.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem'}
  schemas:
    NewPet:
      type: object
      required: [name, species, owner_id]
      properties:
        name: {type: string, maxLength: 80}
        species:
          type: string
          enum: [dog, cat, rabbit, bird, reptile, other]
        breed: {type: string}
        date_of_birth: {type: string, format: date}
        owner_id: {type: string, format: uuid}
    Pet:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/NewPet'
        - type: object
          required: [id, created_at]
          properties:
            id: {type: string, format: uuid, readOnly: true}
            created_at: {type: string, format: date-time, readOnly: true}
    Appointment:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: string}
        pet_id: {type: string, format: uuid}
        starts_at: {type: string, format: date-time}
        duration_minutes: {type: integer, example: 30}
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [booked, checked_in, completed, cancelled, no_show]
    Problem:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: {type: string, format: uri}
        title: {type: string}
        status: {type: integer}
        detail: {type: string}
  securitySchemes:
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: https://auth.vetcare.example.com/oauth/token
          scopes:
            appointments:read: Read pets, owners and appointments
            appointments:write: Create and modify appointments

openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: Paperback Store API
  version: 1.0.0-beta.4
  summary: Catalogue and orders for the Paperback online bookstore
  description: >-
    Public API of the Paperback bookstore. All responses are JSON. Monetary amounts are
    represented as strings with exactly two decimal places (e.g. `"12.50"`) to avoid
    floating point rounding issues, together with an ISO 4217 currency code.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    identifier: Apache-2.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.paperback.example/{version}
    variables:
      version:
        default: v1
        enum: [v1, v1-beta]
tags:
  - {name: catalogue, description: Books, authors and editions}
  - {name: orders}
paths:
  /books:
    get:
      tags: [catalogue]
      operationId: searchBooks
      summary: Search books
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: q
          description: Full-text query over title, subtitle, authors and ISBN.
          schema: {type: string, minLength: 2}
        - in: query
          name: format
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Format'
          style: form
          explode: false
        - name: sort
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            default: relevance
            enum:
              - relevance
              - price_asc
              - price_desc
              - published_desc
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Search results
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  total: {type: integer}
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Book'}
  /books/{isbn}:
    get:
      tags: [catalogue]
      operationId: getBook
      parameters:
        - name: isbn
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^(97[89])?\d{9}[\dX]$'
          example: "9780141439518"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: The book
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Book'}
        "404": {description: No book with this ISBN}
  /orders:
    post:
      tags: [orders]
      operationId: placeOrder
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderRequest'
            examples:
              shipping:
                summary: Ship a paperback to a home address
                value:
                  lines:
                    - {isbn: "9780141439518", format: paperback, quantity: 1}
                  fulfilment:
                    kind: shipping
                    address: {line1: 12 Rue des Lilas, city: Lyon, postal_code: "69003", country: FR}
              ebook:
                summary: Buy an e-book
                value:
                  lines: [{isbn: "9780141439518", format: ebook, quantity: 1}]
                  fulfilment: {kind: digital, email: reader@example.org}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Order placed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'}
        '400':
          description: Invalid order
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    Format:
      type: string
      enum: [hardcover, paperback, ebook, audiobook]
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amount, currency]
      properties:
        amount: {type: string, pattern: '^\d+\.\d{2}$', examples: ["12.50"]}
        currency: {type: string, minLength: 3, maxLength: 3, examples: [EUR]}
    Book:
      type: object
      required: [isbn, title, authors]
      properties:
        isbn: {type: string}
        title: {type: string}
        subtitle: {type: [string, "null"]}
        authors:
          type: array
          items: {type: string}
          minItems: 1
        published: {type: string, format: date}
        editions:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              format: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Format'}
              price: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'}
              in_stock: {type: boolean}
    OrderRequest:
      type: object
      required: [lines, fulfilment]
      properties:
        lines:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          items:
            type: object
            required: [isbn, format, quantity]
            properties:
              isbn: {type: string}
              format: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Format'}
              quantity: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20}
        fulfilment:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Shipping'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Digital'
          discriminator:
            propertyName: kind
            mapping:
              shipping: '#/components/schemas/Shipping'
              digital: '#/components/schemas/Digital'
    Shipping:
      type: object
      required: [kind, address]
      properties:
        kind: {const: shipping}
        address:
          type: object
          required: [line1, city, postal_code, country]
          properties:
            line1: {type: string}
            line2: {type: string}
            city: {type: string}
            postal_code: {type: string}
            country: {type: string, pattern: '^[A-Z]{2}$'}
    Digital:
      type: object
      required: [kind, email]
      properties:
        kind: {const: digital}
        email: {type: string, format: email}
    Order:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderRequest'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id: {type: string, readOnly: true}
            status: {type: string, enum: [pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled]}
            total: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'}

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Ledgerly Payments API
  version: 2024-06-01
  description: |-
    Accept card and bank payments, issue refunds and receive payouts.

    Versioning
    ----------
    The API is versioned by date. Send the `Ledgerly-Version` header to pin your integration to a specific version; if you don't, the version configured in your dashboard is used. Breaking changes are only ever introduced in a new dated version, and every version is supported for at least 24 months after its release.

    Idempotency
    -----------
    All `POST` requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying a request with the same key within 24 hours returns the original response instead of performing the operation twice, which makes it safe to retry after network errors.
  contact: {name: Ledgerly Developer Relations, email: devrel@ledgerly.example}
servers:
  - url: https://api.ledgerly.example
  - url: https://api.sandbox.ledgerly.example
    description: Sandbox -- no real money moves
security:
  - apiKey: []
  - oauth2: [payments.write]
tags:
  - name: Payments
  - name: Refunds
paths:
  /v1/payments:
    post:
      tags: [Payments]
      operationId: createPayment
      summary: Create a payment
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Version'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentCreate'}
            examples:
              card:
                summary: Card payment with 3-D Secure
                value:
                  amount: 4999
                  currency: EUR
                  method: {type: card, token: tok_1PqRsT2uVwXyZ}
                  capture: automatic
                  description: Order 100-2381
                  metadata: {order_id: "100-2381"}
              sepa:
                summary: SEPA Direct Debit
                value:
                  amount: 12000
                  currency: EUR
                  method:
                    type: sepa_debit
                    iban: DE89370400440532013000
                    mandate_id: mdt_8xYz
      callbacks:
        paymentStatus:
          '{$request.body#/callback_url}':
            post:
              summary: Payment status changed
              requestBody:
                content:
                  application/json:
                    schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Payment'}
              responses:
                '2XX':
                  description: Acknowledge receipt. Any other status triggers retries with exponential back-off for up to 3 days.
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Payment created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Payment'}
        '402':
          description: Payment declined
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
              example:
                error:
                  type: card_error
                  code: insufficient_funds
                  message: The card has insufficient funds to complete the purchase.
        '409':
          description: Idempotency key reused with a different request body
  /v1/payments/{id}/refunds:
    post:
      tags: [Refunds]
      operationId: refundPayment
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema: {type: string, pattern: '^pay_[A-Za-z0-9]{14}$'}
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                amount:
                  type: integer
                  description: Amount to refund in minor units. Defaults to the full remaining amount.
                reason:
                  type: string
                  enum: [duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer]
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Refund created
        '422':
          description: The payment cannot be refunded (e.g. it is still pending, or already fully refunded).
components:
  parameters:
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      schema: {type: string, maxLength: 255}
    Version:
      name: Ledgerly-Version
      in: header
      schema: {type: string, example: '2024-06-01'}
  schemas:
    PaymentCreate:
      type: object
      required: [amount, currency, method]
      properties:
        amount: {type: integer, minimum: 50, description: Amount in minor units (e.g. cents).}
        currency: {type: string, enum: [EUR, GBP, USD, CHF, SEK]}
        capture: {type: string, enum: [automatic, manual], default: automatic}
        description: {type: string, maxLength: 500}
        callback_url: {type: string, format: uri}
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {type: string}
          maxProperties: 20
        method:
          oneOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/CardMethod'
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/SepaMethod'
    CardMethod:
      type: object
      required: [type, token]
      properties:
        type: {type: string, enum: [card]}
        token: {type: string}
    SepaMethod:
      type: object
      required: [type, iban, mandate_id]
      properties:
        type: {type: string, enum: [sepa_debit]}
        iban: {type: string}
        mandate_id: {type: string}
    Payment:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaymentCreate'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id: {type: string, example: pay_8fK2LmN4pQ7rS1}
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [requires_action, processing, succeeded, failed, canceled]
            created: {type: integer, format: int64}
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          required: [type, message]
          properties:
            type: {type: string, enum: [api_error, card_error, invalid_request_error, rate_limit_error]}
            code: {type: string}
            message: {type: string}
  securitySchemes:
    apiKey:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: Use your secret API key (`sk_live_...` or `sk_test_...`) as the bearer token.
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          authorizationUrl: https://connect.ledgerly.example/oauth/authorize
          tokenUrl: https://connect.ledgerly.example/oauth/token
          scopes:
            payments.read: Read payments and refunds
            payments.write: Create payments and refunds
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: https://connect.ledgerly.example/oauth/token
          scopes:
            payments.read: Read payments and refunds
            payments.write: Create payments and refunds

openapi: '3.0.3'
info:
    title: Tasks API
    version: 0.9.2
    description: "Simple task tracking API used by the mobile apps.  **Note:** this API is not public and may change without notice."
servers:
    - url: 'http://localhost:8000'
      description: local dev
    - url: https://tasks.internal.example.com
paths:
    /tasks:
        get:
            summary: List tasks
            parameters:
                - name: status
                  in: query
                  schema:
                      type: string
                      enum: ["open", "done", "archived"]
                - name: due_before
                  in: query
                  schema: {type: string, format: date}
                - name: tag
                  in: query
                  description: Can be repeated, e.g. `?tag=home&tag=urgent`.
                  schema:
                      type: array
                      items: {type: string}
                  explode: true
            responses:
                '200':
                    description: OK
                    content:
                        application/json:
                            schema:
                                type: array
                                items:
                                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        post:
            summary: Create a task
            requestBody:
                required: true
                content:
                    application/json:
                        schema:
                            $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
                        example: {title: "Buy milk", due: "2024-11-20", tags: [home, groceries]}
            responses:
                '201':
                    description: Created
                    content:
                        application/json:

jsonSchemaDialect: https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/dialect/base
info:
  title: Skyline Weather API
  version: 3.2.1
  description: |
    Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts and severe weather alerts for any location on Earth.

    * Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees.
    * Units default to metric; pass `units=imperial` for Fahrenheit, mph and inches.
    * Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC unless `tz` is given.
servers:
  - url: https://api.skyline-weather.example/v3
security:
  - ApiKeyHeader: []
  - ApiKeyQuery: [ ]
paths:
  /forecast:
    get:
      operationId: getForecast
      summary: Hourly and daily forecast
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/lat'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/lon'
        - name: hours
          in: query
          schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 240, default: 48}
        - name: days
          in: query
          schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 16, default: 7}
        - name: units
          in: query
          schema: {type: string, enum: [metric, imperial], default: metric}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Forecast
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Forecast'}
        '400':
          description: Invalid coordinates
        '429':
          description: Rate limit exceeded
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              schema: {type: integer}
              description: Seconds until the next request will be accepted
  /alerts/subscriptions:
    post:
      operationId: subscribeAlerts
      summary: Subscribe to severe weather alerts for an area
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [area, callback_url]
              properties:
                area:
                  oneOf:
                    - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Circle'
                    - $ref: '#/components/schemas/GeoJSONPolygon'
                callback_url: {type: string, format: uri}
                min_severity: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Severity'}
      responses:
        '201': {description: Subscription created}
webhooks:
  severeWeatherAlert:
    post:
      summary: A severe weather alert was issued or updated for a subscribed area
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Alert'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Return any 2xx status to acknowledge the alert.
components:
  parameters:
    lat:
      name: lat
      in: query
      required: true
      schema: {type: number, minimum: -90, maximum: 90}
      example: 52.3676
    lon:
      name: lon
      in: query
      required: true
      schema: {type: number, minimum: -180, maximum: 180}
      example: 4.9041
  schemas:
    Severity:
      type: string
      enum: [minor, moderate, severe, extreme]
    Circle:
      type: object
      required: [center, radius_km]
      properties:
        center:
          type: array
          prefixItems: [{type: number}, {type: number}]
          minItems: 2
          maxItems: 2
        radius_km: {type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0, maximum: 500}
    GeoJSONPolygon:
      type: object
      required: [type, coordinates]
      properties:
        type: {const: Polygon}
        coordinates:
          type: array
          items:
            type: array
            items:
              type: array
              items: {type: number}
    Forecast:
      type: object
      properties:
        location:
          type: object
          properties:
            lat: {type: number}
            lon: {type: number}
            elevation_m: {type: [number, 'null']}
        hourly:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              time: {type: string, format: date-time}
              temperature: {type: number}
              precipitation_probability: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 100}
              wind_speed: {type: number}
              weather_code: {type: integer, description: WMO weather interpretation code}
        daily:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              date: {type: string, format: date}
              min: {type: number}
              max: {type: number}
              sunrise: {type: string, format: date-time}
              sunset: {type: string, format: date-time}
    Alert:
      type: object
      required: [id, severity, headline, onset, expires]
      properties:
        id: {type: string}
        severity: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Severity'}
        headline: {type: string, examples: ["Orange warning for heavy rain in Noord-Holland"]}
        description: {type: string}
        onset: {type: string, format: date-time}
        expires: {type: string, format: date-time}
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyHeader:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
    ApiKeyQuery:
      type: apiKey
      in: query
      name: appid
