        object: storefront/storefront-{{ storefront_version }}.tar.gz
        dest: /tmp/storefront-{{ storefront_version }}.tar.gz
        mode: get
      register: tarball
      retries: 3
      delay: 5
      until: tarball is succeeded


    - name: Unpack + install
      block:
        - name: Unarchive
          ansible.builtin.unarchive:
            src: /tmp/storefront-{{ storefront_version }}.tar.gz
            dest: "{{ app_root }}/releases/"
            remote_src: yes
            creates: "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ storefront_version }}/package.json"
        - name: pnpm install (prod deps only)
          ansible.builtin.command: >
            pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod
            --filter @acme/storefront...
          args:
            chdir: "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ storefront_version }}"
          environment:
            NODE_ENV: production
            NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
            NEXT_PUBLIC_FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD: "{{ free_shipping_eur }}"
          become_user: "{{ app_user }}"
        - name: Point "current" at the new release
          ansible.builtin.file:
            src: "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ storefront_version }}"
            dest: "{{ app_root }}/current"
            state: link
          notify: restart storefront
      rescue:
        - name: Roll back symlink
          ansible.builtin.file:
            src: "{{ previous_release.stat.lnk_source }}"
            dest: "{{ app_root }}/current"
            state: link
            force: True
          when: previous_release.stat.exists | default(false)
        - ansible.builtin.fail:
            msg: Install failed on {{ inventory_hostname }}; rolled back to {{ previous_release.stat.lnk_source | default('n/a') }}
      always:
        - name: Clean up tarball
          ansible.builtin.file: path=/tmp/storefront-{{ storefront_version }}.tar.gz state=absent

    - name: Render .env.production
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: templates/env.production.j2
        dest: "{{ app_root }}/shared/.env.production"
        mode: "0640"
      notify:
        - restart storefront
      no_log: True

    - name: nginx cache rules for product images
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/nginx/snippets/acme-images.conf
        content: |
          # managed by ansible -- do not edit on the box
          location ~* ^/_next/image {
              proxy_cache        images;
              proxy_cache_valid  200 302 7d;
              add_header X-Cache-Status $upstream_cache_status;
          }
          location /assets/ { expires 30d; access_log off; }
      notify: reload nginx

    - name: Wait for the health endpoint
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: "{{ healthcheck_url }}"
        status_code: [200, 204]
        return_content: no
      register: health
      until: health.status in [200,204]
      retries: 12
      delay: 5

    - name: Purge CDN surrogate keys (category pages, PDPs, price feed)
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://api.fastly.com/service/{{ fastly_service_id }}/purge/{{ item }}
        method: POST
        headers:
          Fastly-Key: "{{ vault_fastly_key }}"
          Accept: application/json
      loop: "{{ ['category-pages', 'pdp', 'price-feed'] if cdn_purge else [] }}"
      run_once: true
      tags: [cdn,never]

  handlers:
    - name: restart storefront
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: acme-storefront
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: yes
    - name: reload nginx
      ansible.builtin.service: name=nginx state=reloaded

arguments.content:
# docker-compose.yml — local dev stack for the Acme web team
#   storefront (Next.js) · cms (Strapi) · recs (FastAPI) · marketing (Astro) · search (Meilisearch)
#
#   docker compose up -d && open http://localhost:3000
#   docker compose --profile debug up mailpit       # catches outgoing order-confirmation emails
#
# heads-up: `version:` is obsolete in compose v2, but the design team's iMacs still run docker-compose 1.29, so it stays. For now.
version: "3.9"

x-node-defaults: &node-defaults
  restart: unless-stopped
  init: true
  env_file:
    - .env
    - .env.local
  networks: [ web ]
  logging:
    driver: "json-file"
    options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

x-healthcheck-http: &hc
  interval: 15s
  timeout: 5s
  retries: 5
  start_period: 40s

# fmt: markdown
x-readme: |
  ## Ports cheat-sheet
  | service | url | notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | storefront | http://localhost:3000 | Next.js, hot reload, `--inspect` on 9229 |
  | cms | http://localhost:1337/admin | login `admin@acme.test`, password in 1Password |
  | recs | http://localhost:8081/docs | FastAPI swagger UI |
  | marketing | http://localhost:4321 | Astro |
  | search | http://localhost:7700 | Meilisearch, master key in `.env` |
  | mailpit | http://localhost:8025 | only with `--profile debug` |

  Something broken? Ask in #web-platform *before* nuking your volumes. **Never** commit `.env.local` 🙏

services:

  storefront:
    <<: *node-defaults
    build:
      context: ./apps/storefront
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
      target: dev
      args:
        - NODE_VERSION=20.18.0
        - PNPM_VERSION=9.12.1
    image: acme/storefront:dev
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - 9229:9229⇥# node --inspect
    environment:
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL: http://localhost:1337
      CMS_INTERNAL_URL: http://cms:1337
      RECS_URL: "http://recs:8081/v1"
      SEARCH_URL: http://search:7700
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY: EUR
      NEXT_PUBLIC_FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD: "49.00"
      NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_KLARNA: 'true'
      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096 --inspect=0.0.0.0:9229
    volumes:
      - ./apps/storefront:/app:cached
      - /app/node_modules
      - storefront-next:/app/.next
    depends_on:
      cms:
        condition: service_healthy
      recs:
        condition: service_started
    healthcheck:
      <<: *hc
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3000/api/health"]

  cms:
      <<: *node-defaults
      image: acme/cms:2.7
      build: ./apps/cms
      ports: ["1337:1337"]
      environment:
        - DATABASE_CLIENT=postgres
        - DATABASE_HOST=db
        - DATABASE_NAME=strapi
        - DATABASE_USERNAME=${POSTGRES_USER:-strapi}
        - DATABASE_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
        - APP_KEYS=${CMS_APP_KEYS}
        - "PREVIEW_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/preview?secret=${PREVIEW_SECRET}&slug="
        # webhook -> storefront on publish (ISR revalidate)
        - WEBHOOK_URL=http://storefront:3000/api/revalidate
      volumes:
        - cms-uploads:/opt/app/public/uploads
      depends_on: [db, redis]
      healthcheck:
        <<: *hc
        test: curl --fail --silent http://localhost:1337/_health || exit 1

  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-strapi}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: strapi
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:5432:5432
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./ops/db/seed:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro    # seeds 40 demo SKUs + 3 campaigns
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER:-strapi} -d strapi"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - web

  redis:
    image: "redis:7.4-alpine"
    command: redis-server --save "" --appendonly no --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    networks: [web]

  recs:
    build:
      context: ./services/recs
    image: acme/recs:dev
    command: >
      uvicorn recs.api:app
      --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8081
      --reload --reload-dir /code/recs
    environment:
      MODEL_URI: s3://acme-ml-models/recs/two-tower/2026-11-01/
      FEATURE_STORE_URL: redis://redis:6379/2
      EMBEDDING_DIM: 128
      AB_TEST_BUCKETS: '{"control": 50, "two_tower_v3": 50}'
      FALLBACK_STRATEGY: bestsellers
      LOG_LEVEL: debug
    ports: [ "8081:8081" ]
    volumes:
      - ./services/recs:/code
    depends_on:
      - redis
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits: {cpus: '2.0', memory: 3g}
        reservations:
          memory: 1g
    networks: [web]

  marketing:
    <<: *node-defaults
    build: ./apps/marketing
    ports:
      - target: 4321
        published: "4321"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      PUBLIC_SITE_URL: http://localhost:4321
      PUBLIC_GA_ID: G-XXXXXXXXXX
      PUBLIC_BANNER_TEXT: "🎄 Holiday Sale: up to 40% off — ends Dec 26!"
      PUBLIC_CMS_URL: http://localhost:1337
    labels:
      com.acme.team: "marketing-web"
      com.acme.owner: '@acme/growth-eng'

  search:
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.11
    environment:
      - MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MEILI_MASTER_KEY:-dev-only-master-key-change-me}
      - MEILI_ENV=development
      - MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=true
    ports: ['7700:7700']
    volumes: [ "meili:/meili_data" ]
    networks:
      web:
        aliases: [ search.local ]

  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:latest
    profiles: ["debug"]
    ports:
      - "8025:8025"
      - "1025:1025"
    environment:
      MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY: 1
      MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE: 1
    networks: [web]


volumes:
  pgdata: {}
  cms-uploads:
  storefront-next:
  meili:
    driver: local

networks:
  web:
    name: acme-web
    driver: bridge

# beacon backend - local dev AND the prod boxes (prod adds docker-compose.prod.yml on top)
#   docker compose up -d
#   docker compose --profile tools up -d          # + adminer, mailpit
#   docker compose -f docker_compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d     (on beacon-prod-*, ansible does this)
name: beacon

x-logging: &default-logging
  driver: json-file
  options:
    max-size: "10m"
    max-file: '5'

x-beacon-env: &beacon-env
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://beacon:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-beacon}@db:5432/beacon
  REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0
  S3_ENDPOINT_URL: http://minio:9000
  S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-glowtide-content}
  ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${ASC_ISSUER_ID}
  ASC_KEY_ID: ${ASC_KEY_ID:?set ASC_KEY_ID in .env (App Store Server API key id)}
  PLAY_PACKAGE_NAMES: studio.lanternfish.glowtide,studio.lanternfish.sprout
  SENTRY_DSN: ${SENTRY_DSN:-}
  TZ: UTC

services:
  api:
    build:
      context: ./services/beacon
      args:
        - PYTHON_VERSION=3.12
        - "UV_VERSION=0.5.4"
    image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:${BEACON_TAG:-dev}
    command: ["uvicorn", "beacon.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--proxy-headers", "--forwarded-allow-ips", "*"]
    environment:
      <<: *beacon-env
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
      WEB_CONCURRENCY: 2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    depends_on:
      db: { condition: service_healthy }
      cache:
        condition: service_started
      migrate:
          condition: service_completed_successfully
    secrets: [asc_api_key, play_service_account]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *default-logging
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://localhost:8000/healthz"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 15s

  migrate:
    image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:${BEACON_TAG:-dev}
    command: alembic upgrade head
    environment: *beacon-env
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  worker:
    image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:${BEACON_TAG:-dev}
    # arq worker: receipt re-validation, weekly leaderboard rollover, push fan-out (APNs + FCM)
    command: >
      arq beacon.worker.WorkerSettings
      --custom-log-dict beacon.logging.LOG_CONFIG

arguments.content:
---
# site-compute.yml -- provision Slurm compute + GPU nodes on larch
# Research Computing Services, University of Northfield
#
#   ansible-playbook -i inventories/larch/hosts.ini site-compute.yml --limit 'gpu[01:08]' --diff --check
#
# NB:  slurm_version MUST match the controller (group_vars/slurmctld.yml), otherwise slurmd refuses to register.
# NB2: slurmdbd_password is vaulted -> run with --ask-vault-pass or export ANSIBLE_VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE

- name: Configure Slurm compute nodes
  hosts: compute:gpu:!drained
  become: yes
  gather_facts: true
  serial: "25%"
  max_fail_percentage: 10
  vars_files:
    - vars/slurm.yml
    - "vars/{{ cluster_name }}-secrets.yml"
  vars:
    slurm_version: "24.05.4"
    slurm_user: { name: slurm, uid: 981,  gid: 981 }
    spack_root: /opt/spack
    lmod_version: 8.7.53
    scratch_root:   /scratch
    drain_first: True
    # Rendered into slurm.conf.j2 (one PartitionName= line each). Keep the columns lined up, it makes --diff readable.
    slurm_partitions:
      # fmt: table
      - {name: short, nodes: "cn[001-120]", max_time: "04:00:00", default: true, tier: 10}
      - {name: long,   nodes: "cn[001-096]",  max_time: "7-00:00:00", default: false, tier: 5}
      - {name: gpu, nodes: "gpu[01-08]", max_time: '2-00:00:00', default: false, tier: 10}
      - {name: bigmem, nodes: "fat[1-4]", max_time: 3-00:00:00, default: no, tier: 5}
    gres_types: [a100, h100]
    cgroup_conf: |
      CgroupPlugin=cgroup/v2
      ConstrainCores=yes
      ConstrainRAMSpace=yes
      ConstrainDevices=yes
      AllowedRAMSpace=98
    nhc:
      enabled: yes
      interval: 300     # seconds; NHC also runs as slurmd's HealthCheckProgram
      checks: [ check_fs_mount_rw -f /scratch, check_fs_mount_rw -f /home, 'check_hw_ib 100', check_ps_service -u root -S sshd ]
    slurmdbd_password: !vault |
          $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256
          36383433643335336339626631616532373731363266306566343634396137653262363931393630
          3630356261353637663538656630333366386334373562320a383463613033383432643039383662
          30623234616565373939386139313737303436656235306432636636356137323533393537343366
          3564633366643938310a316131623662326139663466646237306462653564313765383233626632
          6237

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Refuse to run on anything that is not EL9
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_distribution in ['Rocky', 'AlmaLinux', 'RedHat']
          - ansible_distribution_major_version | int >= 9
        fail_msg: "larch compute images are EL9 only (got {{ ansible_distribution }} {{ ansible_distribution_version }})"
        quiet: true

    - name: Drain node before touching slurmd
      command: scontrol update NodeName={{ inventory_hostname_short }} State=DRAIN Reason="ansible run {{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }}"
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['slurmctld'][0] }}"
      changed_when: false
      when: drain_first | bool

  tasks:
    - name: Install Slurm, munge and friends
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - "slurm-{{ slurm_version }}"
          - "slurm-slurmd-{{ slurm_version }}"
          - "slurm-pam_slurm-{{ slurm_version }}"
          - munge
          - hwloc
          - numactl
          - lua-posix        # Lmod
          - "nhc >= 1.4.3"
        state: present
        enablerepo: larch-hpc,epel
      notify: restart slurmd

    - name: Munge key
      copy:
        src: files/munge.key
        dest: /etc/munge/munge.key
        owner: munge
        group: munge
        mode: 0400
      no_log: true
      notify:
      - restart munge

    - name: Slurm config files
      template: src={{ item }}.j2 dest=/etc/slurm/{{ item }} owner=root group=root mode=0644
      loop:
        - slurm.conf
        - gres.conf
        - topology.conf
      notify: restart slurmd

    - name: cgroup.conf
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: "{{ cgroup_conf }}"
        dest: /etc/slurm/cgroup.conf
        mode: '0644'
      notify: restart slurmd

    - name: Per-job scratch cleanup epilog
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/slurm/epilog.d/50-scratch-cleanup.sh
        mode: "0755"
        # !unsafe because ${#dirs[@]} looks like the start of a Jinja comment to Ansible
        content: !unsafe |
          #!/bin/bash
          # Runs as root on every node of the allocation after the job has ended.
          [[ -n "${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}" ]] || exit 0
          dirs=( "/scratch/local/job.${SLURM_JOB_ID}" "/dev/shm/job.${SLURM_JOB_ID}" )
          logger -t slurm-epilog "removing ${#dirs[@]} scratch dirs for job ${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
          rm -rf --one-file-system -- "${dirs[@]}"
          exit 0

    - name: GPU nodes
      when:
        - "'gpu' in group_names"
        - ansible_local.nvidia.driver_version is defined
      block:
        - name: Install DCGM
          ansible.builtin.dnf: {name: datacenter-gpu-manager, state: present}

        - name: Persistence mode + DCGM host engine
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: "{{ item }}"
            enabled: true
            state: started
          loop: [nvidia-persistenced, nvidia-dcgm]

        - name: Quick GPU diagnostic (dcgmi diag -r 1)
          ansible.builtin.command: dcgmi diag -r 1 -j
          register: dcgm_diag
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: >-
            (dcgm_diag.stdout | from_json).DCGM_GPU_DIAGNOSTIC.test_categories
            | map(attribute='tests') | flatten | selectattr('results', 'search', 'Fail') | list | length > 0
      rescue:
        - name: Keep the node drained so nobody lands on a broken GPU
          ansible.builtin.command: >
            scontrol update NodeName={{ inventory_hostname_short }}
            State=DRAIN Reason="dcgm diag failed {{ ansible_date_time.date }}"
          delegate_to: "{{ groups['slurmctld'][0] }}"
        - ansible.builtin.meta: end_host

    - name: Spack upstream for user installs
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ spack_root }}/etc/spack/upstreams.yaml"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          upstreams:
            larch-central:
              install_tree: /opt/spack/opt/spack
              modules:
                lmod: /opt/spack/share/spack/lmod
      tags: [spack]

    - name: Lmod default MODULEPATH
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/profile.d/z00_lmod.sh
        regexp: '^export MODULEPATH='
        line: 'export MODULEPATH=/opt/spack/share/spack/lmod/linux-rocky9-x86_64/Core:/opt/modulefiles'
        create: yes
      tags: [ spack,lmod ]

    - meta: flush_handlers

    - name: Undrain
      command: scontrol update NodeName={{ inventory_hostname_short }} State=RESUME
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['slurmctld'][0] }}"
      when: drain_first | bool

  handlers:
    - name: restart munge
      service: name=munge state=restarted
    - name: restart slurmd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: slurmd
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: yes


- name: Login nodes | news file shown by `larch-news`
  hosts: login
  become: true
  tags: [news]
  vars_files: [vars/slurm.yml]
  vars:
    maint_window: {start: "Wed 2 Dec 06:00", end: "Fri 4 Dec 18:00"}
  tasks:
    - name: /etc/larch/news.md (rendered in the terminal with glow)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/larch/news.md
        owner: root
        mode: "0644"
        # fmt: markdown
        content: |
          # larch news ({{ ansible_date_time.date }})

          **Maintenance:** the `long` and `bigmem` partitions will be drained from {{ maint_window.start }} until {{ maint_window.end }}. Jobs that cannot finish before the window starts stay pending with reason `ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance` -- they are *not* cancelled.

          * Slurm is now {{ slurm_version }}. Job scripts that set both `--mem` and `--mem-per-cpu` are rejected at submission time, pick one.
          *   GPU jobs must ask for a GPU type explicitly, e.g. `--gres=gpu:a100:2`; an untyped `--gres=gpu:2` now lands on the (much slower) V100 nodes in `gpu-legacy`.
          * `/scratch` is **not** backed up and files older than 60 days are purged every Sunday night.

          Questions: <rcs-help@northfield.ac.uk> or the [user guide](https://hpc.northfield.ac.uk/docs/).

        content: !unsafe |
          #!/bin/bash
          # Runs as root on every node of the allocation after the job has ended.
          [[ -n "${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}" ]] || exit 0
          dirs=( "/scratch/local/job.${SLURM_JOB_ID}" "/dev/shm/job.${SLURM_JOB_ID}" )
          logger -t slurm-epilog "removing ${#dirs[@]} scratch dirs for job ${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
          rm -rf --one-file-system -- "${dirs[@]}"
          exit 0

    - name: GPU nodes
      when:
        - "'gpu' in group_names"
        - ansible_local.nvidia.driver_version is defined
      block:
        - name: Install DCGM
          ansible.builtin.dnf: {name: datacenter-gpu-manager, state: present}

        - name: Persistence mode + DCGM host engine
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: "{{ item }}"
            enabled: true
            state: started
          loop: [nvidia-persistenced, nvidia-dcgm]

        - name: Quick GPU diagnostic (dcgmi diag -r 1)
          ansible.builtin.command: dcgmi diag -r 1 -j
          register: dcgm_diag
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: >-
            (dcgm_diag.stdout | from_json).DCGM_GPU_DIAGNOSTIC.test_categories
            | map(attribute='tests') | flatten | selectattr('results', 'search', 'Fail') | list | length > 0
      rescue:
        - name: Keep the node drained so nobody lands on a broken GPU
          ansible.builtin.command: >
            scontrol update NodeName={{ inventory_hostname_short }}
            State=DRAIN Reason="dcgm diag failed {{ ansible_date_time.date }}"
          delegate_to: "{{ groups['slurmctld'][0] }}"
        - ansible.builtin.meta: end_host

    - name: Spack upstream for user installs
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ spack_root }}/etc/spack/upstreams.yaml"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          upstreams:
            larch-central:
              install_tree: /opt/spack/opt/spack
              modules:
                lmod: /opt/spack/share/spack/lmod
      tags: [spack]

    - name: Lmod default MODULEPATH
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/profile.d/z00_lmod.sh
        regexp: '^export MODULEPATH='
        line: 'export MODULEPATH=/opt/spack/share/spack/lmod/linux-rocky9-x86_64/Core:/opt/modulefiles'
        create: yes
      tags: [ spack,lmod ]

    - meta: flush_handlers

    - name: Undrain
      command: scontrol update NodeName={{ inventory_hostname_short }} State=RESUME
      delegate_to: "{{ groups['slurmctld'][0] }}"
      when: drain_first | bool

  handlers:
    - name: restart munge
      service: name=munge state=restarted
    - name: restart slurmd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: slurmd
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: yes


- name: Login nodes | news file shown by `larch-news`
  hosts: login
  become: true
  tags: [news]
  vars_files: [vars/slurm.yml]
  vars:
    maint_window: {start: "Wed 2 Dec 06:00", end: "Fri 4 Dec 18:00"}
  tasks:
    - name: /etc/larch/news.md (rendered in the terminal with glow)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/larch/news.md
        owner: root
        mode: "0644"
        # fmt: markdown
        content: |
          # larch news ({{ ansible_date_time.date }})

          **Maintenance:** the `long` and `bigmem` partitions will be drained from {{ maint_window.start }} until {{ maint_window.end }}. Jobs that cannot finish before the window starts stay pending with reason `ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance` -- they are *not* cancelled.

          * Slurm is now {{ slurm_version }}. Job scripts that set both `--mem` and `--mem-per-cpu` are rejected at submission time, pick one.
          *   GPU jobs must ask for a GPU type explicitly, e.g. `--gres=gpu:a100:2`; an untyped `--gres=gpu:2` now lands on the (much slower) V100 nodes in `gpu-legacy`.
          * `/scratch` is **not** backed up and files older than 60 days are purged every Sunday night.

          Questions: <rcs-help@northfield.ac.uk> or the [user guide](https://hpc.northfield.ac.uk/docs/).

arguments.content:
# docker-compose.yml for cmorph-pp -- CMIP6 post-processing stack (dev / single workstation)
# Climate Analytics Group, Dept. of Earth System Science, University of Northfield
#
#   cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d
#   docker compose --profile thredds up -d       # also serve the outputs over OPeNDAP
#   docker compose run --rm pp-cli regrid --source-id MPI-ESM1-2-HR --experiment ssp585 --grid 1x1
#
# The ESGF mirror lives on the group NFS (/data/cmip6, read-only). Do NOT bind-mount it rw: the export is
# shared with the larch cluster and a stray `rm -rf` in a container takes out everyone's replicas.

name: cmorph-pp

x-common-env: &common-env
  TZ: UTC
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"            # dask does the parallelism, don't let MKL/OpenBLAS oversubscribe
  MKL_NUM_THREADS: '1'
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: 1
  HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING: "FALSE"  # NFS + HDF5 file locking = hung workers
  DASK_DISTRIBUTED__COMM__TIMEOUTS__CONNECT: 60s
  DASK_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY: /scratch/dask-tmp
  ESMFMKFILE: /opt/conda/lib/esmf.mk

x-logging: &logging
  logging:
    driver: json-file
    options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}

x-data-volumes: &data-volumes
  - type: bind
    source: ${CMIP6_ROOT:-/data/cmip6}
    target: /data/cmip6
    read_only: true
  - type: volume
    source: scratch
    target: /scratch
  - ./config:/etc/cmorph-pp:ro

x-worker: &worker
  image: ghcr.io/nfld-climate/cmorph-pp:${PP_TAG:-2026.11.0}
  restart: unless-stopped
  environment:
    <<: *common-env
    DASK_DISTRIBUTED__WORKER__MEMORY__TARGET: 0.6
    DASK_DISTRIBUTED__WORKER__MEMORY__SPILL: 0.7
    DASK_DISTRIBUTED__WORKER__MEMORY__PAUSE: 0.85
    DASK_DISTRIBUTED__WORKER__MEMORY__TERMINATE: 0.95
  volumes: *data-volumes
  depends_on:
    scheduler:
      condition: service_healthy
  command: >
    dask worker tcp://scheduler:8786
    --nworkers 1 --nthreads ${WORKER_THREADS:-4}
    --memory-limit ${WORKER_MEMORY:-16GiB}
    --local-directory /scratch/dask-tmp
    --name $${HOSTNAME}
  stop_grace_period: 1m30s

services:

  scheduler:
    <<: *logging
    image: ghcr.io/nfld-climate/cmorph-pp:${PP_TAG:-2026.11.0}
    command: ["dask", "scheduler", "--port", "8786", "--dashboard-address", ":8787"]
    environment: *common-env
    ports:
      - "8786:8786"
      - 127.0.0.1:8787:8787     # dashboard, localhost only -- use ssh -L from your laptop
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "python -c 'import socket; socket.create_connection((\"localhost\", 8786), 2)'" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s

  worker-a:
    <<: [*worker, *logging]
    hostname: worker-a
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits: {cpus: "4", memory: 18g}

  worker-b:
    <<: [ *worker, *logging ]
    hostname: worker-b
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
            cpus: '4'
            memory: 18g

  # GPU worker: builds the conservative regridding weights with xESMF + cupy.
  # Only on hosts with nvidia-container-toolkit, hence the profile.
  worker-gpu:
    <<: *worker
    profiles: ["gpu"]
    hostname: worker-gpu
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0"
      CMORPH_ARRAY_BACKEND: cupy
      DASK_DISTRIBUTED__WORKER__RESOURCES__GPU: 1
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - driver: nvidia
            count: 1
            capabilities: [gpu]

  jupyter:
    <<: *logging
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.jupyter
      args:
        PYTHON_VERSION: "3.12"
        ESMF_VERSION: 8.7.0
        XESMF_VERSION: 0.8.8
    ports: [ 8888:8888 ]
    volumes:
      - ${CMIP6_ROOT:-/data/cmip6}:/data/cmip6:ro
      - scratch:/scratch
      - ./notebooks:/home/jovyan/work
      - pp-output:/data/output
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      JUPYTER_TOKEN: ${JUPYTER_TOKEN:?set JUPYTER_TOKEN in .env}
      DASK_SCHEDULER_ADDRESS: tcp://scheduler:8786
      JUPYTER_ENABLE_LAB:
    user: "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-100}"
    depends_on: [scheduler]

  thredds:
    image: unidata/thredds-docker:5.5
    profiles:
      - thredds
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "8081"
        protocol: tcp
        mode: host
    environment:
      - TDS_CONTENT_ROOT_PATH=/usr/local/tomcat/content
      - TDM_PW=${TDM_PW}
      - "JAVA_OPTS=-Xms4g -Xmx8g -server -Djava.awt.headless=true"
      - TDS_HOST=http://localhost:8081
    volumes:
      - ./thredds/catalog.xml:/usr/local/tomcat/content/thredds/catalog.xml:ro
      - type: volume
        source: pp-output
        target: /data/output
        read_only: true
        volume: {nocopy: true}

  pp-cli:
    image: ghcr.io/nfld-climate/cmorph-pp:${PP_TAG:-2026.11.0}
    profiles: [cli]
    entrypoint: ["cmorph-pp"]
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      DASK_SCHEDULER_ADDRESS: tcp://scheduler:8786
    volumes: *data-volumes
    working_dir: /scratch
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
    labels:
      org.opencontainers.image.description: "CLI for regridding, de-drifting and CMORizing CMIP6 output; see docs/pp-cli.md"
      uk.ac.northfield.climate.maintainer: 'Dr. A. Lindqvist <a.lindqvist@northfield.ac.uk>'

volumes:
  scratch:
    driver: local
    driver_opts:
      type: tmpfs
      device: tmpfs
      o: "size=64g,uid=1000"
  pp-output:
    external: true
    name: cmorph_pp_output     # created by `make volumes`, lives on the RAID array

networks:
  default:
    name: cmorph-pp
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.driver.mtu: 9000

arguments.content:
name: Storefront CI

# Lint/test on every PR that touches the storefront or the shared packages.
# Lighthouse + Chromatic on PRs only, Vercel preview per PR, prod deploy on `storefront@x.y.z` tags.
# Owner: @acme/web-platform   (ping #web-ci if main is red for > 1h)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    tags: [ "storefront@*" ]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apps/storefront/**'
      - "packages/ui/**"
      - packages/pricing/**
      - '!**/*.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_lighthouse:
        description: 'Run Lighthouse against the preview URL?'
        type: boolean
        default: true
      locale:
        description: Locale to audit
        type: choice
        options: [en-NL, nl-NL, de-DE, 'fr-FR']
        default: en-NL

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  deployments: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PNPM_VERSION: 9.12.1
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  TURBO_TEAM: acme-web
  TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1
  FORCE_COLOR: "3"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint
        run: pnpm turbo run lint --filter=@acme/storefront... --filter=@acme/ui
      - name: tsc
        run: pnpm turbo run typecheck --filter=...[origin/main]
      - name: Stylelint (CSS modules)
        run: pnpm stylelint "apps/storefront/**/*.module.css" --max-warnings=0

  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        node: [ 18, 20, 22 ]
        shard: [1/3, 2/3, 3/3]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            node: 20
            shard: 1/1
        exclude:
          - node: 18
            shard: 3/3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: "${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}"}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Unit tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        run: pnpm --filter @acme/storefront test -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }} --coverage
        env:
          TZ: Europe/Amsterdam   # price cut-off tests depend on CET midnight
          CI: true
      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.node == 20 && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: storefront,shard-${{ strategy.job-index }}

  preview:
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: preview
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    outputs:
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy to Vercel (preview)
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm i -g vercel@39
          url=$(vercel deploy --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} --scope acme-web --build-env NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY=EUR)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: prj_storefront_9f2a

  lighthouse:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || inputs.run_lighthouse
    needs: [preview]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lighthouse CI
        id: lhci
        uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v12
        with:
          urls: |
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/c/womens-sneakers
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/p/aurora-runner-2?sku=AUR-2-BLK-42
          budgetPath: ./apps/storefront/lighthouse-budget.json
          uploadArtifacts: true
          temporaryPublicStorage: true
      - name: Comment scores on the PR

name: Storefront CI

# Lint/test on every PR that touches the storefront or the shared packages.
# Lighthouse + Chromatic on PRs only, Vercel preview per PR, prod deploy on `storefront@x.y.z` tags.
# Owner: @acme/web-platform   (ping #web-ci if main is red for > 1h)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    tags: [ "storefront@*" ]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apps/storefront/**'
      - "packages/ui/**"
      - packages/pricing/**
      - '!**/*.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_lighthouse:
        description: 'Run Lighthouse against the preview URL?'
        type: boolean
        default: true
      locale:
        description: Locale to audit
        type: choice
        options: [en-NL, nl-NL, de-DE, 'fr-FR']
        default: en-NL

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  deployments: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PNPM_VERSION: 9.12.1
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  TURBO_TEAM: acme-web
  TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
  NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1
  FORCE_COLOR: "3"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint
        run: pnpm turbo run lint --filter=@acme/storefront... --filter=@acme/ui
      - name: tsc
        run: pnpm turbo run typecheck --filter=...[origin/main]
      - name: Stylelint (CSS modules)
        run: pnpm stylelint "apps/storefront/**/*.module.css" --max-warnings=0

  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        node: [ 18, 20, 22 ]
        shard: [1/3, 2/3, 3/3]
        include:
          - os: windows-latest
            node: 20
            shard: 1/1
        exclude:
          - node: 18
            shard: 3/3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with: {version: "${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}"}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Unit tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        run: pnpm --filter @acme/storefront test -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }} --coverage
        env:
          TZ: Europe/Amsterdam   # price cut-off tests depend on CET midnight
          CI: true
      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.node == 20 && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: storefront,shard-${{ strategy.job-index }}

  preview:
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: preview
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    outputs:
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy to Vercel (preview)
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm i -g vercel@39
          url=$(vercel deploy --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }} --scope acme-web --build-env NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY=EUR)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:

    needs: [preview]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lighthouse CI
        id: lhci
        uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v12
        with:
          urls: |
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/c/womens-sneakers
            ${{ needs.preview.outputs.url }}/p/aurora-runner-2?sku=AUR-2-BLK-42
          budgetPath: ./apps/storefront/lighthouse-budget.json
          uploadArtifacts: true
          temporaryPublicStorage: true
      - name: Comment scores on the PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          LH_MANIFEST: ${{ steps.lhci.outputs.manifest }}
        with:
          # fmt: js
          script: |
            const manifest = JSON.parse(process.env.LH_MANIFEST)
            const pct = (x) => Math.round(x*100)
            const rows = manifest.map(r => { const s=r.summary; return `| ${new URL(r.url).pathname} | ${pct(s.performance)} | ${pct(s.accessibility)} | ${pct(s.seo)} |` })
            const body = ['### 🔦 Lighthouse (mobile, ${{ inputs.locale || 'en-NL' }})', '', '| page | perf | a11y | seo |', '|---|--:|--:|--:|', ...rows].join('\n')
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({ ...context.repo, issue_number: context.issue.number, body })

  chromatic:
    needs: lint
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-visual') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0     # chromatic needs full history for baselines
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: chromaui/action@latest
        with:
          projectToken: ${{ secrets.CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN }}
          workingDir: packages/ui
          onlyChanged: true
          exitZeroOnChanges: true
          autoAcceptChanges: "main"

  deploy-prod:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/storefront@')
    needs: [test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx vercel@39 deploy --prod --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Draft GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          draft: true
          name: Storefront ${{ github.ref_name }}
          # fmt: markdown
          body: |
            ## 🛍️ Storefront ${{ github.ref_name }}
            Deployed to **production** by @${{ github.actor }}.
            * [Vercel deployment](https://vercel.com/acme-web/storefront)
            * [Lighthouse report](https://lighthouse.acme-shop.example/storefront/${{ github.sha }}) -- compare against the last tag before you celebrate

            > Remember to update the price feed in Merchant Center if SKUs or prices changed!
      - name: Notify #launches
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: C04ACMEWEB
          slack-message: "*Storefront ${{ github.ref_name }}* is live :tada: <https://www.acme-shop.example|acme-shop.example>"
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

arguments.content:
# .github/workflows/mobile-release.yml
# Builds Glowtide (Unity) + Sprout (native) and ships them with fastlane.
#   push to main                     -> beacon tests + Unity builds (no upload)
#   tag glowtide-v* / sprout-v*      -> TestFlight + Play internal track
#   manual dispatch                  -> pick app / platform / lane
name: Mobile release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    tags:
      - 'glowtide-v*'
      - "sprout-v*"
    paths-ignore: ['**.md', 'docs/**',
      'website/**']
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      app:
        description: Which app to build
        type: choice
        options: [glowtide, sprout]
        default: glowtide
      platform:
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - android
          - both
        default: both
      lane:
        description: fastlane lane to run after the build (beta uploads to TestFlight / Play internal,
          release also uploads the store metadata but never submits for review)
        required: false
        default: 'beta'
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 3 * * 1-5'   # nightly-ish, keeps the Unity Library cache warm

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
  id-token: write

env:
  APP: ${{ inputs.app || (startsWith(github.ref_name, 'sprout-') && 'sprout' || 'glowtide') }}
  FASTLANE_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK: "1"
  FASTLANE_HIDE_CHANGELOG: true
  LC_ALL: en_US.UTF-8

jobs:
  beacon-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: beacon
          POSTGRES_USER: beacon
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - &checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {fetch-depth: 0, lfs: false}
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - run: uv run --directory services/beacon pytest -q --cov=beacon --cov-report=xml
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://beacon:beacon@localhost:5432/beacon
          REDIS_URL: ""

  unity:
    name: Glowtide ${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'unity-build')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        targetPlatform: [iOS, Android]
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Git LFS pull (art + audio)
        run: git lfs pull
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: games/glowtide/Library
          key: Library-${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}-${{ hashFiles('games/glowtide/Assets/**', 'games/glowtide/Packages/**', 'games/glowtide/ProjectSettings/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            Library-${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}-
            Library-
      # copied from https://game.ci/docs/github/builder - keep the env names, the action reads them
      - uses: game-ci/unity-builder@v4
        env:
          UNITY_LICENSE: ${{ secrets.UNITY_LICENSE }}
          UNITY_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.UNITY_EMAIL }}
          UNITY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.UNITY_PASSWORD }}
        with:
          projectPath: games/glowtide
          unityVersion: 2022.3.49f1
          targetPlatform: ${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}
          buildMethod: Lanternfish.Build.BuildScript.BuildFromCI
          versioning: Custom
          version: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          androidExportType: androidAppBundle
          androidKeystoreName: glowtide.keystore
          androidKeystoreBase64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          androidKeystorePass: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASS }}
          androidKeyaliasName: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYALIAS_NAME }}
          androidKeyaliasPass: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYALIAS_PASS }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: glowtide-${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}
          path: build/${{ matrix.targetPlatform }}
          retention-days: 7


  ship:
    needs: [unity]
    if: >-
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.lane != '')
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include: # fmt: table
          - {platform: ios, os: macos-15, lane: "ios beta", artifact: glowtide-iOS}
          - {platform: android, os: ubuntu-24.04, lane: 'android beta', artifact: glowtide-Android}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    environment: store-uploads
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with: { name: "${{ matrix.artifact }}", path: build/ }
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3'
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Decode Play service account
        if: matrix.platform == 'android'
        run: echo "${{ secrets.PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64 }}" | base64 --decode > fastlane/play-service-account.json
      - name: fastlane ${{ matrix.lane }}
        run: |
          bundle exec fastlane ${{ matrix.lane }} \
            app:${{ env.APP }} \
            build_dir:build
          echo "::notice title=Uploaded::${{ env.APP }} ${{ github.ref_name }} → ${{ matrix.platform }}"
        env:
          MATCH_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MATCH_PASSWORD }}
          MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION: ${{ secrets.MATCH_GIT_BASIC_AUTHORIZATION }}
          ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
          ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
          ASC_KEY_P8: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
          SUPPLY_JSON_KEY: fastlane/play-service-account.json

  notify:
    needs: [beacon-tests, unity, ship]
    if: ${{ always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Summarize to Discord
        shell: python
        env:
          WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_RELEASES_WEBHOOK }}
          RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        # fmt: python
        run: |
          import json, os, urllib.request
          needs=json.loads(os.environ["RESULTS"])
          icon={'success':'✅','skipped':'⏭️'}
          lines=[f"{icon.get(v['result'],'❌')} {k}: {v['result']}" for k,v in needs.items()]
          body={"content":"**Mobile release** `%s`\n"%os.environ["GITHUB_REF_NAME"]+"\n".join(lines)}
          req=urllib.request.Request(os.environ["WEBHOOK"],data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"lanternfish-ci"})
          urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10)

#   kubectl apply -f kubernetes_multi_document.yaml

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: beacon
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: beacon
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: beacon-config
  namespace: beacon
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  WEB_CONCURRENCY: "2"
  PLAY_PACKAGE_NAMES: "studio.lanternfish.glowtide,studio.lanternfish.sprout"
  remote-config.json: |
    {
      "glowtide": {"min_supported_version": "1.7.0", "hint_cost_pearls": 1, "weekly_board": true},
      "sprout":   {"min_supported_version": "3.1.0", "paywall_variant": "B", "rating_prompt_after_waterings": 5}
    }
  leaderboards.toml: |-
    [weekly]
    reset_cron = "0 0 * * MON"
    max_entries = 5000
    # anti-cheat: anything above this per puzzle is rejected
    max_score_per_puzzle = 3200
---
apiVersion: bitnami.com/v1alpha1
kind: SealedSecret
metadata:
  name: beacon-secrets
  namespace: beacon
spec:
  # fmt: off
  encryptedData:
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: 
    ASC_KEY_P8:        
    PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: 
  # fmt: on
  template:
    metadata:
      name: beacon-secrets
      namespace: beacon
    type: Opaque
---

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: beacon-api
  namespace: beacon
  labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: beacon-api, app.kubernetes.io/part-of: beacon}
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "beacon 2.3.0 - receipts v2 + weekly boards"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: beacon-api
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: beacon-api
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'
        prometheus.io/port: "8000"
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      initContainers:
      - name: migrate
        image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:2.3.0
        command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
        env: &beacon-env
          - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef: {name: beacon-secrets, key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
          - name: DATABASE_URL
            value: postgresql+asyncpg://beacon:$(POSTGRES_PASSWORD)@beacon-db-rw.beacon.svc:5432/beacon
          - name: REDIS_URL
            value: "redis://beacon-redis-master:6379/0"
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:2.3.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args: ["uvicorn", "beacon.main:app", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=8000", "--proxy-headers"]
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
              protocol: TCP
          env: *beacon-env
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: beacon-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: remote-config
              mountPath: /etc/beacon/remote-config.json
              subPath: remote-config.json
              readOnly: true
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 192Mi }
            limits:
              memory: 384Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 3
      volumes:
        - name: remote-config
          configMap:
            name: beacon-config
            items:
              - key: remote-config.json
                path: remote-config.json

kind: Service
metadata: {name: beacon-api, namespace: beacon}
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: beacon-api
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: beacon
  namespace: beacon
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.middlewares: beacon-ratelimit@kubernetescrd
    # App Store Server Notifications v2 and Play RTDN (pub/sub push) need the raw body, so no body-rewriting middlewares on this ingress please
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
    - hosts: [api.lanternfish.studio]

  rules:
    - host: api.lanternfish.studio

        paths:
          - path: /

    "metrics": [

    ]
  }
}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: weekly-leaderboard-rollover
  namespace: beacon
  annotations:
    description: >
      Closes the current weekly Glowtide leaderboard season every Monday 00:00 UTC,
      archives the top 5000 entries to S3 and sends the "your weekly rank" push to everyone
      who submitted at least one score.
spec:
  schedule: "0 0 * * MON"
  timeZone: Etc/UTC
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: rollover
              image: ghcr.io/lanternfish/beacon:2.3.0
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - |
                  set -eu
                  python -m beacon.jobs.rollover --season "$(date -u +%G-W%V)"
                  python -m beacon.jobs.push_weekly_results --dry-run=false
              envFrom:
                - configMapRef: {name: beacon-config}
                - secretRef:
                    name: beacon-secrets
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: beacon-api
  namespace: beacon
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: beacon-api

arguments.content:
# CI for fernsolve: builds the C++ core + Python bindings against several MPI / BLAS combinations
# and runs the convergence regression suite. The nightly run also does a strong-scaling smoke test
# on the self-hosted runner that lives on a larch login node (yes, really -- RCS signed it off, see #741).
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '**.md'
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '17 3 * * *'     # 03:17 UTC, off the hour to dodge the GitHub cron stampede
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_scaling:
        description: Run the strong-scaling smoke test on the self-hosted larch runner (needs a 4-node allocation, ~40 min)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      rtol:
        description: "Relative residual tolerance for the regression suite"
        required: false
        default: '1e-10'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 4
  CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE: 1
  OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe: "yes"     # runners have 4 vCPUs, the MPI tests use up to 8 ranks
  PRTE_MCA_rmaps_default_mapping_policy: ':oversubscribe'
  FERN_TEST_RTOL: ${{ inputs.rtol || '1e-10' }}

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - &checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0     # setuptools-scm needs the tags
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12', cache: pip}
      - run: pip install pre-commit && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure

  build-test:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.compiler }} / ${{ matrix.mpi }}${{ matrix.blas && format(' / {0}', matrix.blas) || '' }}
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-22.04,
             macos-14]
        compiler: [gcc, clang]
        mpi: [openmpi, mpich]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-14
            mpi: mpich       # Homebrew mpich + Apple clang: Fortran ABI mismatch, see #812
          - {os: ubuntu-22.04, compiler: clang}
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            compiler: gcc
            mpi: openmpi
            blas: openblas-openmp
            coverage: true
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            compiler: intel-oneapi
            mpi: intelmpi
            blas: mkl
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - *checkout

      - name: Install toolchain (Ubuntu)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.compiler != 'intel-oneapi'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          case "${{ matrix.mpi }}" in
            openmpi) MPI_PKGS="libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin" ;;
            mpich)   MPI_PKGS="libmpich-dev mpich" ;;
          esac
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build $MPI_PKGS \
               libopenblas-openmp-dev liblapacke-dev libsuitesparse-dev

      - name: Install toolchain (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install ninja open-mpi openblas suite-sparse

      - name: Install Intel oneAPI
        if: matrix.compiler == 'intel-oneapi'
        uses: rscohn2/setup-oneapi@v0
        with:
          components: |
            icx@2025.0.4
            impi@2021.14.1
            mkl@2025.0.1

      - name: Configure
        shell: bash
        run: >
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
          -DFERN_ENABLE_MPI=ON
          -DFERN_BLAS_VENDOR=${{ matrix.blas || 'Generic' }}
          -DFERN_ENABLE_COVERAGE=${{ matrix.coverage && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'gcc' && 'gcc' || matrix.compiler == 'clang' && 'clang' || 'icx' }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'gcc' && 'g++' || matrix.compiler == 'clang' && 'clang++' || 'icpx' }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --target all fernsolve_python

      - name: Unit + MPI tests (1/2/4/8 ranks)
        working-directory: build
        run: ctest -L 'unit|mpi' --timeout 900 -j2
        env:
          OMP_NUM_THREADS: 1

      - name: Convergence regression suite
        run: |
          python -m pip install -e ".[test]" --no-build-isolation
          pytest tests/regression -q -n auto --rtol "$FERN_TEST_RTOL" \
            --junitxml=reports/regression-${{ strategy.job-index }}.xml
          {
            echo "### Regression summary (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.mpi }})"
            echo
            echo "| matrix | solver | iters | rel. residual |"
            echo "|---|---|---:|---:|"
            python tools/summarize_regression.py reports/ --format md-rows
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: ${{ matrix.coverage && !cancelled() }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.mpi }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  scaling-smoke:
    # Self-hosted runner `larch-login2` submits a 4-node job via sbatch and waits for it.
    # Only on schedule or manual dispatch, NEVER on pull_request (forks could run arbitrary code on the cluster)
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_scaling)
    needs: [ build-test ]
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, larch]
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      SBATCH_ACCOUNT: rse-fernsolve
      SBATCH_PARTITION: short
      SBATCH_TIMELIMIT: "00:45:00"
      SBATCH_EXCLUSIVE: 1
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Submit and wait
        id: submit
        run: |
          module purge
          module load gcc/13.2.0 openmpi/4.1.6 cmake/3.29.2 openblas/0.3.27
          jobid=$(sbatch --parsable --wait --nodes=4 --ntasks-per-node=64 --cpus-per-task=3 \
                    --output=scaling-%j.out ci/slurm/strong_scaling.sbatch)
          echo "jobid=${jobid}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          sacct -j "$jobid" --format=JobID,Elapsed,MaxRSS,State%20 -P | column -t -s '|'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: scaling-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            scaling-*.out
            build/scaling/*.csv
          retention-days: 14

raw_arguments.content:
# CI for fernsolve: builds the C++ core + Python bindings against several MPI / BLAS combinations
# and runs the convergence regression suite. The nightly run also does a strong-scaling smoke test
# on the self-hosted runner that lives on a larch login node (yes, really -- RCS signed it off, see #741).
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '**.md'
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '17 3 * * *'     # 03:17 UTC, off the hour to dodge the GitHub cron stampede
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_scaling:
        description: Run the strong-scaling smoke test on the self-hosted larch runner (needs a 4-node allocation, ~40 min)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      rtol:
        description: "Relative residual tolerance for the regression suite"
        required: false
        default: '1e-10'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL: 4
  CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE: 1
  OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe: "yes"     # runners have 4 vCPUs, the MPI tests use up to 8 ranks
  PRTE_MCA_rmaps_default_mapping_policy: ':oversubscribe'
  FERN_TEST_RTOL: ${{ inputs.rtol || '1e-10' }}

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - &checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0     # setuptools-scm needs the tags
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12', cache: pip}
      - run: pip install pre-commit && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure

  build-test:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.compiler }} / ${{ matrix.mpi }}${{ matrix.blas && format(' / {0}', matrix.blas) || '' }}
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-22.04,
             macos-14]
        compiler: [gcc, clang]
        mpi: [openmpi, mpich]
        exclude:
          - os: macos-14
            mpi: mpich       # Homebrew mpich + Apple clang: Fortran ABI mismatch, see #812
          - {os: ubuntu-22.04, compiler: clang}
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            compiler: gcc
            mpi: openmpi
            blas: openblas-openmp
            coverage: true
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            compiler: intel-oneapi
            mpi: intelmpi
            blas: mkl
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - *checkout

      - name: Install toolchain (Ubuntu)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.compiler != 'intel-oneapi'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          case "${{ matrix.mpi }}" in
            openmpi) MPI_PKGS="libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin" ;;
            mpich)   MPI_PKGS="libmpich-dev mpich" ;;
          esac
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ninja-build $MPI_PKGS \
               libopenblas-openmp-dev liblapacke-dev libsuitesparse-dev

      - name: Install toolchain (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install ninja open-mpi openblas suite-sparse

      - name: Install Intel oneAPI
        if: matrix.compiler == 'intel-oneapi'
        uses: rscohn2/setup-oneapi@v0
        with:
          components: |
            icx@2025.0.4
            impi@2021.14.1
            mkl@2025.0.1

      - name: Configure
        shell: bash
        run: >
          cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
          -DFERN_ENABLE_MPI=ON
          -DFERN_BLAS_VENDOR=${{ matrix.blas || 'Generic' }}
          -DFERN_ENABLE_COVERAGE=${{ matrix.coverage && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}
          -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'gcc' && 'gcc' || matrix.compiler == 'clang' && 'clang' || 'icx' }}
          -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${{ matrix.compiler == 'gcc' && 'g++' || matrix.compiler == 'clang' && 'clang++' || 'icpx' }}

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --target all fernsolve_python

      - name: Unit + MPI tests (1/2/4/8 ranks)
        working-directory: build
        run: ctest -L 'unit|mpi' --timeout 900 -j2
        env:
          OMP_NUM_THREADS: 1

      - name: Convergence regression suite
        run: |
          python -m pip install -e ".[test]" --no-build-isolation
          pytest tests/regression -q -n auto --rtol "$FERN_TEST_RTOL" \
            --junitxml=reports/regression-${{ strategy.job-index }}.xml
          {
            echo "### Regression summary (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.mpi }})"
            echo
            echo "| matrix | solver | iters | rel. residual |"
            echo "|---|---|---:|---:|"
            python tools/summarize_regression.py reports/ --format md-rows
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: ${{ matrix.coverage && !cancelled() }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.mpi }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  scaling-smoke:
    # Self-hosted runner `larch-login2` submits a 4-node job via sbatch and waits for it.
    # Only on schedule or manual dispatch, NEVER on pull_request (forks could run arbitrary code on the cluster)
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_scaling)
    needs: [ build-test ]
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, larch]
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      SBATCH_ACCOUNT: rse-fernsolve
      SBATCH_PARTITION: short
      SBATCH_TIMELIMIT: "00:45:00"
      SBATCH_EXCLUSIVE: 1
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - name: Submit and wait
        id: submit
        run: |
          module purge
          module load gcc/13.2.0 openmpi/4.1.6 cmake/3.29.2 openblas/0.3.27
          jobid=$(sbatch --parsable --wait --nodes=4 --ntasks-per-node=64 --cpus-per-task=3 \
                    --output=scaling-%j.out ci/slurm/strong_scaling.sbatch)
          echo "jobid=${jobid}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          sacct -j "$jobid" --format=JobID,Elapsed,MaxRSS,State%20 -P | column -t -s '|'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: scaling-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            scaling-*.out
            build/scaling/*.csv
          retention-days: 14

arguments.content:
# Genomics core -- k8s manifests for the variant-calling stack on the `okapi` research cluster.
# Rendered base for `kubectl apply -k deploy/overlays/prod`. Do not hand-edit in prod, edit deploy/base/*.yaml.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: genomics-varcall
  labels:
    lab: mensah-genomics
    cost-centre: "40217"
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata: {name: varcall-quota, namespace: genomics-varcall}
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "512"
    requests.memory: 2Ti
    limits.memory: 3Ti
    requests.nvidia.com/gpu: 4
    persistentvolumeclaims: "20"
--- # reference genomes + annotation, read-only for the pipeline pods
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: refdata
  namespace: genomics-varcall
  annotations:
    backup.velero.io/backup-volumes-excludes: "true"
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadOnlyMany]
  storageClassName: cephfs-ssd
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 750Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: varcall-config
  namespace: genomics-varcall
data:
  # plain KEY=value pairs, consumed with envFrom
  NXF_ANSI_LOG: "false"
  NXF_OPTS: -Xms1g -Xmx4g
  REF_BUILD: GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla
  nextflow.config: |
    process {
        executor = 'k8s'
        errorStrategy = { task.exitStatus in [137,140,143] ? 'retry' : 'finish' }
        maxRetries = 2
        withLabel: 'bwa' { cpus = 16; memory = { 48.GB * task.attempt } }
        withLabel:'deepvariant' {
            cpus = 32
            memory = 120.GB
            accelerator = [request: 1, type: 'nvidia.com/gpu']
        }
    }
    k8s {
        namespace = 'genomics-varcall'
        serviceAccount = 'nextflow'
        storageClaimName = 'refdata'
        storageMountPath = '/refdata'
    }
  # fmt: markdown
  README.md: |
    # varcall on okapi

    This namespace runs the **germline short-variant** pipeline (BWA-MEM2 → GATK MarkDuplicates/BQSR → DeepVariant → GLnexus) for the Genomics Core. Reference data under `/refdata` is read-only; ask in the #genomics-infra channel before touching it, a re-index of GRCh38 takes most of a day.

    * Submit with `nextflow run mensah-lab/varcall -r v3.2.0 -profile okapi --samplesheet s3://...`
    * Per-sample limits are 16 CPU / 48 GiB for alignment and one A100 for DeepVariant (`--gpu`), cf. the ResourceQuota above.
    *   Results land in `s3://mensah-lab-results/varcall/<run-id>/`; intermediate files are deleted after 14 days.

    Contacts: Dr. K. Mensah (PI), J. Ortiz (RSE)
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: s3-credentials
  namespace: genomics-varcall
type: Opaque
stringData:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: REPLACE_ME
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "REPLACE_ME"
  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: eu-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: https://s3.okapi.example.org
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: bwa-mem2-index-grch38
  namespace: genomics-varcall
  labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: refindex, app.kubernetes.io/part-of: varcall}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 1
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      nodeSelector:
        node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hm.8xlarge    # bwa-mem2 index needs ~64 GB for GRCh38
      containers:
      - name: index
        image: quay.io/biocontainers/bwa-mem2:2.2.1--he70b90d_6
        command: ["/bin/bash", "-euo", "pipefail", "-c"]
        args:
          - |
            cd /refdata/GRCh38
            if [[ -s GRCh38.fa.bwt.2bit.64 ]]; then echo "index exists, nothing to do"; exit 0; fi
            bwa-mem2 index -p GRCh38.fa GRCh38.fa 2>&1 | tee index.log
            sha256sum GRCh38.fa.* > GRCh38.index.sha256
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: "4", memory: 72Gi}
          limits:
            memory: 80Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - {name: refdata, mountPath: /refdata}
      volumes:
        - name: refdata
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: refdata-rw
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: clinvar-sync
  namespace: genomics-varcall
spec:
  schedule: "30 2 * * 0"     # Sundays 02:30, after NCBI's weekly ClinVar release
  timeZone: Europe/London
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: sync
              image: "ghcr.io/mensah-lab/refsync:1.4"
              args: [ "--source", "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/vcf_GRCh38/clinvar.vcf.gz",
                      "--dest", "/refdata/annotation/clinvar/",
                      "--keep", "8" ]
              envFrom:
                - secretRef: {name: s3-credentials}
                - configMapRef:
                    name: varcall-config
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: igv-web
  namespace: genomics-varcall
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: &igv-labels
      app.kubernetes.io/name: igv-web
      app.kubernetes.io/component: viewer
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *igv-labels
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 101
        fsGroup: 101
      containers:
        - name: igv
          image: ghcr.io/mensah-lab/igv-web:2.17.4-nginx
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              name: http
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}
            limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 512Mi}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: igv-web
  namespace: genomics-varcall
spec:
  selector: {app.kubernetes.io/name: igv-web, app.kubernetes.io/component: viewer}
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: http
...
# end of rendered base; overlays/prod adds the Ingress and the oauth2-proxy sidecar

# shop-web: storefront + recs manifests (prod-eu-west)
# Originally generated by kompose, hand-maintained ever since. Sorry.
# Apply with:  kubectl apply -f kubernetes_multi_document.yaml --server-side
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: shop-web
  labels:
    team: web-platform
    istio-injection: enabled
--- # ---------------- config ----------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: recs-config
  namespace: shop-web
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  RECS_MAX_ITEMS: "24"
  RECS_FALLBACK_STRATEGY: bestsellers
  ENABLE_PERSONALIZATION: "true"
  # fmt: json
  feature-flags.json: |
    {"pdp_carousel": {"enabled": true, "variant": "two_tower_v3", "rollout": 0.5},
     "cart_upsell": {"enabled": true,"max_items":4},
       "email_recs": {"enabled": false, "note": "waiting on the CRM consent flag"}}
  slots.yaml: |
    # rendered into the storefront at build time
    slots:
      - id: pdp-similar
        title: "You might also like"
        max: 12
      - id: cart-upsell
        title: Complete the look ✨
        max: 4
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: storefront-secrets
  namespace: shop-web
  annotations:
    # rotated by vault-agent, do NOT edit by hand
    vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject: 'true'
type: Opaque
stringData:
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: "sk_live_REPLACED_BY_VAULT"
  CMS_API_TOKEN: replaced-by-vault
  PREVIEW_SECRET: >-
    replaced-by-vault
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop-web
  labels: &storefront-labels
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: acme-shop
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "4.12.0"
spec:
  replicas: 6
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *storefront-labels
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: '9464'
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront}
      containers:
      - name: storefront
        image: registry.acme.example/web/storefront:4.12.0@sha256:3f1c9a7e2b4d6f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
          name: http
        - {containerPort: 9464, name: metrics}
        envFrom:
          - configMapRef: { name: storefront-config }
          - secretRef:
              name: storefront-secrets
        env:
          - name: NODE_ENV
            value: production
          - name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY
            value: "EUR"
          - name: RECS_URL
            value: http://recs.shop-web.svc.cluster.local:8081/v1
          - name: POD_IP
            valueFrom:
              fieldRef:
                fieldPath: status.podIP
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}
          limits:
            memory: 1Gi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: {path: /api/health, port: http}
          periodSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/health?deep=0
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 20
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 10"]
--- # svc
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: storefront, namespace: shop-web}
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop-web
  namespace: shop-web
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod

# shop-web: storefront + recs manifests (prod-eu-west)
# Originally generated by kompose, hand-maintained ever since. Sorry.
# Apply with:  kubectl apply -f kubernetes_multi_document.yaml --server-side
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: shop-web
  labels:
    team: web-platform
    istio-injection: enabled
--- # ---------------- config ----------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: recs-config
  namespace: shop-web
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  RECS_MAX_ITEMS: "24"
  RECS_FALLBACK_STRATEGY: bestsellers
  ENABLE_PERSONALIZATION: "true"
  # fmt: json
  feature-flags.json: |
    {"pdp_carousel": {"enabled": true, "variant": "two_tower_v3", "rollout": 0.5},
     "cart_upsell": {"enabled": true,"max_items":4},
       "email_recs": {"enabled": false, "note": "waiting on the CRM consent flag"}}
  slots.yaml: |
    # rendered into the storefront at build time
    slots:
      - id: pdp-similar
        title: "You might also like"
        max: 12
      - id: cart-upsell
        title: Complete the look ✨
        max: 4
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: storefront-secrets
  namespace: shop-web
  annotations:
    # rotated by vault-agent, do NOT edit by hand
    vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject: 'true'
type: Opaque
stringData:
  STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: "sk_live_REPLACED_BY_VAULT"
  CMS_API_TOKEN: replaced-by-vault
  PREVIEW_SECRET: >-
    replaced-by-vault
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop-web
  labels: &storefront-labels
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: acme-shop
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "4.12.0"
spec:
  replicas: 6
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *storefront-labels
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: '9464'
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront}
      containers:
      - name: storefront
        image: registry.acme.example/web/storefront:4.12.0@sha256:3f1c9a7e2b4d6f8091a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f7a8
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
          name: http
        - {containerPort: 9464, name: metrics}
        envFrom:
          - configMapRef: { name: storefront-config }
          - secretRef:
              name: storefront-secrets
        env:
          - name: NODE_ENV
            value: production
          - name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CURRENCY
            value: "EUR"
          - name: RECS_URL
            value: http://recs.shop-web.svc.cluster.local:8081/v1
          - name: POD_IP
            valueFrom:
              fieldRef:
                fieldPath: status.podIP
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi}
          limits:
            memory: 1Gi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: {path: /api/health, port: http}
          periodSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/health?deep=0
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 20
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 10"]

kind: Service
metadata: {name: storefront, namespace: shop-web}
spec:
