arguments.content:
# .github/workflows/ci.yml -- main pipeline for the Lumen monorepo
#
#   sdk/python  -> ruff, pytest matrix, integration tests against real services
#   packages/*  -> eslint + vitest per workspace package
#   crates/*    -> clippy + cargo test on stable and on the MSRV
#
# Job names are referenced by branch protection and the merge queue: talk to
# release-eng (#ci-help) before renaming anything.
# yamllint disable rule:line-length rule:truthy
name: "CI: build, test & release"

"on":
  push:
    branches: [main, "release/**"]
    tags: ["v*.*.*", "sdk-v*"]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "docs/**"
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  merge_group: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * 1-5"   # weekday nightly, deliberately off the hour
    - cron: '0 12 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run-benchmarks:
        description: "Run benchmarks: slow (~40 min)"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      publish-target:
        description: 'Registry to publish to # leave empty for a dry run'
        type: choice
        options: ["", npm, pypi, crates, all]
        default: ""
      log-level:
        description: RUST_LOG / LOG_LEVEL override
        required: false
        default: null

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
  VITEST_HOOK_TIMEOUT: 1e3
  DEFAULT_UMASK: 0022
  LOG_LEVEL: ${{ inputs.log-level || 'info' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect changed areas
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      python: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.python }}
      node: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.node }}
      rust: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.rust }}
    steps:
      - &checkout
        name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            python:
              - 'sdk/python/**'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
            node:
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            rust:
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.lock'

  lint:
    name: "Lint: ruff, eslint, clippy"
    needs: changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    env: &lint-env
      RUFF_OUTPUT_FORMAT: github
      ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG: "true"
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: &node-with
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint
        run: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" lint -- --max-warnings=0
      - name: Ruff
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with: { src: sdk/python, args: "check --output-format=github" }
      - name: Clippy
        if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

  test-python:
    name: "Python ${{ matrix.python }} / ${{ matrix.os }}"
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.python == 'true' || github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14, windows-2022]
        python: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
        experimental: [false]
        exclude:
          - { os: macos-14, python: "3.10" }
          - { os: windows-2022, python: "3.11" }
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, python: "3.14-dev", experimental: true, label: "nightly CPython", pip-cache: ~/.cache/pip }
          - { os: windows-2022, python: "3.12", experimental: false, label: "Windows / py3.12", pip-cache: '~\AppData\Local\pip\Cache' }
    env:
      <<: *lint-env
      COVERAGE_FILE: .coverage.${{ matrix.os }}.${{ matrix.python }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: sdk/python
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: "sdk/python/requirements/*.txt"
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel
          python -m pip install -e ".[test]" -c requirements/constraints.txt
      - name: Unit tests
        run: |
          pytest -q -n auto --cov=lumen --cov-report=xml \
            --junitxml="reports/junit-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}.xml" \
            -m "not integration and not slow"
      # - name: Upload coverage to Codecov (disabled: token rotation, see #4471)
      #   uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
      #   with:
      #     files: sdk/python/coverage.xml
      #     flags: python-${{ matrix.python }}

  integration:
    name: Integration (postgres + redis)
    needs: test-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env: &db-env
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: lumen_test
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports: ["6379:6379"]
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: "3.12", cache: pip, cache-dependency-path: "sdk/python/requirements/*.txt" }
      - name: Run integration suite
        env:
          <<: [*lint-env, *db-env]
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/lumen_test
          REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:6379/0"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install -e "sdk/python[test,postgres]"
          pytest sdk/python/tests/integration \
            --junitxml=reports/junit-integration.xml \
            -m "integration and not slow" -p no:cacheprovider
          echo "### Integration summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          python scripts/ci/summarize_junit.py reports/junit-integration.xml >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  test-node:
    name: "Node ${{ matrix.node }}: ${{ matrix.package }}"
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.node == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    strategy:
      matrix:
        package: ['@lumen/core', '@lumen/react', "@lumen/cli", '@scope/pkg']
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          <<: *node-with
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --filter "${{ matrix.package }}" test -- --coverage --reporter=junit --outputFile=reports/junit.xml

  rust:
    name: "Rust (${{ matrix.toolchain }}, ${{ matrix.os }})"
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions: { contents: read }
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14]
        toolchain: [stable, "1.79"]   # 1.79 == MSRV, bump together with Cargo.toml
    env:
      SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED: "true"
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with: { toolchain: "${{ matrix.toolchain }}", components: "clippy, rustfmt" }
      - uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.6
      - run: cargo test --workspace --locked --all-features
      - name: Benchmarks (manual runs only)
        if: inputs.run-benchmarks && matrix.toolchain == 'stable' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo bench -p lumen-core -- --output-format bencher | tee bench.txt

  release:
    name: Publish packages
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.publish-target != ''
    needs: [integration, test-node, rust]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment:
      name: release
      url: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ github.ref_name }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write      # trusted publishing (PyPI) + npm provenance
      attestations: write
    env:
      BIN_MODE: 0755
      PUBLISH_TARGET: ${{ inputs.publish-target || 'all' }}
    steps:
      - <<: *checkout
        with: { fetch-depth: 1, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Build artifacts
        run: |
          make dist
          find dist -type f -name 'lumen-*' -exec install -m "$BIN_MODE" {} dist/bin/ \;
          ls -la dist/
      - name: Write release metadata
        run: |
          cat > dist/release.json <<'JSON'
          {
            "version": "${{ github.ref_name }}",
            "commit": "${{ github.sha }}",
            "packages": ["@lumen/core", "@lumen/react", "lumen-sdk", "lumen-core"],
            "channels": { "npm": "latest", "pypi": "stable" }
          }
          JSON
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            dist/*.whl
            dist/*.tar.gz
            dist/release.json
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: "C0123ABCD"
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "Release ${{ github.ref_name }}: ${{ job.status }}",
              "blocks": [
                { "type": "section", "text": { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*${{ github.ref_name }}* finished with `${{ job.status }}` <${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|logs>" } }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

raw_arguments.content:
# .github/workflows/ci.yml -- main pipeline for the Lumen monorepo
#
#   sdk/python  -> ruff, pytest matrix, integration tests against real services
#   packages/*  -> eslint + vitest per workspace package
#   crates/*    -> clippy + cargo test on stable and on the MSRV
#
# Job names are referenced by branch protection and the merge queue: talk to
# release-eng (#ci-help) before renaming anything.
# yamllint disable rule:line-length rule:truthy
name: "CI: build, test & release"

"on":
  push:
    branches: [main, "release/**"]
    tags: ["v*.*.*", "sdk-v*"]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "docs/**"
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  merge_group: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 3 * * 1-5"   # weekday nightly, deliberately off the hour
    - cron: '0 12 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run-benchmarks:
        description: "Run benchmarks: slow (~40 min)"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      publish-target:
        description: 'Registry to publish to # leave empty for a dry run'
        type: choice
        options: ["", npm, pypi, crates, all]
        default: ""
      log-level:
        description: RUST_LOG / LOG_LEVEL override
        required: false
        default: null

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
  VITEST_HOOK_TIMEOUT: 1e3
  DEFAULT_UMASK: 0022
  LOG_LEVEL: ${{ inputs.log-level || 'info' }}

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect changed areas
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      python: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.python }}
      node: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.node }}
      rust: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.rust }}
    steps:
      - &checkout
        name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            python:
              - 'sdk/python/**'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
            node:
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            rust:
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'Cargo.lock'

  lint:
    name: "Lint: ruff, eslint, clippy"
    needs: changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    env: &lint-env
      RUFF_OUTPUT_FORMAT: github
      ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG: "true"
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: &node-with
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: ESLint
        run: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" lint -- --max-warnings=0
      - name: Ruff
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with: { src: sdk/python, args: "check --output-format=github" }
      - name: Clippy
        if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

  test-python:
    name: "Python ${{ matrix.python }} / ${{ matrix.os }}"
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.python == 'true' || github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14, windows-2022]
        python: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
        experimental: [false]
        exclude:
          - { os: macos-14, python: "3.10" }
          - { os: windows-2022, python: "3.11" }
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04, python: "3.14-dev", experimental: true, label: "nightly CPython", pip-cache: ~/.cache/pip }
          - { os: windows-2022, python: "3.12", experimental: false, label: "Windows / py3.12", pip-cache: '~\AppData\Local\pip\Cache' }
    env:
      <<: *lint-env
      COVERAGE_FILE: .coverage.${{ matrix.os }}.${{ matrix.python }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: sdk/python
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: "sdk/python/requirements/*.txt"
      - name: Install
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel
          python -m pip install -e ".[test]" -c requirements/constraints.txt
      - name: Unit tests
        run: |
          pytest -q -n auto --cov=lumen --cov-report=xml \
            --junitxml="reports/junit-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python }}.xml" \
            -m "not integration and not slow"
      # - name: Upload coverage to Codecov (disabled: token rotation, see #4471)
      #   uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
      #   with:
      #     files: sdk/python/coverage.xml
      #     flags: python-${{ matrix.python }}

  integration:
    name: Integration (postgres + redis)
    needs: test-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env: &db-env
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: lumen_test
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports: ["6379:6379"]
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: "3.12", cache: pip, cache-dependency-path: "sdk/python/requirements/*.txt" }
      - name: Run integration suite
        env:
          <<: [*lint-env, *db-env]
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/lumen_test
          REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:6379/0"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install -e "sdk/python[test,postgres]"
          pytest sdk/python/tests/integration \
            --junitxml=reports/junit-integration.xml \
            -m "integration and not slow" -p no:cacheprovider
          echo "### Integration summary" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          python scripts/ci/summarize_junit.py reports/junit-integration.xml >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  test-node:
    name: "Node ${{ matrix.node }}: ${{ matrix.package }}"
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.node == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: { contents: read }
    strategy:
      matrix:
        package: ['@lumen/core', '@lumen/react', "@lumen/cli", '@scope/pkg']
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          <<: *node-with
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --filter "${{ matrix.package }}" test -- --coverage --reporter=junit --outputFile=reports/junit.xml

  rust:
    name: "Rust (${{ matrix.toolchain }}, ${{ matrix.os }})"
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    permissions: { contents: read }
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-14]
        toolchain: [stable, "1.79"]   # 1.79 == MSRV, bump together with Cargo.toml
    env:
      SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED: "true"
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with: { toolchain: "${{ matrix.toolchain }}", components: "clippy, rustfmt" }
      - uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.6
      - run: cargo test --workspace --locked --all-features
      - name: Benchmarks (manual runs only)
        if: inputs.run-benchmarks && matrix.toolchain == 'stable' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo bench -p lumen-core -- --output-format bencher | tee bench.txt

  release:
    name: Publish packages
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.publish-target != ''
    needs: [integration, test-node, rust]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment:
      name: release
      url: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ github.ref_name }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write      # trusted publishing (PyPI) + npm provenance
      attestations: write
    env:
      BIN_MODE: 0755
      PUBLISH_TARGET: ${{ inputs.publish-target || 'all' }}
    steps:
      - <<: *checkout
        with: { fetch-depth: 1, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Build artifacts
        run: |
          make dist
          find dist -type f -name 'lumen-*' -exec install -m "$BIN_MODE" {} dist/bin/ \;
          ls -la dist/
      - name: Write release metadata
        run: |
          cat > dist/release.json <<'JSON'
          {
            "version": "${{ github.ref_name }}",
            "commit": "${{ github.sha }}",
            "packages": ["@lumen/core", "@lumen/react", "lumen-sdk", "lumen-core"],
            "channels": { "npm": "latest", "pypi": "stable" }
          }
          JSON
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            dist/*.whl
            dist/*.tar.gz
            dist/release.json
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.27.0
        with:
          channel-id: "C0123ABCD"
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "Release ${{ github.ref_name }}: ${{ job.status }}",
              "blocks": [
                { "type": "section", "text": { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*${{ github.ref_name }}* finished with `${{ job.status }}` <${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}|logs>" } }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}

arguments.content:
# ledger: rendered manifests for namespace fin-ledger
#
# Source of truth is deploy/helm/ledger (chart 3.9.1). This file is committed so
# Argo CD diffs stay reviewable, and for whoever still runs `kubectl apply -f`:
#   kubectl apply --server-side --field-manager=platform -f kubernetes_multi_document.yaml
# YAML anchors are scoped to one document -- never alias across a `---`.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: fin-ledger
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    istio-injection: enabled
    "finance.example.com/cost-center": "CC-4410"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: { name: ledger-config, namespace: fin-ledger, labels: { app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger, app.kubernetes.io/part-of: finance-core } }
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  HTTP_PORT: "8080"
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS: "*"
  PLUGIN_PACKAGES: '@finance/ledger-plugins'
  appsettings.json: |
    {
      "Ledger": {
        "PostingBatchSize": 500,
        "Currencies": ["EUR", "USD", "GBP", "CHF"],
        "Rounding": { "Mode": "HalfEven", "Scale": 4 }
      },
      "ConnectionStrings": { "Ledger": "Host=pg-ledger-rw.fin-ledger.svc;Database=ledger;Username=ledger" }
    }
  wait-for-db.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    # Blocks until the primary accepts connections (max ~2 minutes).
    set -eu
    i=0
    until pg_isready -h "${DB_HOST:-pg-ledger-rw}" -p 5432 -q; do
      i=$((i + 1))
      if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then echo "database not ready: giving up" >&2; exit 1; fi
      sleep 2
    done
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ledger-api
  namespace: fin-ledger
  labels: &common_labels
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: finance-core
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: helm
    helm.sh/chart: ledger-3.9.1
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1"
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: null
  creationTimestamp: null
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0 }
  selector:
    matchLabels: &selector_labels
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger
      app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        <<: [*common_labels, *selector_labels]
        version: "3.9.1"
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "9090"
        checksum/config: 6f1c0e9b2f8d4a3c7e5b1a0d9c8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ledger
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }
      imagePullSecrets: []
      tolerations: []
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector: { matchLabels: *selector_labels }
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-for-db
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        command: ["/bin/sh", "/scripts/wait-for-db.sh"]
        volumeMounts: [{ name: scripts, mountPath: /scripts, readOnly: true }]
        securityContext: &container_security
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: "registry.example.com/finance/ledger-api:3.9.1@sha256:9b2c4f0e1d7a6b5c3e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d"
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        args: ["--config=/etc/ledger/appsettings.json", "--http-port=$(HTTP_PORT)"]
        ports:
        - { name: http, containerPort: 8080, protocol: TCP }
        - { name: metrics, containerPort: 9090 }
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef: { name: ledger-config }
        env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef: { name: pg-ledger-app, key: password }
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }
        resources: &api_resources
          requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 384Mi }
          limits: { cpu: "2", memory: 1Gi }
        livenessProbe: &http_probe
          httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: http }
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
          failureThreshold: 3
        readinessProbe:
          <<: *http_probe
          httpGet: { path: "/readyz?verbose=false", port: http }
          failureThreshold: 1
        startupProbe:
          <<: *http_probe
          failureThreshold: 30
        securityContext: *container_security
        volumeMounts:
        - { name: config, mountPath: /etc/ledger, readOnly: true }
        - { name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp }
      - name: otel-agent
        image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.108.0
        args: ["--config=env:OTEL_CONFIG"]
        resources:
          <<: *api_resources
          limits: { cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi }
        securityContext:
          <<: *container_security
          runAsUser: 10002
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: ledger-config
          items: [{ key: appsettings.json, path: appsettings.json }]
      - name: scripts
        configMap: { name: ledger-config, defaultMode: 0755, items: [{ key: wait-for-db.sh, path: wait-for-db.sh }] }
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ledger-api
  namespace: fin-ledger
  annotations: { service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-internal: "true", external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/hostname: ledger.internal.example.com. }
spec:
  selector: { app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger, app.kubernetes.io/component: api }
  ports:
    - { name: http, port: 80, targetPort: http }
    - { name: metrics, port: 9090, targetPort: metrics, appProtocol: http }
---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata: { name: ledger-api, namespace: fin-ledger }
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: ledger-api }
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 24
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 }
    - type: Pods
      pods:
        metric: { name: ledger_http_requests_per_second }
        target: { type: AverageValue, averageValue: 1e3 }
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies: [{ type: Percent, value: 20, periodSeconds: 60 }]
    scaleUp: {}
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: postingrules.ledger.finance.example.com
  annotations:
    controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version: v0.16.1
spec:
  group: ledger.finance.example.com
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    kind: PostingRule
    listKind: PostingRuleList
    plural: postingrules
    singular: postingrule
    shortNames: [prule]
  versions:
    - name: v1beta1
      served: true
      storage: true
      subresources:
        status: {}
      additionalPrinterColumns:
        - { name: Account, type: string, jsonPath: .spec.account }
        - { name: Ready, type: string, jsonPath: '.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status' }
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          description: PostingRule maps an incoming business event to one or more balanced ledger postings.
          required: [spec]
          properties:
            apiVersion:
              type: string
              description: 'APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values.'
            kind:
              type: string
              description: "Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents: CamelCase, singular."
            metadata:
              type: object
            spec:
              type: object
              description: |
                Desired behaviour of the rule.

                Rules are evaluated in ascending `priority`; the first match wins.
                Amounts are minor units (cents), never floats.
              required: [account, match, legs]
              properties:
                account:
                  type: string
                  description: Ledger account code, e.g. "4000-REVENUE".
                  pattern: '^[0-9]{4}-[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$'
                priority:
                  type: integer
                  description: Lower runs first.
                  default: 100
                  minimum: 0
                match:
                  type: object
                  description: Event selector.
                  properties:
                    eventType:
                      type: string
                      description: CloudEvents `type` attribute; glob patterns such as "payments.*" are allowed.
                    source:
                      type: string
                      description: Optional CloudEvents source. "*" matches any source.
                      default: "*"
                    attributes:
                      type: object
                      additionalProperties: { type: string }
                legs:
                  type: array
                  description: Debit/credit legs; must sum to zero per currency.
                  minItems: 2
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [direction, account, amountExpr]
                    properties:
                      direction: { type: string, enum: [debit, credit], description: "Side of the posting: debit or credit." }
                      account: { type: string, description: Target account code. }
                      amountExpr:
                        type: string
                        description: >-
                          CEL expression evaluated against the event payload;
                          must return an int (minor units).
                      metadata:
                        type: object
                        x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
            status:
              type: object
              description: Observed state, written by the ledger-operator.
              properties:
                observedGeneration: { type: integer, format: int64 }
                conditions:
                  type: array
                  x-kubernetes-list-type: map
                  x-kubernetes-list-map-keys: [type]
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [type, status]

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: fin-ledger
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
    istio-injection: enabled
    "finance.example.com/cost-center": "CC-4410"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: { name: ledger-config, namespace: fin-ledger, labels: { app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger, app.kubernetes.io/part-of: finance-core } }
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  HTTP_PORT: "8080"
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS: "*"
  PLUGIN_PACKAGES: '@finance/ledger-plugins'
  appsettings.json: |
    {
      "Ledger": {
        "PostingBatchSize": 500,
        "Currencies": ["EUR", "USD", "GBP", "CHF"],
        "Rounding": { "Mode": "HalfEven", "Scale": 4 }
      },
      "ConnectionStrings": { "Ledger": "Host=pg-ledger-rw.fin-ledger.svc;Database=ledger;Username=ledger" }
    }
  wait-for-db.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    # Blocks until the primary accepts connections (max ~2 minutes).
    set -eu
    i=0
    until pg_isready -h "${DB_HOST:-pg-ledger-rw}" -p 5432 -q; do
      i=$((i + 1))
      if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then echo "database not ready: giving up" >&2; exit 1; fi
      sleep 2
    done
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ledger-api
  namespace: fin-ledger
  labels: &common_labels
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: finance-core
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: helm
    helm.sh/chart: ledger-3.9.1
  annotations:

    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: null
  creationTimestamp: null
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5

    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0 }
  selector:
    matchLabels: &selector_labels
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger
      app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        <<: [*common_labels, *selector_labels]
        version: "3.9.1"
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "9090"
        checksum/config: 6f1c0e9b2f8d4a3c7e5b1a0d9c8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ledger
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 45
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile: { type: RuntimeDefault }
      imagePullSecrets: []
      tolerations: []
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
        labelSelector: { matchLabels: *selector_labels }
      initContainers:
      - name: wait-for-db
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        command: ["/bin/sh", "/scripts/wait-for-db.sh"]
        volumeMounts: [{ name: scripts, mountPath: /scripts, readOnly: true }]
        securityContext: &container_security
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: "registry.example.com/finance/ledger-api:3.9.1@sha256:9b2c4f0e1d7a6b5c3e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d"
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        args: ["--config=/etc/ledger/appsettings.json", "--http-port=$(HTTP_PORT)"]
        ports:
        - { name: http, containerPort: 8080, protocol: TCP }
        - { name: metrics, containerPort: 9090 }
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef: { name: ledger-config }
        env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef: { name: pg-ledger-app, key: password }
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom: { fieldRef: { fieldPath: metadata.name } }
        resources: &api_resources
          requests: { cpu: 250m, memory: 384Mi }
          limits: { cpu: "2", memory: 1Gi }
        livenessProbe: &http_probe
          httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: http }
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
          failureThreshold: 3
        readinessProbe:
          <<: *http_probe
          httpGet: { path: "/readyz?verbose=false", port: http }
          failureThreshold: 1
        startupProbe:
          <<: *http_probe
          failureThreshold: 30
        securityContext: *container_security
        volumeMounts:
        - { name: config, mountPath: /etc/ledger, readOnly: true }
        - { name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp }
      - name: otel-agent
        image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.108.0
        args: ["--config=env:OTEL_CONFIG"]
        resources:
          <<: *api_resources
          limits: { cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi }
        securityContext:
          <<: *container_security
          runAsUser: 10002
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: ledger-config
          items: [{ key: appsettings.json, path: appsettings.json }]
      - name: scripts
        configMap: { name: ledger-config, defaultMode: 0755, items: [{ key: wait-for-db.sh, path: wait-for-db.sh }] }
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ledger-api

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2

openapi: 3.1.0
# Public contract for the Tessera Billing API.
# Edited by hand AND by `make openapi-sync` (which only rewrites components/schemas),
# so keep long-form notes in the description blocks rather than in comments.
#
#   npx @redocly/cli lint openapi.yaml
#   npx @redocly/cli preview-docs openapi.yaml --port 8089
info:
  title: Tessera Billing API
  version: "2024-11-01"
  summary: Invoices, subscriptions and usage-based billing.
  description: |
    # Introduction

    The Tessera Billing API is organised around **REST**. It has predictable,
    resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON request bodies, returns JSON responses and uses standard HTTP verbs and status codes.

    ## Versioning
    * The API version is a date, sent in the `Tessera-Version` header.
    * Breaking changes always ship behind a new date; additive changes do not:
      - new optional request fields
      - new response fields
          + new enum values -- your client **must** tolerate unknown values

    | Header | Required | Example | Notes |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `Authorization` | yes | `Bearer tsk_live_…` | Secret keys never belong in browsers or mobile apps |
    | `Tessera-Version` | no | `2024-11-01` | Defaults to the version pinned on your account |
    | `Idempotency-Key` | POST only | `9f1c2e…` | Keys expire after 24 hours |

    ```bash
    curl https://api.tessera.example/v2/invoices \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $TESSERA_KEY" -H "Tessera-Version: 2024-11-01"
    ```

    > **Note:** amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (cents for `usd`).
  termsOfService: https://tessera.example/legal/terms
  contact: { name: Tessera Developer Relations, url: "https://tessera.example/support", email: api@tessera.example }
  license: { name: Apache 2.0, identifier: Apache-2.0 }
  x-sdk-packages: { npm: '@tessera/billing', pypi: tessera-billing, go: "github.com/tessera/billing-go" }

servers:
  - url: https://api.tessera.example/v2
    description: Production
  - url: "https://{region}.sandbox.tessera.example/v2"
    description: Sandbox (data reset every Sunday 00:00 UTC)
    variables:
      region:
        default: eu
        enum: [eu, us, ap]
        description: "Data residency region: use the one your account lives in."

security:
  - bearerAuth: []
  - oauth2: ["billing:read"]

tags:
  - name: Invoices
    description: Create, finalize and pay invoices.
  - name: Status
    description: |
      Unauthenticated health endpoint. Safe to poll every few seconds;
      responses are cached at the edge for **5 s**.
  - name: Webhooks
    x-displayName: "Webhooks & events"

x-response-sets:   # merged into operations below with `<<`
  auth-errors: &auth_errors
    "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
    "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
  common-errors: &common_errors
    "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/RateLimited" }
    5XX: { $ref: "#/components/responses/ServerError" }

paths:
  /status:
    get:
      operationId: getStatus
      tags: [Status]
      security:
        - {}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Service is up.
          headers:
            Access-Control-Allow-Origin:
              schema: { type: string, examples: ["*"] }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, enum: [ok, degraded] }
                  incident_url: { type: [string, "null"], format: uri, default: null }
  /invoices:
    get:
      operationId: listInvoices
      summary: List invoices
      tags: [Invoices]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/StartingAfter'
        - name: status
          in: query
          description: Filter by status. Repeat the parameter to match several, e.g. `?status=open&status=draft`.
          schema:
            type: array
            items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvoiceStatus" }
          style: form
          explode: true
      responses:
        <<: [*auth_errors, *common_errors]
        "200":
          description: A page of invoices, newest first.
          headers:
            X-RateLimit-Remaining: { description: Requests left in the current window., schema: { type: integer } }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [data, has_more]
                properties:
                  data: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice" } }
                  has_more: { type: boolean }
                  next_cursor: { type: [string, "null"] }
    post:
      operationId: createInvoice
      summary: Create an invoice
      tags: [Invoices]
      description: |
        Creates a **draft** invoice. Lines can be passed inline or added later with
        [`POST /invoices/{id}/lines`](#tag/Invoices/operation/addInvoiceLine).

        1. Draft invoices can be edited freely.
        2. Finalizing assigns a number (`INV-2024-000123`) and locks the lines.
        3. Paid invoices are immutable -- issue a credit note instead.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          schema: { type: string, maxLength: 255 }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvoiceCreate" }
            examples:
              one-off:
                summary: One-off invoice with a flat line
                value: { customer: cus_Q2w3E4r5T6y7U8, currency: eur, collection_method: send_invoice, days_until_due: 30, lines: [{ kind: flat, description: "Onboarding workshop #1", amount: 150000 }] }
              metered:
                summary: Usage line priced from a meter
                value:
                  customer: cus_Q2w3E4r5T6y7U8
                  currency: usd
                  lines:
                    - kind: usage
                      meter: api_requests
                      quantity: 1e3
                      unit_amount_decimal: "0.0425"
      responses:
        <<: *auth_errors
        "201":
          description: The created draft invoice.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice" }
        "409":
          description: "Idempotency conflict: the key was already used with a different body."
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }

webhooks:
  invoice.finalized:
    post:
      summary: Invoice finalized
      description: Sent once per invoice. Delivery is *at least once*; deduplicate on `id`.
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              allOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/EventEnvelope"
                - type: object
                  properties:
                    type: { const: invoice.finalized }
                    data: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice" }
      responses:
        "2XX": { description: Acknowledge within 10 seconds or the delivery is retried. }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: "tsk_(live|test)_*"
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          authorizationUrl: https://auth.tessera.example/oauth/authorize
          tokenUrl: https://auth.tessera.example/oauth/token
          scopes:
            "billing:read": Read invoices, subscriptions and usage
            "billing:write": Create and modify billing objects
            "webhooks:manage": "Manage webhook endpoints (admin only: requires 2FA)"
  parameters:
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 25 }
    StartingAfter:
      name: starting_after
      in: query
      description: Cursor taken from `next_cursor` of the previous page.
      schema: { type: string }
  responses:
    Unauthorized: &problem_response
      description: Missing or invalid credentials.
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Problem" }
    Forbidden:
      <<: *problem_response
      description: The key is valid but lacks the required scope.
    RateLimited:
      <<: *problem_response
      description: "Too many requests: back off using the `Retry-After` header."
    ServerError:
      <<: *problem_response
      description: Something went wrong on our side. Idempotent requests are safe to retry.
  schemas:
    InvoiceStatus:
      type: string
      enum: [draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible]
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amount, currency]
      properties:
        amount: { type: integer, description: Minor units. }
        currency: { type: string, pattern: "^[a-z]{3}$", examples: [eur, usd] }
    Invoice:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Timestamps"
        - type: object
          required: [id, status, customer, total]
          properties:
            id: { type: string, readOnly: true, examples: [in_1PqRsTuVwXyZ01] }
            number: { type: [string, "null"], examples: ["INV-2024-000123", null] }
            status: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvoiceStatus" }
            customer: { type: string }
            total: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Money" }
            lines: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvoiceLine" } }
            metadata:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: { type: string, maxLength: 500 }
              default: {}
      examples:
        - { id: in_1PqRsTuVwXyZ01, number: null, status: draft, customer: cus_Q2w3E4r5T6y7U8, total: { amount: 150000, currency: eur }, created_at: "2024-11-04T09:30:00Z" }
    InvoiceCreate:
      type: object
      required: [customer, currency]
      properties:
        customer: { type: string }
        currency: { type: string }
        collection_method: { type: string, enum: [charge_automatically, send_invoice], default: charge_automatically }
        days_until_due: { type: integer, minimum: 0, description: "Required when `collection_method: send_invoice`." }
        lines: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/InvoiceLine" }, maxItems: 250 }
    InvoiceLine:
      description: |
        A line is either a **flat** amount or a **usage** charge. The `kind`
        property selects the variant:

        | kind | priced by | example |
        |------|-----------|---------|
        | `flat` | `amount` | setup fee |
        | `usage` | `meter` x `unit_amount_decimal` | API calls |
      oneOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/FlatLine"
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/UsageLine"
      discriminator:
        propertyName: kind
        mapping:
          flat: "#/components/schemas/FlatLine"
          usage: "#/components/schemas/UsageLine"
    FlatLine:
      type: object
      required: [kind, amount]
      properties:
        kind: { const: flat }
        description: { type: string, maxLength: 500 }
        amount: { type: integer }
    UsageLine:
      type: object
      required: [kind, meter, quantity]
      properties:
        kind: { const: usage }
        meter: { type: string, description: "Meter slug, e.g. `api_requests`." }
        quantity: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
        unit_amount_decimal: { type: string, pattern: '^\d+(\.\d{1,12})?$' }
    Timestamps:
      type: object
      properties:
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time, readOnly: true }
        updated_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time, readOnly: true }
    EventEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, created_at]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, examples: [evt_1QxYz8AbCdEf] }
        type: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        livemode: { type: boolean }
    Problem:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem details.
      properties:
        type: { type: string, format: uri, default: "about:blank" }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer }
        detail: { type: string }
        errors:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              pointer: { type: string, examples: ["#/lines/0/amount"] }
              message: { type: string }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""relctl -- release orchestration for the Meridian monorepo.

Single file on purpose: CI images vendor it without a package install step.
Requires Python 3.11+ (``tomllib``, ``enum.StrEnum``).

Maintainers: release-eng (#rel-eng on Slack). Please keep the subcommands
alphabetised in ``build_parser`` -- the docs generator relies on it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import dataclasses
import enum
import json
import logging
import os
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import sys
import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, ClassVar, Final, Literal, TypeAlias

__version__ = "2.7.0"

log = logging.getLogger("relctl")

DEFAULT_CONFIG: Final = Path("relctl.toml")
SEMVER_RE: Final = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<major>0|[1-9]\d*)\.(?P<minor>0|[1-9]\d*)\.(?P<patch>0|[1-9]\d*)"
    r"(?:-(?P<pre>[0-9A-Za-z.-]+))?(?:\+(?P<build>[0-9A-Za-z.-]+))?$"
)
CONVENTIONAL_RE: Final = re.compile(r"^(?P<type>\w+)(?:\([^)]*\))?(?P<bang>!)?: (?P<desc>.+)$")
BumpKind: TypeAlias = Literal["major", "minor", "patch", "pre"]
EXIT_OK, EXIT_FAILURE, EXIT_CONFIG, EXIT_PUBLISH = 0, 1, 3, 4

# fmt: markdown
HELP_EPILOG = r"""
## Examples

* Plan a release for everything that changed since the last tag:
  `relctl plan --since v4.12.0`
* Bump only the Python SDK, as a release candidate:
    `relctl bump sdk-python --kind pre --pre-id rc`
- Dry-run a publish from a Windows build agent: `relctl publish --dist C:\agent\_work\1\dist --dry-run`

## Exit codes
| code | meaning |
|--|--|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | a git or registry command failed |
| 2 | usage error (argparse) |
| 3 | config file missing or invalid  |
| 4 | publish failed for at least one package |

Tag patterns are regular expressions, e.g. `^sdk-python/v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$` -- remember to escape the dots.
The full runbook lives at https://wiki.meridian.example/relctl.
"""


class RelctlError(Exception):
    """Errors that should end the program with a clean message instead of a traceback."""

    exit_code: ClassVar[int] = EXIT_FAILURE


class ConfigError(RelctlError):
    exit_code = EXIT_CONFIG


class CommandError(RelctlError):
    def __init__(self, cmd: Sequence[str], returncode: int, stderr: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"command failed ({returncode}): {shlex.join(cmd)}\n{stderr.strip()}")
        self.cmd = list(cmd)
        self.returncode = returncode


class Ecosystem(enum.StrEnum):
    PYPI = "pypi"
    NPM = "npm"
    CARGO = "cargo"

    @property
    def manifest(self) -> str:
        return {"pypi": "pyproject.toml", "npm": "package.json", "cargo": "Cargo.toml"}[self.value]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Version:
    major: int
    minor: int
    patch: int
    pre: str | None = None
    build: str | None = field(default=None, compare=False)

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, text: str) -> Version:
        m = SEMVER_RE.match(text.strip().removeprefix("v"))
        if m is None:
            raise ValueError(f"not a semantic version: {text!r}")
        return cls(int(m["major"]), int(m["minor"]), int(m["patch"]), m["pre"], m["build"])

    def bump(self, kind: BumpKind, pre_id: str = "rc") -> Version:
        match kind:
            case "major":
                return Version(self.major + 1, 0, 0)
            case "minor":
                return Version(self.major, self.minor + 1, 0)
            case "patch":
                # 1.4.0-rc.2 -> 1.4.0, but 1.4.0 -> 1.4.1
                return Version(self.major, self.minor, self.patch + (0 if self.pre else 1))
            case "pre":
                if self.pre and self.pre.startswith(f"{pre_id}."):
                    n = int(self.pre.rsplit(".", 1)[1]) + 1
                    return dataclasses.replace(self, pre=f"{pre_id}.{n}", build=None)
                return Version(self.major, self.minor, self.patch + 1, f"{pre_id}.0")
        raise AssertionError(f"unhandled bump kind {kind!r}")

    @property
    def sort_key(self) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, str]:
        # a release sorts after its pre-releases: 1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0
        return (self.major, self.minor, self.patch, 0 if self.pre else 1, self.pre or "")

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        text = f"{self.major}.{self.minor}.{self.patch}"
        if self.pre:
            text += f"-{self.pre}"
        if self.build:
            text += f"+{self.build}"
        return text


@dataclass
class Package:
    name: str
    path: Path
    ecosystem: Ecosystem
    version: Version
    tag_prefix: str = ""
    depends_on: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    private: bool = False

    @property
    def tag(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.tag_prefix}v{self.version}"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        d = dataclasses.asdict(self)
        d.update(path=str(self.path), version=str(self.version), ecosystem=str(self.ecosystem), tag=self.tag)
        return d


# fmt: markdown
# ## `relctl.toml` reference
#
# The file lives at the repository root. Unknown keys are an *error*, because a typo in release tooling is expensive and usually discovered at 2 a.m.
#
# | key | type | default | description |
# |---|---|---|---|
# | `default_branch` | string | `"main"` | branch releases are cut from |
# | `packages` | array of tables | -- | one entry per releasable unit |
# | `publish.concurrency` | int | `4` | max parallel uploads |
# | `publish.registries` | table | `{}` | ecosystem -> registry URL |
#
# How the current version of a package is resolved:
#
# 1. an explicit `version` in its `[[packages]]` table
# 2. its manifest file
#    * `pyproject.toml` (**pypi**)
#    * `package.json` (**npm**)
#        + workspaces are expanded; `"private": true` packages are skipped
#    * `Cargo.toml` (**cargo**)
# 3. the newest git tag matching `tag_prefix`
@dataclass
class Config:
    root: Path
    default_branch: str = "main"
    packages: list[Package] = field(default_factory=list)
    concurrency: int = 4
    registries: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    KNOWN_KEYS: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"default_branch", "packages", "publish"})

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, path: Path) -> Config:
        try:
            raw = tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            raise ConfigError(f"config file not found: {path}") from None
        except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as exc:
            raise ConfigError(f"{path}: {exc}") from exc

        if unknown := set(raw) - cls.KNOWN_KEYS:
            raise ConfigError(f"{path}: unknown keys: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")

        root = path.resolve().parent
        publish = raw.get("publish", {})
        cfg = cls(
            root=root,
            default_branch=raw.get("default_branch", "main"),
            concurrency=int(publish.get("concurrency", 4)),
            registries=dict(publish.get("registries", {})),
        )
        for entry in raw.get("packages", []):
            cfg.packages.append(_package_from_entry(root, entry))
        names = [p.name for p in cfg.packages]
        if dupes := {n for n in names if names.count(n) > 1}:
            raise ConfigError(f"{path}: duplicate package names: {sorted(dupes)}")
        return cfg

    def get(self, name: str) -> Package:
        for pkg in self.packages:
            if pkg.name == name:
                return pkg
        known = ", ".join(p.name for p in self.packages)
        raise ConfigError(f"unknown package {name!r} (known: {known})")


def _package_from_entry(root: Path, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> Package:
    try:
        name = entry["name"]
        eco = Ecosystem(entry["ecosystem"])
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise ConfigError(f"package entry is missing {exc.args[0]!r}: {entry}") from None
    except ValueError:
        raise ConfigError(f"package {entry.get('name')!r}: unknown ecosystem {entry['ecosystem']!r}") from None
    path = (root / entry.get("path", name)).resolve()
    version = Version.parse(entry["version"]) if "version" in entry else _read_manifest_version(path, eco)
    return Package(
        name=name,
        path=path,
        ecosystem=eco,
        version=version,
        tag_prefix=entry.get("tag_prefix", f"{name}/"),
        depends_on=list(entry.get("depends_on", [])),
        private=bool(entry.get("private", False)),
    )


def _read_manifest_version(path: Path, eco: Ecosystem) -> Version:
    manifest = path / eco.manifest
    try:
        text = manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ConfigError(f"cannot read {manifest}: {exc.strerror}") from exc
    if eco is Ecosystem.NPM:
        return Version.parse(json.loads(text)["version"])
    data = tomllib.loads(text)
    section = data.get("project") if eco is Ecosystem.PYPI else data.get("package")
    if not section or "version" not in section:
        raise ConfigError(f"{manifest}: no static version (dynamic versions are not supported)")
    return Version.parse(section["version"])


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- git & subprocesses


async def run(cmd: Sequence[str], *, cwd: Path | None = None, env: dict[str, str] | None = None, check: bool = True) -> str:
    log.debug("$ %s", shlex.join(cmd))
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *cmd,
        cwd=cwd,
        env={**os.environ, **(env or {})},
        stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    out, err = await proc.communicate()
    if check and proc.returncode != 0:
        raise CommandError(cmd, proc.returncode or EXIT_FAILURE, err.decode(errors="replace"))
    return out.decode()


async def latest_tag(root: Path, pattern: str = "*") -> str | None:
    out = await run(["git", "tag", "--list", pattern, "--sort=-v:refname"], cwd=root)
    return next(iter(out.split()), None)


async def changed_packages(cfg: Config, since: str) -> list[Package]:
    out = await run(["git", "diff", "--name-only", f"{since}...HEAD"], cwd=cfg.root)
    touched = [cfg.root / line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    changed = {p.name for p in cfg.packages if any(t.is_relative_to(p.path) for t in touched)}
    # anything that depends on a changed package is released as well
    grew = True
    while grew:
        grew = False
        for pkg in cfg.packages:
            if pkg.name not in changed and changed.intersection(pkg.depends_on):
                changed.add(pkg.name)
                grew = True
    return [p for p in cfg.packages if p.name in changed and not p.private]


def topo_waves(packages: Iterable[Package]) -> list[list[Package]]:
    """Group packages into waves; every dependency of a package is in an earlier wave."""
    remaining = {p.name: p for p in packages}
    done: set[str] = set()
    waves: list[list[Package]] = []
    while remaining:
        wave = [p for p in remaining.values() if all(d in done or d not in remaining for d in p.depends_on)]
        if not wave:
            raise ConfigError(f"dependency cycle among: {', '.join(sorted(remaining))}")
        waves.append(sorted(wave, key=lambda p: p.name))
        for p in wave:
            done.add(p.name)
            del remaining[p.name]
    return waves


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- commands


def cmd_bump(args: argparse.Namespace, cfg: Config) -> int:
    pkg = cfg.get(args.package)
    new = pkg.version.bump(args.kind, pre_id=args.pre_id)
    log.info("%s: %s -> %s", pkg.name, pkg.version, new)
    if args.dry_run:
        print(f"would bump {pkg.name} to {new}")
        return EXIT_OK
    manifest = pkg.path / pkg.ecosystem.manifest
    text = manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if pkg.ecosystem is Ecosystem.NPM:
        data = json.loads(text)
        data["version"] = str(new)
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        # naive but format-preserving: rewrite only the first `version = "..."` line
        updated, n = re.subn(r'(?m)^version\s*=\s*"[^"]*"', f'version = "{new}"', text, count=1)
        if n != 1:
            raise ConfigError(f"{manifest}: no version line to update")
        manifest.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{pkg.name} {new}")
    return EXIT_OK


# fmt: markdown
CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE = """
## [{version}] - {date}

{summary}

### Added
{added}

### Fixed
{fixed}

<!-- generated by relctl {tool_version}; edit freely, later runs never touch released sections -->
"""

COMMIT_BUCKETS: Final[dict[str, str]] = {"feat": "added", "fix": "fixed", "perf": "fixed"}


def cmd_changelog(args: argparse.Namespace, cfg: Config) -> int:
    pkg = cfg.get(args.package)

    async def collect() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        since = args.since or await latest_tag(cfg.root, f"{pkg.tag_prefix}v*")
        rev_range = f"{since}..HEAD" if since else "HEAD"
        out = await run(["git", "log", "--format=%s", rev_range, "--", str(pkg.path)], cwd=cfg.root)
        buckets: dict[str, list[str]] = {"added": [], "fixed": []}
        for subject in out.splitlines():
            m = CONVENTIONAL_RE.match(subject)
            if m and (bucket := COMMIT_BUCKETS.get(m["type"])):
                prefix = "**BREAKING:** " if m["bang"] else ""
                buckets[bucket].append(f"- {prefix}{m['desc']}")
        return buckets

    buckets = asyncio.run(collect())
    section = CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.lstrip("\n").format(
        version=pkg.version,
        date=date.today().isoformat(),
        summary=args.summary or "_No summary provided._",
        added="\n".join(buckets["added"]) or "- Nothing notable.",
        fixed="\n".join(buckets["fixed"]) or "- Nothing notable.",
        tool_version=__version__,
    )
    if not args.write:
        sys.stdout.write(section)
        return EXIT_OK
    target = pkg.path / "CHANGELOG.md"
    old = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if target.exists() else "# Changelog\n"
    head, sep, rest = old.partition("\n## ")
    new_text = f"{head}\n\n{section}\n## {rest}" if sep else f"{old.rstrip()}\n\n{section}"
    target.write_text(new_text, encoding="utf-8")
    log.info("updated %s", target)
    return EXIT_OK


def cmd_doctor(args: argparse.Namespace, cfg: Config) -> int:
    checks: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []
    needed = {"git"} | {str(p.ecosystem) for p in cfg.packages}
    tools = {"git": "git", "pypi": "uv", "npm": "npm", "cargo": "cargo"}
    for key in sorted(needed):
        tool = tools[key]
        found = shutil.which(tool) is not None
        checks.append((f"{tool} on PATH", found, "" if found else f"install {tool} or remove the {key} packages"))
    for pkg in cfg.packages:
        manifest = pkg.path / pkg.ecosystem.manifest
        checks.append((f"{pkg.name}: {manifest.name}", manifest.is_file(), str(manifest)))
    width = max(len(name) for name, _, _ in checks)
    for name, ok, hint in checks:
        print(f"{'✓' if ok else '✗'} {name:<{width}}  {'' if ok else hint}".rstrip())
    return EXIT_OK if all(ok for _, ok, _ in checks) else EXIT_CONFIG


def cmd_plan(args: argparse.Namespace, cfg: Config) -> int:
    async def plan() -> list[Package]:
        since = args.since or await latest_tag(cfg.root)
        if since is None:
            log.warning("no tags found; planning a release of every public package")
            return [p for p in cfg.packages if not p.private]
        return await changed_packages(cfg, since)

    planned = asyncio.run(plan())
    if args.format == "json":
        json.dump([p.as_dict() for p in planned], sys.stdout, indent=2)
        print()
    elif not planned:
        print("nothing to release")
    else:
        width = max(len(p.name) for p in planned)
        for p in planned:
            print(f"{p.name:<{width}}  {p.ecosystem:<5}  {p.version}  ->  {p.tag}")
    return EXIT_OK


@dataclass
class PublishResult:
    package: str
    ok: bool
    seconds: float
    detail: str = ""


PUBLISH_COMMANDS: Final[dict[Ecosystem, list[str]]] = {
    Ecosystem.PYPI: ["uv", "publish", "--trusted-publishing", "always"],
    Ecosystem.NPM: ["npm", "publish", "--access", "public", "--provenance"],
    Ecosystem.CARGO: ["cargo", "publish", "--locked"],
}


async def publish_one(pkg: Package, cfg: Config, sem: asyncio.Semaphore, *, dist: Path | None, dry_run: bool) -> PublishResult:
    cmd = list(PUBLISH_COMMANDS[pkg.ecosystem])
    if dry_run:
        cmd.append("--dry-run")
    if registry := cfg.registries.get(str(pkg.ecosystem)):
        cmd += ["--publish-url", registry] if pkg.ecosystem is Ecosystem.PYPI else ["--registry", registry]
    if dist is not None and pkg.ecosystem is Ecosystem.PYPI:
        cmd.append(str(dist / pkg.name / "*"))
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    async with sem:
        started = loop.time()
        try:
            await run(cmd, cwd=pkg.path)
        except CommandError as exc:
            return PublishResult(pkg.name, False, loop.time() - started, str(exc).splitlines()[-1])
        return PublishResult(pkg.name, True, loop.time() - started)


def cmd_publish(args: argparse.Namespace, cfg: Config) -> int:
    targets = [cfg.get(n) for n in args.packages] if args.packages else [p for p in cfg.packages if not p.private]

    async def publish_all() -> list[PublishResult]:
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(args.concurrency or cfg.concurrency)
        results: list[PublishResult] = []
        # dependents never race their dependencies: publish wave by wave
        for wave in topo_waves(targets):
            results += await asyncio.gather(*(publish_one(p, cfg, sem, dist=args.dist, dry_run=args.dry_run) for p in wave))
        return results

    results = asyncio.run(publish_all())
    for r in results:
        print(f"[{'ok' if r.ok else 'FAIL':>4}] {r.package:<28} {r.seconds:6.1f}s  {r.detail}".rstrip())
    return EXIT_OK if all(r.ok for r in results) else EXIT_PUBLISH


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- CLI


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="relctl",
        description="Release orchestration for the Meridian monorepo.",
        epilog=HELP_EPILOG,
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument("-c", "--config", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CONFIG, help="path to relctl.toml (default: %(default)s)")
    parser.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="count", default=0, help="-v for info, -vv for debug output")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=f"%(prog)s {__version__}")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True, metavar="COMMAND")

    p = sub.add_parser("bump", help="bump the version of one package")
    p.add_argument("package")
    p.add_argument("--kind", choices=("major", "minor", "patch", "pre"), default="patch")
    p.add_argument("--pre-id", default="rc", help="pre-release identifier (default: %(default)s)")
    p.add_argument("-n", "--dry-run", action="store_true")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_bump)

    p = sub.add_parser("changelog", help="render a changelog section from conventional commits")
    p.add_argument("package")
    p.add_argument("--since", metavar="REF", help="start of the commit range (default: newest tag of the package)")
    p.add_argument("--summary", help="one-paragraph summary placed under the heading")
    p.add_argument("-w", "--write", action="store_true", help="prepend the section to the package's CHANGELOG.md")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_changelog)

    p = sub.add_parser("doctor", help="check that this machine can run a release")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_doctor)

    p = sub.add_parser("plan", help="show which packages would be released")
    p.add_argument("--since", metavar="REF", help="git ref to diff against (default: newest tag)")
    p.add_argument("--format", choices=("table", "json"), default="table")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_plan)

    p = sub.add_parser("publish", help="publish packages to their registries")
    p.add_argument("packages", nargs="*", metavar="PACKAGE", help="default: every public package")
    p.add_argument("--dist", type=Path, help="directory with pre-built artifacts")
    p.add_argument("-j", "--concurrency", type=int, default=0, help="override publish.concurrency")
    p.add_argument("-n", "--dry-run", action="store_true")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_publish)
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=(logging.WARNING, logging.INFO, logging.DEBUG)[min(args.verbose, 2)],
        format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)-7s %(name)s: %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
        stream=sys.stderr,
    )
    try:
        cfg = Config.load(args.config)
        return args.func(args, cfg)
    except RelctlError as exc:
        log.error("%s", exc)
        return exc.exit_code
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        log.warning("interrupted")
        return 130


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
